title: Senior Assigned Support Engineer-(Designated / Premier Support)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As an Assigned Support Engineer, you’ll be a trusted technical advisor to GitLab’s largest Self-managed, GitLab Dedicated, and GitLab.com customers, helping them avoid operational disruption and get the most from GitLab. You’ll combine deep Linux systems expertise, GitLab and CI/CD knowledge, and a proactive support mindset to understand each customer’s environment, anticipate and prevent issues, and solve complex technical and business challenges. In a typical week, you might be prioritizing strategic blockers with customer stakeholders, partnering with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales to drive defect resolution and influence the roadmap, or diving into code, logs, and tools like strace to troubleshoot performance issues. Your impact in the first year will be measured by customer trust, reduced critical incidents, and clear, reusable support content that empowers customers and GitLab teams alike.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Provide technical support to our largest Self-managed, GitLab Dedicated, and GitLab.com customers, ensuring their GitLab environments remain stable and performant.</li> <li value="2">Troubleshoot and resolve complex, critical, and sensitive support issues using tools like Zendesk, logs, and Linux utilities such as strace, through email and video conferencing.</li> <li value="3">Build strong, proactive relationships with key customer stakeholders, helping them prioritize and address their most important technical blockers.</li> <li value="4">Collaborate with <a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/product/">Product</a>, <a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/development/">Development</a>, <a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/infrastructure/">Infrastructure</a>, <a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/customer-success/">Customer Success</a>, and <a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/sales/">Sales</a> teams to drive bug fixes, influence feature development, and help shape product goals and roadmap.</li> <li value="5">Act as a technical expert on GitLab and CI/CD implementations, advising customers on how incidents and service interruptions impact their workflows and how to mitigate them.</li> <li value="6">Create and improve support content, including documentation and knowledge articles, to help customers and GitLab team members resolve issues more efficiently.</li> <li value="7">Partner closely with Support Engineering team members through <a class="textLink" href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/support-pairing/?_gl=1%2a1vj7usl%2a_ga%2aMTYyOTI0OTAxNC4xNjc4NzIwMDg0%2a_ga_ENFH3X7M5Y%2aMTY4NDgzNDU0OC4xMTAuMS4xNjg0ODM2NDM3LjAuMC4w">pairing sessions</a> and <a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/support/#support-stable-counterpart">stable counterpart</a> relationships to share knowledge and solve problems together.</li> <li value="8">Contribute to team growth by participating in hiring processes, including reviewing applications and assessments and joining interviews.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Background managing complex, customer facing support cases end to end, from initial inquiry and triage through reproduction, escalation, and resolution.</li> <li value="2">Advanced troubleshooting skills with the ability to investigate ambiguous, multi-layered technical issues and identify root causes across applications, infrastructure, and integrations.</li> <li value="3">Strong Linux systems administration knowledge (LFCE or RHCE equivalent), including performance analysis and low-level debugging tools.</li> <li value="4">Practical experience with GitLab and continuous integration / continuous delivery (CI/CD), including how different deployment models and outages affect customers.</li> <li value="5">Ability to write and maintain clear, reusable support content such as knowledge articles, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides.</li> <li value="6">Proficiency with scripting languages (such as Ruby or Bash) and familiarity with model-view-controller (MVC) frameworks, preferably Ruby on Rails.</li> <li value="7">Effective communication skills for explaining complex technical topics to audiences with varying technical backgrounds and for building rapport with customer stakeholders.</li> <li value="8">Familiarity with DevOps practices and technologies such as Kubernetes and serverless platforms, with openness to applying transferable skills from related domains.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Support team is a fully distributed, global group across the AMER, EMEA, and APAC regions, focused on helping customers get the most from GitLab by troubleshooting complex issues and digging into code and logs to understand why something is not working as expected. As an Assigned Support Engineer, you’ll be part of our broader Support Engineering organization, working closely with other Support Engineers through regular pairing sessions, 1:1s, coffee chats, and Slack conversations to stay connected while collaborating asynchronously across time zones. We balance autonomy with accountability, giving you flexibility to structure your shift in a way that fits your life while ensuring we can reliably address customer issues. Thanks to GitLab’s <a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/all-remote/values/#transparency">Transparency</a> value, you can see what we are working on in our<a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/support/"> Support Team</a> page. Additionally, you can see our <a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/direction/">company roadmap</a> and <a class="textLink" href="https://www.youtube.com/@Gitlab">meetings</a> to see what we are working on at any time.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

title: Account Executive – Sales Talent Pool: Register Your Interest
description: <p><strong>We’re always keen to hear from talented sales professionals. This is not a current vacancy, but if you’d like to be considered for future opportunities at Bitwarden, register your interest and we’ll contact you if a suitable role opens.</strong></p> <p><strong>About Bitwarden</strong><strong><br></strong> Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Our password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey solutions make it easy for everyone to extend robust security across their devices. Bitwarden is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California, with a team located across the globe.</p> <p><strong>What our Account Executives do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own a territory and an assigned quota, closing new business with a focus on organisations of 1,000+ employees</li> <li>Prospect effectively and manage lead flow to build a strong pipeline (typically 3–5x coverage)</li> <li>Manage and forecast the pipeline accurately in our CRM</li> <li>Build territory plans that deliver both short-term and long-term revenue</li> <li>Recruit, onboard and grow channel partners, including resellers, MSPs, VARs and integrators, and build joint business plans with measurable goals</li> <li>Work closely with marketing on events, programmes and campaigns that create demand among partners’ customers</li> <li>Keep sales leadership informed on channel pipeline and forecast</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who we’d love to hear from</strong></p> <ul> <li>4–8 years of SaaS sales experience in new business or business development. Cyber security experience is a plus but not essential</li> <li>A consistent track record of hitting annual quota, with specific customer wins you can talk about</li> <li>Proven success driving revenue through partners, with strong existing relationships with resellers, MSPs, VARs or integrators</li> <li>The ability to build relationships and influence decision makers at every level of a partner or customer organisation</li> <li>Experience at a startup or high-growth company is desirable</li> <li>A self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and can work independently or as part of a team</li> <li>Excellent communication skills: listening, writing and presenting</li> <li>Confident with CRM tools, Google Workspace and Microsoft Office</li> <li>A bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience</li> <li>Additional languages are welcome, as some territories may require them</li> </ul> <p><strong>What happens next</strong><strong><br></strong> Submit your CV along with a short note telling us where you’re based and the type of territory or role you’re interested in. If a suitable Account Executive role opens, our Talent Acquisition  team will contact you. Our process typically includes a screening call, interviews with sales leadership and the team, and a role play.</p> <p><strong>A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US</strong></p> <ul> <li>Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone––from our friends and family to the world’s largest organisations.</li> <li>Become an expert in a growing market. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software.</li> <li>Learn and grow professionally. Embrace the opportunity to build up your demand generation and product-led growth expertise in a fast-growing startup.</li> <li>We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work with motivated and supportive team members across the world.</li> </ul> <p><em>Bitwarden is dedicated to building a diverse and talented team and welcomes applications from all backgrounds.</em></p> <p><em>Privacy:</em> By submitting your CV, you agree that Bitwarden may keep your details, in line with our privacy policy (<a href="https://bitwarden.com/privacy/">https://bitwarden.com/privacy/</a>), to contact you about future sales roles. You can ask us to delete your details at any time by emailing ----- <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Legal Counsel (Employment Law)
description: <p>At JetBrains, code is our passion. Ever since we started, back in 2000, we have been striving to make the strongest, most effective developer tools on earth. By automating routine checks and corrections, our tools speed up production, freeing developers to grow, discover, and create.</p> <p>We are now looking for a Senior Legal Counsel – Employment Law, based in Germany, to provide expert legal support on German employment law and contribute to employment-related matters across JetBrains’ global operations. The role involves supporting HR in managing sensitive workplace situations, contributing to the development and implementation of employment practices that align with legal standards and business needs, and advising on employee representation structures.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as a trusted advisor to HR<strong> </strong>on sensitive and complex employee matters, providing strategic guidance that takes into account legal requirements, organizational context, and reputational considerations.</li> <li>Provide<strong> </strong>strategic legal support and pragmatic counsel to the Group Counsel – Labor Law, General Counsel, and the HR team, with a primary focus on German labor law and broader support across JetBrains’ operations.</li> <li>Handle a wide range of employee matters, including complex and sensitive cases in Germany, and assist with such matters in other jurisdictions by developing sound legal strategies, reviewing documentation, and helping the business confidently stand behind its decisions.</li> <li>Assess and respond to complex or nuanced internal communications and reports, supporting the development of thoughtful and well-balanced strategies aligned with legal and organizational considerations.</li> <li>Draft, review, and continuously improve employment agreements, contractor agreements, and HR-related templates and policies tailored to Germany and other applicable jurisdictions.</li> <li>Conduct in-depth, group-wide analyses on employment and labor law topics, and lead or contribute to cross-functional projects, including the harmonization of employment policies and documentation across countries.</li> <li>Act as a senior advisor to HR teams on employment practices and workplace policies, including remote work, employee benefits, disciplinary procedures, and work safety matters, particularly for the German entities of the JetBrains group.</li> <li>Take a lead role in providing legal support in relation to employee representation structures with a focus on Germany.<strong> </strong>Advise on their operations and management interactions in compliance with local legislation and best practices.</li> <li>Stay abreast of legislative changes in German labor law and provide legal training and knowledge-sharing sessions to internal stakeholders, particularly HR and management.</li> <li>Represent JetBrains in communications with German regulatory and government bodies on employment-related matters.</li> <li>Collaborate with legal colleagues across the global team on projects and issues that intersect with employment and labor law.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Fluency in German and English, both written and spoken.</li> <li>A law degree with excellent academic credentials. German bar admission is an advantage.</li> <li>Senior-level post-qualification experience in employment and labor law, typically gained through 6+ years of relevant legal practice with demonstrated hands-on experience in employment dispute resolution. Experience in both in-house and reputable international law firm environments is an advantage.</li> <li>In-depth knowledge of German employment law, with practical experience advising on complex workplace matters, procedures, and collaboration with employee representation structures.</li> <li>The ability to provide clear, solutions-oriented guidance in complex or evolving legal contexts.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to assess sensitive employee-related matters, distill key issues, and develop clear, effective legal and communication approaches.</li> <li>Excellent skills in legal drafting, negotiation, dispute resolution, and managing emotionally sensitive situations involving employees.</li> <li>A proactive, collaborative, pragmatic, and adaptable solutions-oriented approach, with strong interpersonal skills and business awareness.</li> <li>The ability to work independently in a fast-paced, international environment with multiple stakeholders and shifting priorities.</li> <li>Willingness to provide support for employment law matters in other countries with the help of external counsel and internal legal colleagues.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Why join JetBrains? </strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.</li> <li>Flexible work location. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.</li> <li>Remote work. Spend up to 30 days per year working remotely from abroad.</li> <li>Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.</li> <li>Medical insurance allowance. Enjoy peace of mind for you and your family</li> <li>Learning and development opportunities. Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.</li> <li>Language classes. Pick up the local language or sharpen your English skills.</li> <li>Fuel your day. Enjoy a hot meal or receive a lunch allowance on workdays.</li> <li>Mental health support. title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description: <h3><strong>Introduction</strong></h3> <p>We’re expanding and have a fantastic opportunity for a Senior Mechanical Engineer to join our mechanical and biomedical engineering department. We want to deepen and broaden the skills we already have in the group, and to add to its great culture. This role would suit someone in the early stages of their career, looking for a new challenge within an innovative company.</p> <p>This team works predominantly across healthcare projects, and you will use your engineering skills at all stages of the development life-cycle, taking responsibility for design challenges and technical problems.</p> <p>There is no deadline for this role, as we recruit on a rolling basis. Once the position is filled, we will close the advert. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.</p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></h3> <p>The majority of your time will be spent delivering exceptional mechanical engineering for our multi-national medical technology clients, understanding their requirements and communicating clearly and effectively. You will be hands-on in solving complex mechanical challenges, often alongside other disciplines, within supportive project teams.</p> <p>You will work on projects across a range of healthcare sectors, including medical devices, drug delivery, surgical systems and diagnostics instruments. The technical challenges we tackle are ground-breaking, innovative and make a real difference to the landscape of medical technology.</p> <p>You will guide aspects of the mechanical development and define technical solutions, using your experience to design systems and parts for manufacture by applying real-world knowledge. Your work is likely to include:</p> <ul> <li>First-principles engineering analysis</li> <li>Concept generation and the development of engineering designs</li> <li>Rapid prototyping</li> <li>Hands-on testing and experimentation, including the design and execution of test programmes</li> <li>Detailed design for manufacture and assembly, and liaising with suppliers</li> <li>Presenting results, both internally and to clients</li> <li>Preparing technical reports and producing high-quality documentation</li> </ul> <p>Our culture encourages team members to take on the level of responsibility that suits them. You will have the opportunity to significantly develop your skills and career, learn from others and make a substantial impact on our projects.</p> <p>We are keen to support the development of our employees, and as such offer an extensive in-house training program. As you advance within the organisation there will be plenty of opportunities for you to develop your technical skills and specialism, take on more leadership responsibilities and/or focus more on supporting the development of sales opportunities.</p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>What you can bring</strong></h3> <p>You’ll bring strong mechanical engineering ability and enthusiasm to the role. You will deliver high-quality work on client projects, to specification and to timelines. You will be responsible for delivering the tasks you’re assigned, and for defining tasks for yourself and often for others.</p> <p>We’re looking for applicants who can demonstrate:</p> <ul> <li>An excellent undergraduate degree in Mechanical Engineering (or a related subject such as Biomedical Engineering, Product Design Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering or Mechatronics) or equivalent experience</li> <li>Design engineering industry experience, for example (but not limited to) high proficiency in CAD (e.g. SolidWorks), design analysis, structural analysis, rapid prototyping, technical drawings, design for manufacture and design for assembly</li> <li>A proven track record of working in a diverse team and of successful delivery</li> <li>A creative and analytical approach to problem-solving and concept generation</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication</li> </ul> <p>In addition, experience in any of the following would be advantageous (but is not essential):</p> <ul> <li>Experience in a consulting environment</li> <li>Experience in medical device development, or other regulated product development</li> <li>Familiarity with analysis tools such as Python/MATLAB, CFD and FEA</li> <li>An interest in applying engineering to the biomedical field</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3><strong>What we do</strong></h3> <p>Cambridge Consultants is one of the world’s leading product development and technology consultancies, with a reputation for cutting-edge design, development and value creation for a global client base. We develop breakthrough technology for some of the most exciting companies on the planet. Our people, facilities and work make us unique. Our medical technology division develops some of the most novel products, with tangible and often life-changing benefits for users and patients.</p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>What we offer</strong></h3> <ul> <li>25 days annual leave plus bank holidays (with the option to buy 10 more a year)</li> <li>Company bonus (profit share)</li> <li>Flexible working patterns and hybrid working</li> <li>Medical insurance and group income protection</li> <li>Employee assistance programme and mental health support group</li> <li>Enhanced maternity/paternity leave</li> <li>Sabbatical leave</li> <li>Travel insurance (business and leisure)</li> <li>Generous company pension plan</li> <li>Personalised career development and training plans</li> <li>Free breakfast and two-course lunch in the office every day</li> <li>Free onsite parking and we are close to public transport links</li> <li>A variety of events organised by our social committee, ranging from summer and Christmas parties to board game nights and socials at our own rooftop bar!</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3><strong>Why Cambridge Consultants?</strong></h3> <p>At Cambridge Consultants, you'll contribute to radical, new-to-the-world innovation that transforms business, society and the planet. Joining our multidisciplinary teams means helping to turn bold ideas into reality, harnessing the power of deep tech to create products, services and experiences that have never existed before. Whether you're advancing technologies, shaping strategy, supporting operations or driving commercial growth, it's an opportunity to make a real impact and help create the future.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p style="text-align: center;"><strong>By submitting an application to Cambridge Consultants, you confirm that the information provided in this application, together with any supporting documentation, is true, complete, and accurate to the best of your knowledge and belief. You understand that any false statement, misleading information, or material omission may render you liable to disqualification from the recruitment process, withdrawal of any offer of employment, or dismissal without notice if discovered following appointment. You acknowledge that the organisation reserves the right to verify the information supplied.</strong><br></p> <hr> <p style="text-align: center;"> </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Mavericks Wanted</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"134233118":true,"201341983":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on</span> <br><span data-contrast="auto"> </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto">In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible. </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto"> </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto">Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll ask "why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical & thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"134233118":true,"201341983":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p></div><h3><strong><u>What You’ll Do</u></strong></h3> <p>The Associate Director, Patient Advocacy, Skeletal Dysplasia will develop and execute patient advocacy activities that support BridgeBio’s work in skeletal dysplasia, primarily focusing on Europe, Latin America and other international markets as needed, and requires fluency in both Portuguese and Spanish. The role has responsibility for the development and execution of the skeletal dysplasia patient advocacy activities in support of clinical development and commercialisation, while safeguarding long-term patient trust and community relationships in support to the Global and International Patient Advocacy strategy</p> <p>Reporting to the Executive Director of International Patient Advocacy, this role drives engagement across the skeletal dysplasia community in Latin America, Europe and supports other relevant international and local markets as needed, ensuring community insights inform company strategy and decision-making. The Associate Director supports the development of external international partnerships and advocacy and educational initiatives, strengthening meaningful outreach across the region.</p> <h3><strong><u>Key Responsibilities</u></strong></h3> <ul> <li>Serve as the primary liaison to patient advocacy organizations in Latin America, Europe and other international markets as needed, establishing and strengthening compliant, long-term relationships built on trust, transparency, and alignment</li> <li>Support the development of the patient advocacy strategy and implement an international patient advocacy plan for skeletal dysplasia, aligned with the international plan and local priorities</li> <li>Represent BridgeBio at patient advocacy and community meetings across materials</li> <li>Adapt engagement and communications for Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking and other international communities, ensuring materials and interactions are culturally relevant and accessible</li> <li>Support the Executive Director of International Patient Advocacy in strategic planning and oversight of advocacy-related budgets, including grants, sponsorships, advisory engagements, and educational initiatives</li> <li>Work with local and international teams to understand differences in care pathways, access barriers, community priorities, and advocacy environments across international markets</li> <li>Coordinate international grants, sponsorships, advisory engagements, and program budgets in line with applicable policies and local requirements</li> <li>Share clear, actionable community insights with internal partners while protecting individual privacy, preserving patient trust, and maintaining appropriate boundaries</li> <li>Monitor and report changes in communicating patient and caregiver perspectives, unmet needs, and appropriately consented stories and imagery through internal activities and company materials</li> <li>Strengthen BridgeBio’s role as a trusted partner in the skeletal dysplasia advocacy community through presentations and participation in relevant external forums</li> </ul> <h3><strong><u>Where You Will Work</u></strong></h3> <ul> <li>This role is based in Europe</li> <li>Frequent travel across Europe, Latin America and other relevant geographies is required; travel will vary with community and business needs</li> </ul> <h3><strong><u>Who You Are</u></strong></h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in a scientific field; advanced degree preferred.</li> <li>5+ years of patient advocacy or community preferred.</li> <li>Fluency in both Spanish and Portuguese is required to engage effectively with patient communities and partners in both languages. title: Werk Student Recruitment
description: Werkstudent Recruitment (Nederlandstalig) — Den Haag of Berlijn, hybride (v/m/x) Wil je weten hoe recruitment echt werkt? Bij Eye ga je niet alleen cv's archiveren. Je helpt een groeiend recruitmentteam bouwen aan de manier waarop we mensen aannemen. En als het klikt, willen we je graag laten doorgroeien tot recruiter. Over Eye Eye Security maakt cybersecurity van topniveau, met een ingebouwde cyberverzekering, bereikbaar voor elk bedrijf in Europa, niet alleen voor de grote spelers. We zijn met ruim 190 collega's, met ons hoofdkantoor in Den Haag en een kantoor in Berlijn. Ons team komt uit de inlichtingenwereld, defensie, tech en consultancy. We groeien hard, dus er is veel te bouwen en veel te leren. Wat ga je doen? Je helpt onze recruiters kandidaten te vinden voor lastig in te vullen functies Je screent sollicitaties voor onze junior functies, waarvan veel in het Nederlands Je maakt van recruitmentdata heldere rapportages waar het team en managers echt iets aan hebben Je verbetert hoe we ons ATS gebruiken en houdt de data op orde Je brengt structuur in onze recruitmentkennis, te beginnen met alle vacatureteksten op één plek Je zorgt dat sollicitatiegesprekken soepel verlopen: plannen, afstemmen en contact met kandidaten Je helpt onze contacten met hogescholen en universiteiten op te bouwen De functie is nieuw en groeit mee met jou en met wat het team het hardst nodig heeft. Wie ben jij? Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en redt je goed in het Engels Je zit in het derde of vierde jaar van je hbo- of wo-opleiding en kunt 20 uur per week werken, waarvan 2 à 3 dagen op ons kantoor in Den Haag of Berlijn Je hebt minstens een half jaar administratieve of kantoorervaring (een bestuursjaar telt ook mee) en je bent handig met Excel Je wilt een carrière in recruitment opbouwen en bent benieuwd hoe het vak in elkaar zit Je pakt dingen zelf op: je ziet wat er moet gebeuren, zoekt hulp als je die nodig hebt en stelt goede vragen Mooi meegenomen Je vindt het leuk om met data te werken, of wilt daar beter in worden Je hebt al wat ervaring met recruitment, HR of een ATS Wat krijg je? Vanaf de eerste week echte verantwoordelijkheid, met een recruiter naast je van wie je het vak leert Een duidelijke kans om door te groeien naar junior recruiter Flexibele uren die passen bij je studie, en hybride werken Een team dat successen samen viert, van maandelijkse teamactiviteiten tot onze jaarlijkse "Eye-cation" Over Eye Security Eye Security biedt cybersecurity met een ingebouwde cyberverzekering aan organisaties in heel Europa. Ons hoofdkantoor staat in Nederland en we zijn gegroeid naar ruim 170 medewerkers. We blijven internationaal uitbreiden. We combineren geavanceerde technologie met praktische expertise om cyberdreigingen in realtime te detecteren, erop te reageren en de schade te herstellen. Ons team bestaat uit professionals met een achtergrond in de inlichtingenwereld, defensie, tech en consultancy. We werken allemaal aan dezelfde missie: cybersecurity van topniveau bereikbaar maken voor elk bedrijf, niet alleen voor de grote spelers. Bij Eye werk je aan internationale projecten, los je echte vraagstukken op en help je onze klanten aan een veiligere digitale toekomst. Kleine noot: in de Engelse en Nederlandse vacature in het document staat “ruim 190 collega’s”, wat recentere vacatures van Eye ook noemen. Strong understanding of confidentiality, data protection (GDPR), and the judgment to know what can and cannot be shared externally. title: Working Student (m/w/d) - Pre Sales Support
description: As a leading global software product company in the field of Compliance & Automation, ITMF Group develop cutting-edge RegTech solutions with a focus on Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Fraud. We are dedicated to automating manual processes using Machine Learning and Data Science, ensuring our clients have the most efficient and effective compliance solutions in the market. We value innovation, excellence, and continuous learning at IMTF Group. We provide a dynamic, collaborative work environment where your ideas will be heard, and your skills will be put to the test. As a Working Student, you will support our Pre-Sales team in preparing presentations, demos and proposals that showcase the value of our compliance solutions to potential clients. Responsibilities Support the Pre-Sales team in preparing product presentations and demonstrations, e.g. slides, demo scenarios and test data Assist in responding to requests for information (RFIs) and requests for proposals (RFPs) by researching information, compiling answers and maintaining our response library Help keep our demo environments up-to-date, including creating test data and checking new product features after releases Create and maintain technical documentation, training materials and presentation templates Support proof of concept projects, e.g. with data preparation and documentation of results Conduct market and competitor research in the field of RegTech, Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Fraud Document customer feedback and prepare it for the product development team Requirements Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s program in Business Informatics, Business Administration with a focus on Finance/Banking, Computer Science, or a related field Interest in software and technology; interest in the financial sector or compliance topics is a plus Structured and accurate way of working, with the ability to quickly familiarize yourself with complex topics Confident use of MS Office, especially PowerPoint and Excel Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude Good communication skills, team spirit and a proactive attitude First practical experience from an internship or student job is an advantage, but not a must Fluent in both German and English, both written and spoken; additional languages are a plus Benefits Make the World Safer : Contribute to preventing financial crime and help our customers create a safer world. Be Part of an Established RegTech : Make a difference at a leading RegTech company in Switzerland. International Exposure : Expand your horizons by working with international customers on various challenging projects and markets in a dynamic, multicultural team. Ownership and Development : Make an impact and develop yourself by taking on significant ownership and responsibility from the beginning. Paid Further Education : Take advantage of opportunities for paid further education to enhance your skills and career growth. The anticipated salary for a Working Student – Pre Sales Support in Bensheim, Germany is EUR 18.000 gross per year based on a 20 hours working week (50 % employment level). At IMTF, we are committed to treating all candidates with respect and equality, regardless of gender, religion, nationality, or any other characteristic. We embrace diversity and inclusion as integral components of our organizational culture, and we welcome candidates from all backgrounds to apply and contribute to our team. <li>Experience working on large-scale systems</li> <li>Experience optimizing Continuous Delivery and Continuous Deployment pipelines as well as the tooling and processes that go with them</li> <li>Interest in cloud platforms, containerization, and Infrastructure as Code tools</li> <li>Application and systems observability background</li> <li>Collaboration mindset, boundless curiosity and a demonstrable ability to learn</li> <li>A product development mindset when developing new components</li> </ul> <p> You share our<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/values/"> values</a>, and work in accordance with those values.</p> <p><strong>Performance indicators</strong></p> <p>The Delivery team has the following performance indicators:</p> <ul> <li><a title: Team Lead, SEO & GEO (all genders)
description: <h2><strong>The role</strong></h2> <p>At HelloFresh, we want to change the way people eat forever by making it easier for customers around the world to discover, plan, and enjoy high-quality meals. Over the past decade, we’ve grown from a meal-kit company into a global food solutions group, active across multiple brands including HelloFresh, Factor, Green Chef, EveryPlate, Chef’s Plate, and Youfoodz.</p> <p>As search behavior evolves across Google, AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Reddit, and other discovery surfaces, our SEO team is expanding its focus from traditional organic search to broader Organic Discovery: building the content, technical, authority, and measurement foundations that help customers find our brands wherever discovery and dinner decisions happen.</p> <p>We are looking for a <strong>Team Lead, SEO & GEO</strong> to lead our global Organic Discovery team and help shape the next phase of how HelloFresh Group approaches organic growth. This role will lead a team of SEO/GEO specialists and work across international markets to translate global strategy into scalable programs that grow non-brand organic demand, strengthen our visibility across traditional and AI-driven search, and improve the quality and discoverability of our content.</p> <p>This is a highly cross-functional leadership role. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Content, Brand, and local Marketing teams to identify opportunities, prioritize the highest-impact work, and build scalable solutions across brands and markets. You’ll need to be equally comfortable setting strategy, coaching a team, digging into performance data, and influencing senior stakeholders to move complex initiatives forward.</p> <h2> </h2> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Lead, coach, and develop a team of SEO/GEO specialists, setting clear priorities and creating an environment of strong ownership, collaboration, and continuous development.</li> <li>Help define and execute the global SEO & GEO strategy across HelloFresh Group brands and markets, translating broader Organic Discovery priorities into actionable roadmaps.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to grow non-brand organic demand and customer acquisition across traditional search engines, AI search experiences, and emerging discovery platforms.</li> <li>Partner with local Marketing teams to understand market-specific opportunities and challenges while building global strategies, standards, and solutions that can scale across markets.</li> <li>Lead cross-functional Organic Discovery initiatives spanning technical SEO, content strategy, on-page optimization, structured data, internal linking, authority and trust signals, and GEO/AI visibility.</li> <li>Partner closely with Product and Engineering to translate SEO/GEO opportunities into clear requirements, influence roadmap prioritization, and ensure Organic Discovery is considered in all major product and platform decisions.</li> <li>Develop scalable approaches to content creation, optimization, and governance across recipe, editorial, transactional, and other high-value organic surfaces.</li> <li>Advance our GEO strategy by identifying how our brands can become more visible, cited, and authoritative across AI-powered discovery experiences.</li> <li>Use search, analytics, AI visibility, competitive, and internal business data to identify opportunities, diagnose performance changes, prioritize investments, and measure impact.</li> <li>Establish clear performance reporting and communicate SEO/GEO performance, opportunities, risks, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.</li> <li>Support global and local teams with SEO/GEO expertise, creating frameworks and best practices that enable markets to move quickly without sacrificing quality or consistency.</li> <li>Manage relationships with relevant agencies, technology partners, and vendors description: <div class="content-intro"><p>The Trade Desk is a global technology company and the world’s leading independent platform for digital advertising, with over 3,000 employees across more than 30 offices. Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet — from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more.  <br><br>Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world’s brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly. <br><br>The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you’re driven to solve meaningful challenges, we’d love to meet you.</p></div><p><span data-contrast="auto">The Trade Desk is changing the way global brands and their agencies advertise to audiences around the world. We are proud of the culture we have built. We value the unique experiences and perspectives that each person brings to The Trade Desk, and we are committed to fostering inclusive spaces where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work every day.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":240,"335559739":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">So, if you are talented, driven, creative, and eager to join a dynamic, globally-connected team, then we want to talk!</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":240,"335559739":240}"> </span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">What we do:</span></strong></p> <p>The DACH region represents a critical growth market for EMEA and this is a senior-level opportunity within our Market Development team, which is central to our EMEA growth<br>strategy. title: Director, Development Cost Management & Capital Planning EMEA
description: <p><strong>Director, Development Cost & Capital Planning (EMEA) </strong></p> <p><strong>Location: London, hybrid, with regular travel to project locations across EMEA</strong></p> <p><strong>About Nscale</strong></p> <p>At Nscale, we are building the infrastructure for Europe’s AI revolution. Nscale is developing cutting-edge sovereign generative AI solutions, powered by a new generation of high-performance, sustainable data centres and GPUs built specifically for AI workloads. </p> <p>The growth of artificial intelligence is driving unprecedented global demand for compute and GPU infrastructure. Nscale is positioned at the heart of this transformation — building the platforms that will enable the next decade of innovation. </p> <p>Nscale is working closely with the world’s most advanced AI technology providers, integrating next-gen compute hardware and GPU clusters in both partner and Nscale built facilities. This is a unique opportunity to join Nscale’s journey, play a key role in delivering transformative AI infrastructure, and help shape a company scaling globally with a key focus in the EMEA region.</p> <p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>The Director, Development Cost & Capital Planning is accountable for establishing cost certainty, capital planning, development risk and commercial viability across Nscale's EMEA Development portfolio from site identification (Gate 0) through due diligence (Gate 1) to development sanction and ‘shovel-ready’ transition into Delivery (Gate 2).</p> <p>The role owns L0 Indicative Estimates, L1 Estimated Budgets and L2 Schematic Design Budget for every EMEA opportunity, consolidating the development, energy, design, construction, procurement and AI infrastructure workstream budgets into a single Total Development Cost (TDC) providing the commercial and financial foundation for site selection, land and lease acquisitions, Colocation leases, underwriting business cases, investment committee approvals and project approvals.</p> <p>Operating as an individual contributor at first, the role will personally prepare estimates, cost models, risk registers, benchmarking and investment-grade business cases while establishing the systems, governance and processes required for future growth. The role will develop to manage a high performing team supporting the Development function as it expands across the EMEA region.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Development Cost Planning & Estimating</strong> - Own L0, L1 and L2 estimates across the EMEA portfolio, maintaining the Total Development Cost (TDC), proforma and development cost baseline through Gate 2. Where early stage budgets have missing elements, propose and agree estimates and placeholders with the project team.</li> <li><strong>Investment Underwriting & Business Case Development </strong>- Provide CAPEX, contingency, cash flow and cost-risk inputs to support acquisitions, business cases and Investment Committee approvals.</li> <li><strong>Development Risk Management and Contingency Planning</strong> - Maintain project risk registers and govern contingency in accordance with Nscale policy.</li> <li><strong>Site Selection & Land Acquisition Support</strong> - Support site screening, due diligence and acquisition decisions through cost, risk and abnormality assessments.</li> <li><strong>Power, Utilities & Infrastructure Assessment</strong> - Integrate power, utility and enabling infrastructure costs and schedules into the overall development budget.</li> <li><strong>Procurement & Strategic Supply Chain Integration</strong> - Work with Procurement and Strategic Sourcing to incorporate market capacity, procurement strategy, long-lead items and supply chain risks into estimates.</li> <li><strong>Cost Benchmarking</strong> - Maintain EMEA cost benchmarks, escalation assumptions and market intelligence across key jurisdictions.</li> <li><strong>Contract / Lease Support </strong>- Support the Development team in all areas of land / power acquisition and Colocation leasing and contracting, providing cost annexes in the agreed contract form.</li> <li><strong>Market Intelligence - </strong>Retain current market benchmark costs and reintegrate as-built costs of developments into pre-development modelling and estimates.</li> <li><strong>Portfolio Capital Planning & Forecasting</strong> - Lead portfolio CAPEX forecasting, cashflow planning and variance reporting for all pre-sanction opportunities.</li> <li><strong>Development Governance & Gateway Approvals</strong> - Own cost deliverables, assurance and reporting for Gate 0-2 approvals.</li> <li><strong>Global WBS Alignment and Handover into Delivery</strong> - Structure all estimates to the Global WBS and lead commercial transition to Delivery at Gate 2.</li> <li><strong>Lessons Learned and Estimating Accuracy Improvement</strong> - Improve estimate accuracy, benchmarking and contingency calibration through estimate-to-outturn analysis.</li> <li><strong>Functional Leadership and Future Team Development</strong> - Act as EMEA lead for development cost planning, establishing standards, tools and governance with responsibility for building and leading the team as the portfolio scales.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are</strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years of experience in quantity surveying, cost management, estimating, commercial management organisation.</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>Rôle et missions : </u></strong></p> <p>Vous prendrez la responsabilité du compte MGM au sein de l’équipe OpenDoor (entité qui gère l’ensemble des LOB d’Amazon au sein de WPP Media France).</p> <p>Sur ce portefeuille d'envergure, nous recherchons un <strong>Business Director</strong> <strong>– Client Lead </strong>pour incarner le conseil de haut niveau, guider les recommandations stratégiques et accompagner la montée en compétences d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire.</p> <p>Vos missions principales :</p> <ol> <li><strong> Vision Stratégique, Écriture & Prise de Hauteur :</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Rédiger et porter les recommandations stratégiques globales et spécifique à chaque sortie cinéma en apportant une vraie prise de hauteur 360°.</li> <li>Concevoir des présentations et des synthèses stratégiques à fort impact destinées aux directions marketing, comités de direction, instances internationales et réseaux de partenaires/franchisés.</li> <li>Valoriser, structurer et incarner avec conviction l'ensemble des travaux produits par l'agence pour sublimer la valeur délivrée aux clients.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> Appétence Innovation & Développement de la Valeur Client :</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Démontrer une forte curiosité et une appétence naturelle pour les sujets d'innovation média et les enjeux stratégiques clés du moment : <strong>Influence & Content / Opérations Spéciales, Event…</strong></li> <li>Dans une démarche conseil créatrice de valeur (et non de pur push commercial), savoir détecter dans les échanges clients les besoins émergents pour co-construire des solutions sur-mesure avec l'appui des équipes d'experts internes (Data, Studio, Activation).</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> Leadership Managérial & Coaching Orienté Développement :</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Encadrer et animer une équipe (Account Directors, Account Managers, Executives, Alternants).</li> <li>S'appuyer sur la forte autonomie de l'équipe dans la gestion opérationnelle du quotidien pour adopter une posture de <strong>mentor et de coach</strong>.</li> <li>Identifier les axes de progression individuels — notamment sur la prise de hauteur stratégique, l'écriture et la formalisation des recommandations — et accompagner le développement des collaborateurs seniors pour les aider à franchir des caps majeurs.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> Coordination 360 & Orchestration Interne :</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Assurer l'orchestration globale des réponses plurimédias (Online & Offline) en faisant le lien fluide entre le conseil, le planning stratégique, la création et les équipes d'activation technique (Social, Programmatique, TV/Vidéo).</li> </ul> <p>Profil Recherché :</p> <ul> <li><strong>Expérience :</strong> 10 à 12 ans d'expérience en agence média sur des fonctions de conseil, de stratégie média et de relation client.</li> <li><strong>Expertise dans l’industrie du Cinéma</strong>, idéalement ayant déjà piloté un compte Entertainment (distributeur cinéma).</li> <li><strong>Expertise Média 360 :</strong> Solide culture générale des médias (Off & Online).</li> <li><strong>Qualités Rédactionnelles & Synthèse :</strong> Excellence reconnue dans la réflexion et l'écriture stratégique, capacité à simplifier des problématiques complexes et à porter des dossiers stratégiques de haut niveau.</li> <li><strong>Posture Managériale :</strong>  Capacité avérée à faire progresser ses équipes par l'accompagnement et le coaching plutôt que par le micro-management.</li> <li><strong>Langues :</strong> Anglais professionnel obligatoire.</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>La vie chez WPP Media et ses avantages :</u></strong></p> <p>Notre engagement à façonner l'avenir des médias se manifeste par un soutien actif au développement professionnel de nos talents, les aidant à atteindre leur plein potentiel. Cette démarche s'accompagne d'une vision responsable dans nos stratégies d'investissement médiatique, reflétant ainsi notre double priorité : valoriser nos collaborateurs tout en adoptant des pratiques durables dans notre secteur.</p> <p>Les collaborateurs de WPP Media ont un accès privilégié aux réseaux internationaux de WPP Media et WPP, leur permettant de développer leurs passions, d'étendre leur réseau professionnel et de rester à la pointe des innovations en marketing et publicité.</p> <p>Nous disposons de ressources vastes et variées au service de nos collaborateurs, notre entreprise cultive activement l'inclusion des talents de tous horizons. Les réussites et expertises des équipes sont régulièrement mises en lumière lors d'événements fédérateurs qui ponctuent également les moments clés de l'année, renforçant ainsi notre culture d'entreprise collaborative et diversifiée.</p> <p><strong>Nos avantages comprennent :</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Télétravail :</strong> jusqu'à 2 jours par semaine et 2 semaines complètes à prendre en deux fois dans l’année.</li> <li><strong>Congés offerts :</strong> 2 jours de repos supplémentaires offerts, dont le lundi de Pentecôte.</li> <li><strong>Ancienneté :</strong> Jours de congé additionnels par palier de 5 ans d’ancienneté.</li> <li><strong>Santé & Équité :</strong> 5 jours de télétravail additionnels par mois pour les collaboratrices souffrant d’endométriose.</li> <li><strong>Politique handicap :</strong> 3 jours d'absence autorisés payés par an, accès à des Chèques Emploi Service Universel, et accompagnements spécifiques pour les collaborateurs ayant une RQTH.</li> <li><strong>Engagement sociétal :</strong> Missions solidaires possibles via le programme <em>We care and we act</em>.</li> <li><strong>Tools :</strong> Accès à des outils performants et à la pointe de la technologie pour la gestion des campagnes et le reporting (WPP Open).</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>Process de recrutement :</u></strong></p> <p>Nous nous engageons à rendre ce process aussi rapide et efficace que possible, et à maintenir une communication ouverte et transparente tout au long du process.</p> <ol> <li><strong>Entretien avec l’équipe Recrutement :</strong> Un premier entretien téléphonique ou par vidéoconférence avec l’équipe Talent pour aborder votre parcours et échanger sur le poste.</li> <li><strong>Entretiens Opérationnels :</strong> Une rencontre avec les leads des comptes à gérer. Au moins un entretien physique est prévu dans nos locaux.</li> <li><strong>Étude de cas :</strong> Réalisation d'un Business Case stratégique pour évaluer votre capacité d'analyse, de synthèse, la qualité de votre écriture et votre vision média.</li> </ol> <p>WPP Media garantit l'égalité des chances et considère tous les candidats sans discrimination ni considération de caractéristiques particulières. Nous nous engageons à cultiver un environnement de respect où chacun se sent à sa place et bénéficie des mêmes opportunités d'évolution professionnelle.  </p> <p>Consultez notre politique de confidentialité pour tout savoir sur la protection de vos données <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">politique de confidentialité</a>.  </p> <p>Bien que nous étudiions toutes les candidatures reçues, nous ne contactons que les personnes sélectionnées pour un entretien. <br><br>#<span class="mark

title: Senior Manager Commerce (Mensch) Retail Media
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><div class="scheme-content scheme-margin scheme-introduction"> <div class="content_text"> <p>WPP steht für kreative Transformation. Mit der Kraft von Kreativität gestalten wir eine bessere Zukunft für unsere Mitarbeitenden, unsere Kunden, unsere Gemeinschaften und unseren Planeten. Genau hier setzt WPP Media an: Als globales Mediennetzwerk von WPP vereinen wir die besten Plattformen, Talente und Partner, um in einer vernetzten Medienwelt neue Chancen für grenzenloses Wachstum zu schaffen.</p> <p> </p> </div> </div> <div class="scheme-content scheme-margin scheme-task"> <h2 class="scheme-headline">Das bieten wir dir:</h2> <div class="content_text"> <section> <ul> <li><strong>Work-Life-Balance</strong>: Mit unseren flexiblen Arbeitszeiten & Remote Work gestaltest du deinen Alltag so, wie er zu dir passt. Außerdem kannst du Überstunden ausgleichen. </li> <li><strong>Vacation mode on</strong>: Du erhältst 30 Urlaubstage plus einen flexiblen Tag – zusätzlich sind der 24. und 31.12. frei. </li> <li><strong>Wellbeing first: </strong>Gesundheitsleistungen, attraktive Altersvorsorge sowie Mental Health Awareness Days stellen deine Gesundheit in den Mittelpunkt.</li> <li><strong>Practice makes perfect</strong>: Entfalte dich mit unseren vielfältigen Weiterbildungen und nutze unsere internen Karriereprogramme für deine Entwicklung im WPP-Netzwerk.</li> <li><strong>More than just a job</strong>: Dich erwarten unvergessliche Events, Mitarbeitendenrabatte und weitere Highlights wie das Job Ticket, Wellhub oder das Job Bike.</li> <li><strong>Be yourself</strong>: Bei uns ist jede:r herzlich willkommen - Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit liegen uns am Herzen. </li> </ul> <p> </p> </section> </div> </div> <div class="scheme-content scheme-margin scheme-profile"> <h2 class="scheme-headline">Das bewegst du:</h2> <div class="content_text"> <section> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">Als <strong>Senior Manager Commerce (Mensch) Retail Media</strong> bist du die strategische und operative Schlüsselfigur für unsere Großkund. Du verantwortest die ganzheitliche Planung, Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung ihrer Retail-Media-Aktivitäten – von Amazon und weiteren Marktplätzen über führende Retailer bis hin zu Video- und Audio-Formaten.</p> <ul> <li data-pm-slice="1 1 []"><strong><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">Strategie & Jahresplanung:</span></strong> Du entwickelst ganzheitliche Commerce- und Retail-Media-Strategien für deine Kunden, definierst KPI-Ziele und erstellst die Mediaplanung über alle relevanten Touchpoints und Funnel-Stufen hinweg.</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal"><strong>Kundenführung & Management:</strong> Du führst den Kunden partnerschaftlich und auf Augenhöhe, steuerst die regelmäßige Kommunikation (inkl. internationaler Stakeholder) und präsentierst Ergebnisse sowie strategische Roadmaps in Reviews.</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal"><strong>Ganzheitliche Kampagnensteuerung (A–Z):</strong> Du verantwortest das Kampagnenmanagement über das gesamte Retail-Netzwerk – von Amazon (Sponsored Ads & DSP) über führende Retailer (dm, Rossmann, REWE etc.) bis hin zu Video- und Audio-Aktivierungen (Prime Video, Spotify).</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal"><strong>Operatives Setup & Aussteuerung:</strong> Du übernimmst das hands-on Kampagnen-Setup – von der Keyword- und Audience-Recherche über die Kampagnenstruktur bis hin zum täglichen Bid- und Pacing-Management, um Budgets optimal auszuschöpfen.</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal"><strong>Laufende Optimierung & Testing:</strong> Du justierst Gebote, Match Types und Zielgruppen, führst Tests&Learn durch, optimierst und hebst kontinuierlich Performance-Potenziale.</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal"><strong>Budget- & Rentabilitätsverantwortung:</strong> Du steuerst und überwachst signifikante Mediabudgets eigenverantwortlich, behältst ROAS sowie Effizienzmetriken im Blick und optimierst den Media-Mix kontinuierlich.</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal"><strong>Datenanalyse & Insights:</strong> Du analysierst Performance-, Sortiments- und Marktdaten, erkennst Wachstumshebel und übersetzt komplexe Zahlen in klare Handlungsempfehlungen für den Kunden.</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal"><strong>Fachliche Teamleitung:</strong> Du strukturierst und koordinierst Aufgaben innerhalb eines kleinen Teams, coachst Kolleg:innen auf Junior- und Mid-Level fachlich und sorgst für reibungslose operative Abläufe.</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal"><strong>Innovation & Weiterentwicklung:</strong> Du treibst Best Practices voran, testest neue AdTech-Möglichkeiten und gestaltest die Entwicklung unseres Commerce-Bereichs aktiv mit.</li> </ul> </section> </div> </div> <div class="scheme-content scheme-margin scheme-benefits"> <h2 class="scheme-headline"> </h2> <h2 class="scheme-headline">Das zeichnet dich aus:</h2> <div class="content_text"> <ul> <li class="x_MsoNormal"><strong><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">Berufserfahrung:</span></strong> Du verfügst über einschlägige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Retail Media, Performance Marketing oder E-Commerce (idealerweise auf Agentur- oder Brand-Seite).</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal"><strong>Fundiertes Plattform-Wissen:</strong> Du hast nachweisbare Praxis in der Planung, dem Setup und der Optimierung von Kampagnen im Bereich Advertising (Sponsored Ads und DSP).</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal"><strong>Ganzheitliches Retail-Verständnis:</strong> Du verstehst das Zusammenspiel von Retailern und Marken (egal ob Drogerie, Food oder Marktplatz) und hast Lust, Kampagnen über mehrere Handelsplattformen hinweg strategisch zu orchestrieren.</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal"><strong>Strategische & analytische Denkweise:</strong> Du denkst in Business-Zielen, verstehst Kennzahlen im Detail und kannst fundierte Mediapläne und Wachstumsstrategien entwickeln.</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal"><strong>Souveräne Kundenführung:</strong> Du trittst überzeugend auf, kannst komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich präsentieren und kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch und Englisch.</li> <li class="x_MsoNormal"><strong>Führungs- & Organisationsgeschick:</strong> Du hast Erfahrung darin, Aufgaben im Team strukturiert zu koordinieren, zu delegieren und Kolleg:innen fachlich zu unterstützen.</li> <li><strong>Persönlichkeit & Hands-on-Mentalität:</strong> Du denkst proaktiv mit, packst bei operativen Herausforderungen selbst mit an und bringst eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit.</li> <li><strong>Nice to Have: </strong>Erfahrungen mit weiteren Retail-Plattformen und AdTechs wie Criteo, CitrusAd oder The Trade Desk sowie Tools wie Pacvue, Skai oder Helium10. Kenntnisse in Streaming-Advertising und BI-Tools wie Power BI oder Looker Studio sind ebenfalls ein Plus.</li> </ul> <p> <strong>Darüber hinaus bist du:</strong> #teamorientiert #analytisch #kommunikativ #proaktiv #lösungsorientiert</p> <p>Wenn du diesen Job spannend findest, dann ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich zur Bewerbung, auch wenn du nicht jede oben gelistete Qualifikation aufweisen kannst.</p> <p> </p> </div> </div> <div class="scheme-content scheme-margin scheme-contact"> <h2 class="scheme-headline">Arbeiten bei WPP Media:</h2> <div class="content_text"> <p>Als WPP Media gestalten wir die Zukunft der Medien und investieren dabei konsequent in unsere Mitarbeiter:innen. Jede:r Kolleg:in genießt die Vorteile des globalen Netzwerks von WPP Media und WPP, um sich weiterzuentwickeln und an der Spitze von Marketing und Werbung zu lernen. Vielfalt und Zusammenhalt leben wir durch zahlreiche Employee Resource Groups und regelmäßige interne Events - zum Austausch, zur Inspiration und zum gemeinsamen Feiern unserer Erfolge.<br> <br>WPP Media ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir berücksichtigen alle Bewerber:innen für alle Positionen ohne Diskriminierung. Unser Ziel ist eine Kultur des Respekts und der Zugehörigkeit, in der jede:r die gleichen Möglichkeiten hat, sich einzubringen und beruflich zu wachsen.</p> <p>Bitte lies unsere <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">Datenschutzerklärung</a> für Deutschland, Österreich und die Schweiz, um weitere Informationen darüber zu erhalten, wie wir die von dir bereitgestellten Daten verarbeiten. </p> </div> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
