Auf Basis nachgewiesener Ergebnisse identifizierst du Cross- und Upselling-Potenziale und treibst nachhaltiges Wachstum voran.</li> <li><strong>Thought Leadership:</strong> Du positionierst WPP Media als Vordenker für moderne Datenstrategie und machst den Business Impact datengetriebener Lösungen durch Executive Briefings, Case Studies und POVs sichtbar.</li> <li><strong>Führungskultur:</strong> Als Vorbild für Inclusive Leadership förderst du Diversität, Eigenverantwortung und eine Kultur der Wertschätzung, Zusammenarbeit und des gemeinsamen Erfolgs.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2>Das zeichnet dich aus:</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Führungserfahrung:</strong> Nachweisbare, mehrjährige Erfahrung (mind. 2–3 Jahre) in der disziplinarischen und fachlichen Führung sowie in der Entwicklung von Teams.</li> <li><strong>Branchenexpertise:</strong> Mindestens 7 Jahre relevante Erfahrung im datengetriebenen Marketing, der Media-, Beratungs- oder AdTech/MarTech-Branche, mit praktischer Erfahrung in der Gestaltung und Umsetzung von Datenstrategien.</li> <li><strong>Fachkompetenz:</strong> Tiefgehendes Verständnis von Dateninfrastrukturen, Data Clean Rooms (z. B. InfoSum), CDPs, DSPs, Tagging, Analytics sowie von KI/ML-Konzepten im Marketing – mit der Fähigkeit, Anforderungen zu definieren und mit Fachspezialist:innen in die Umsetzung zu bringen.</li> <li><strong>Datenkompetenz:</strong> Sichere praktische Anwendung von 1PD/2PD/3PD-Daten sowie Kunden-, Business- und Marketingdaten in der Datenkollaboration und -aktivierung.</li> <li><strong>Methodenwissen:</strong> Fundiertes Wissen in den Bereichen Measurement, Incrementality-Frameworks sowie im agilen Projekt- und Change-Management; Erfahrung in der Steuerung mehrgleisiger Programme mit klaren Routinen und Dokumentation.</li> <li><strong>Unternehmerisches Denken:</strong> Eine klare Vision für deinen Einflussbereich, ein ausgeprägter Gestaltungswille und ein exzellentes Standing bei Kunden und Kollegen.</li> <li><strong>Netzwerkkompetenz:</strong> Als kollaborativer Matrix-Networker suchst du aktiv den Austausch über alle Hierarchieebenen hinweg und zeichnest dich durch hohe Problemlösungskompetenz aus.</li> <li><strong>Kommunikationsstärke:</strong> Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen einfach zu erklären und Vertrauen bei Kunden- und Agentur-Counterparts aufzubauen.</li> <li><strong>Ausbildung:</strong> Abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor) erforderlich, ein weiterführender Abschluss ist von Vorteil.</li> </ul> <p>Darüber hinaus bist du:<strong> #teamfähig #lösungsorientiert #kommunikativ</strong></p> <p>Wenn du diesen Job spannend findest, dann ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich zur Bewerbung, auch wenn du nicht jede oben gelistete Qualifikation aufweisen kannst.</p> <p></p> <h2>Arbeiten bei WPP Media:</h2> <p>Als WPP Media gestalten wir die Zukunft der Medien und investieren dabei konsequent in unsere Mitarbeiter:innen. Jede:r Kolleg:in genießt die Vorteile des globalen Netzwerks von WPP Media und WPP, um sich weiterzuentwickeln und an der Spitze von Marketing und Werbung zu lernen. Vielfalt und Zusammenhalt leben wir durch zahlreiche Employee Resource Groups und regelmäßige interne Events - zum Austausch, zur Inspiration und zum gemeinsamen Feiern unserer Erfolge.<br> <br>WPP Media ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir berücksichtigen alle Bewerber:innen für alle Positionen ohne Diskriminierung. Unser Ziel ist eine Kultur des Respekts und der Zugehörigkeit, in der jede:r die gleichen Möglichkeiten hat, sich einzubringen und beruflich zu wachsen.</p> <p>Bitte lies unsere <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">Datenschutzerklärung</a> für Deutschland, Österreich und die Schweiz, um weitere Informationen darüber zu erhalten, wie wir die von dir bereitgestellten Daten verarbeiten. </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Account Development Representative - France
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Who we are</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.</span></p></div><p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive. </p> <p>On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our French EMEA business, generating opportunities via outbound outreach. </p> <p>We have offices in Paris and London and we offer remote working from France and the United Kingdom.</p> <p><strong>This is a remote position open to candidates based in France and the United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CET. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.</strong></p> <p><strong>You should apply if: </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You want to impact the industries that run our world: </strong>Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.</li> <li><strong>You are the architect of your own career: </strong>If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.</li> <li><strong>You love talking to people: </strong>In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.</li> <li><strong>You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: </strong>One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.</li> <li><strong>You treat rejection as a learning experience:</strong> In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara’s mission.</li> <li><strong>You want to be with the best: </strong>Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>In this role, you will:</strong> </h4> <ul> <li>Drive pipeline through personalised outreach to prospects via phone, emails and LinkedIn</li> <li>Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.</li> <li>Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling</li> <li>Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)</li> <li>Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum requirements for the role:</strong></p> <ul> <li>1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles</li> <li>6-12 months sales experience as a minimum</li> <li>Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales</li> <li>Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, verbal and written</li> <li>Curious and able to ask insightful questions</li> <li>A champion of a Growth Mindset</li> <li>Highly proficient in English and fluent in French</li> </ul> <p><strong>An ideal candidate also has:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in closing-sales roles</li> <li>Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)</li> <li>Willingness to collaborate and influence in a “win as a team” environment</li> <li>Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways</li> <li>Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADR pathways</strong></p> <p>Through Samsara’s ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs’ understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.</p> <ul> <li><strong>ADR I</strong> representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.</li> </ul> <ul> <li>The next level in the program is <strong>ADR II</strong>, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.</li> </ul> <ul> <li>The highest level within our organization is <strong>ADR III</strong>. These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.</li> </ul> <p>Please submit an English CV with your application.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Total Rewards</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why <a href="https://www.samsara.com/company/careers/benefits">our rewards</a> are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.</p> <p>Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.</p> <p><strong>Flexible Working </strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.</span></p> <p><strong>Belonging at Samsara</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.</p> <p><strong>Accommodations </strong></p> <p>Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email <a ---------- or <a href="https://forms.gle/DrM6DFQUiSgfPtCVA">click here</a> if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.</p> <p><strong>Our Commitment to Authenticity</strong></p> <p>We use <a href="https://hiretofu.com/privacyPolicy">Tofu</a>, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize gen

title: Contract Sr Data Analyst (SQL,Telemetry,Browser Engine)
description: <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The Gecko platform is the core engine of our product experience. To maintain competitiveness and user satisfaction, we must move beyond surface-level metrics to understand the deep correlations between engine performance and real-world user behavior. We currently face challenges with data quality, such as bot contamination in nightly telemetry, which obscures our understanding of true performance trends. A dedicated analyst is required to bridge the gap between engineering telemetry and actionable product strategy, ensuring that leadership has high-fidelity data to prioritize performance guardrails and technical budgets.</span></p> <h3><strong>Engineering Deliverables</strong></h3> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Automated Dashboards:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Create and maintain high-level overview dashboards that translate complex performance data into consumable formats for Product Managers and leadership.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Telemetry Gap Analysis:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Audit the Gecko codebase to identify missing collection points or "probes" necessary for a complete understanding of the product experience.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Data Sanitization Frameworks:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Develop methodologies and tools to identify and filter data inconsistencies, specifically focusing on isolating bot traffic and hardware-specific noise from telemetry streams.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Behavioral Inference Reports:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Deliver deep-dive analyses correlating technical performance shifts (e.g., LCP, eTLD+1) with user-facing pain points and engagement trends.</span></li> </ul> <h3><strong>Scope, Skills, and Effort Estimate</strong></h3> <h3><strong>Scope</strong></h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The analyst will focus exclusively on Gecko engine telemetry across multiple platforms (Desktop and Android), collaborating with the Performance Team, Data Team, and Product Leadership.</span></p> <h3><strong>Required Skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Technical:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Advanced SQL (BigQuery/Redash), proficiency in data visualization using AI tooling, and experience with statistical analysis (e.g., Pearson’s correlation, multivariate analysis). Knowledge of Rust/C++ is a strong plus. Strong proficiency with AI tools like Claude Code, Codex, or similar is highly desirable. </span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Domain Knowledge:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Ability to understand browser component interactions and their impact on user experience.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Soft Skills:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Proven ability to work independently, translating technical requirements into business insights.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Independent problem solving:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Comfortable working in unfamiliar technical problem spaces and figuring out a path forward with minimal guidance, using documentation, experimentation, source code, data, and other available resources</span><span style="font-weight: 400;">.</span></li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><strong>Hiring Ranges:</strong></p></div><div class="title">Remote Germany</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$62,100</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$82,800 USD</span></div></div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Member of Marketing Staff - Events Marketing Specialist
description: Tessl is a fast-growing Series A startup based in London, founded by Guy Podjarny, who previously founded Snyk. We’ve raised more than $100 million from world-class investors, including Index Ventures, Accel, GV and Boldstart. In 2025, Tessl ranked #2 in Sifted’s B2B SaaS Rising 100 and #20 in its AI 100. We’re building the context layer for AI coding agents and a platform for AI-native software development. As an early member of the team, you’ll help shape how we build and scale a company operating at the forefront of AI and software development. About the Role Events are one of the main ways Tessl builds real relationships with developers, customers, and partners. We're looking for a mid-level Events Marketing Specialist in New York to run our growing US events program on the ground: community meetups, developer chapters, conferences, partner and customer events, and larger Tessl-owned moments. This is a hands-on execution role, with the opportunity to influence our events strategy as we grow our presence in the US. You'll take an agreed plan and make it real, and you'll be the person in the room making sure it runs. Most of the team sits outside the US, so you'll own your events with real autonomy, while sharing learnings and the impact of events on our growth goals with the wider team. What You'll Do Run US events end to end Own operational delivery once strategy, objectives, and format are agreed: timelines, run-of-show, budgets, vendors, venues, catering, AV, signage, swag, and shipping Be the primary owner on the ground, and troubleshoot calmly when something breaks an hour before doors open Make Tessl events feel considered and consistent, not just staffed Support the developer community program Help chapter leaders across the US navigate venues, formats, logistics, swag, and promotion Show up for priority community events and represent Tessl in the room Build repeatable resources so local chapters get more self-sufficient over time Coordinate conferences, partner and field events Manage Tessl's presence at third-party conferences and developer events, and support commercial B2B activations with Sales and Partnerships: booths, sponsorships, side events, dinners, and co-hosted events Keep both sides clear on responsibilities and deadlines on co-hosted events, and support larger programs like US roadshows alongside senior team members Help fill the room Work with Marketing, Community, and Sales so every event has a promotion plan and the assets to back it Flag early when registrations track below target, and help identify the local communities and companies worth reaching (audience acquisition matters here, but this isn't primarily a demand generation role) Keep everyone aligned Maintain a single source of truth for each event so people know what's happening and what they own Surface risks and blockers early with a proposed fix, and work smoothly across time zones with the UK-based Marketing and Community teams What Good Looks Like US events run smoothly without senior team members managing every operational detail Plans are current and trusted, and everyone knows what's expected of them and when Problems surface early, with solutions rather than surprises Events feel polished and intentional on the ground Our community program expands, with regular, well-attended meetups in key US cities Chapter organisers feel well supported and grow more self-sufficient over time Events contribute measurable value to our growth goals, generating sales opportunities and growing our community Awareness of Tessl and AI Native Dev grows among developers and technical leaders in the US What We're Looking For We're looking for a strong operator and doer. You don't need to bring a new events strategy; you need to be very good at turning plans into reality. Must have: A few years running events, field marketing, or community events, from planning through to live delivery Excellent organisation and project management, with real attention to detail across several events at once A proactive communicator who keeps people informed rather than waiting to be asked Good judgment and the confidence to make sensible calls independently Experience managing external vendors, venues, and event partners Happy to get hands-on: as comfortable talking through a plan with a senior stakeholder as tracking down a missing shipment before doors open Comfortable in a fast-moving company and working with a distributed international team Nice to have: Experience with developer, technology, or startup community events Experience supporting community chapters, ambassador programs, or meetup organisers Both community-focused and commercial B2B/field event experience Familiarity with the New York technology and developer scene Some experience promoting events through community channels, email, social, or local outreach Location and Travel This role is based in New York, with regular travel across the US. You'll be Tessl's primary events operator on the ground, so you should be happy to travel when your presence will make an event materially better. We don't expect you at every Tessl event. You'll also work with the global Marketing and Events team at larger moments and team gatherings. Salary and Benefits Salary: We offer a competitive salary based on experience and skills, benchmarked against industry standards. Application Process Introductory call Hiring manager deep dive Practical exercise Final conversation with leadership We care deeply about the warm, inclusive environment we’re building at Tessl and we value diversity – we welcome applications from those typically underrepresented in tech. If you like the sound of this role but are not totally sure whether you’re the right person, do apply anyway! Learn how we think and work On Tessl, The AI Native Development Startup Announcing skills on Tessl: the package manager for agent skills Podcast Episode: The End of Fragmented Agent Context, Guy Podjarny Tessl CEO Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: (Senior) DevOps Engineer (F/M/*)

Fragst Du Dich bei der Arbeit ständig: „Wie können wir unsere Infrastruktur noch effizienter gestalten?“ - Dann hilf uns, unsere systemübergreifende KI-Plattform auf die nächste Stufe zu heben. B. Darum treffen wir uns 3 mal wöchentlich an einem unserer Standorte Damit Du vor Ort auch gut versorgt bist, gibt es bei uns jeden Arbeitstag vor Ort digitale, steuerfreie Essensgutscheine direkt aufs Handy Attraktive Vergütung. title: UAV / Robotics Integration Field Engineer - Hardware
description: 🚀 Join SE3 Labs as (Senior) UAV / Robotics Integration Field Engineer - Hardware Be the person who makes advanced autonomous systems work in the real world. Move across the full stack: drones, sensors, calibration, autonomy software, perception, networking, payloads, field operations, and partner environments. When the system is not mission-ready, you create clarity, find the root cause, and help make it robust. About SE3 SE3 Labs is building Spatial AI by combining 3D computer vision with large language models. We believe the ability to reason about and act within physical space is foundational to unlocking the next generation of automation, from construction to smart infrastructure, and ultimately, defence. Now, we’re bringing Spatial AI into the sky through high-performance UAVs that can perceive, localize, coordinate, and act in the real world. This requires more than strong algorithms and good hardware. It requires systems that can be configured, calibrated, tested, deployed, demonstrated, debugged, and improved under real field conditions. We’re looking for a hands-on engineer who wants to work close to the product, close to the field, and close to the full autonomy stack. Someone who is not limited to one layer, but follows the problem wherever it leads. About the Role As (Senior) UAV / Robotics Integration Engineer , you will be the part of SE3’s engineering team to bring our technology into real-world use. You will bring together UAVs, payloads, sensors, onboard compute, autonomy software, operator tools, and partner environments into systems that are ready to fly, test, demonstrate, and deploy. This is a highly hands-on, end-to-end prototyping and field engineering role. You will work directly with other startups, prime contractors, and military institutions, translating their requirements into practical mechanical and electrical designs building on our existing technology. When something is not working, you go where the evidence leads: recalibrate a sensor, debug a radio link, inspect a wiring harness, analyse a flight log, fix a configuration issue, improve a checklist, or bring the right evidence back to the software development team. The problems you will work on are complex, dynamic, and multivariable. You will often have partial information, limited time, and a system where hardware, software, environment, and operator behavior interact in non-obvious ways. Your job is to create clarity, choose the right debugging path, and drive the system toward a robust long-term solution. You will not just operate systems. You will make them better. What You’ll Work On Own the integration project: Consult with partners, clarify requirements, agree interfaces and test criteria, and drive technical decisions and milestones to a working joint system. Cross-Stack Engineering: Design integration concepts, CAD models, electrical circuits and system integration and bring together sensors, enclosures, calibration, compute, mechanisms, power electronics, controls, networking, autonomy software, and operator workflows. Validation & Fieldability Ownership: Put your system through its paces: on test stands and in the field. Spot design flaws, integration gaps, recurring failure modes, and process bottlenecks. And establish confidence in mission-readiness as the maturity is realized. Create clarity in complex situations: Separate symptoms from root causes, devise efficient debugging workflows, reproduce failures and drive lasting solutions that make the system more robust long term. When the root cause requires it, contribute directly to the layer that matters, drawing directly from the experts who develop core components of your system. Acceptance & Testing Automation: Define and run acceptance tests for platforms, payloads, and deployment configurations. Own readiness checks across calibration, software flashing, networking, sensors, and pre-mission setup. Make readiness measurable and repeatable. Field Deployment & End-User Interface: Install, configure, maintain, and support SE3 systems at test ranges, customer sites, partner demonstrations, exercises, and real-world deployments. Make sure our autonomous platforms perform reliably where it matters, enable end-users to succeed in their missions and represent SE3 with technical credibility outside the lab. Your Profile Most importantly, you’re structured, fast-moving, and mission-driven. You don’t wait for perfect information. You create clarity, iterate fast, and prefer finding and fixing root causes over applying patches. You hold a B.Sc., M.Sc. or similar degree in Robotics, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, Mechatronics, or a related field. You bring multiple years of hands-on experience integrating, testing, operating, and troubleshooting complex robotic, UAV, embedded, automotive, industrial automation, or defence systems. You are proficient in using CAD software, creating wiring diagrams, building electromechanic prototypes and defining and executing test campaigns across hardware disciplines. You are familiar with soldering, crimping, using multimeters, oscilloscopes, serial consoles, or other lab and field equipment, with at least basic experience in command line, data analysis tools and Linux usage. You are proactive, hands-on and able to find effective solutions also under the constraints of field-campaigns and willing to travel and deploy across Europe. You enjoy working directly with partners, operators, and end users. You can explain technical problems clearly, build trust in stressful situations, and represent SE3 professionally outside the lab. You speak fluent English; German is a strong plus. A driving license is required. Given the nature of SE3’s work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to work on defence-related projects and, where required, obtain the relevant security clearance. Especially Valued Bonus Skills Specific knowledge in UAVs, PX4, ArduPilot, QGroundControl, Mission Planner, MAVLink, flight log analysis, mission planning, and airspace coordination. Proficiency in PCBA and electronics circuit design and prototyping, especially targeting high-speed data interfaces and sensors Experience with development on ROS2, Docker, Linux, edge compute devices, C++/Python, Bash, Git, or deployment automation. Experience with networking and radio systems, including WiFi networks, LTE/5G modems, VPNs, telemetry links, antenna placement, RF interference, tactical communication links, and debugging connectivity issues in the field. Experience with perception or measurement systems, camera/IMU calibration, sensor synchronization, image processing, or mission autonomy. Skills interpreting sensor data, robot logs, flight logs, frequency-domain data, vibration issues, EMI issues, thermal issues, or intermittent hardware failures. Experience with environmental testing such as vibration, thermal, ingress protection, EMI/EMC, or MIL-STD-style qualification workflows. Experience creating acceptance tests, runbooks, troubleshooting- or training guides, fleet dashboards, release checklists, or field-support processes. Perks & Benefits Real Ownership: Get equity early, real stock options to participate directly in SE3’s growth Work Environment to Excel at: Find a high-quality and modern toolset, flat hierarchy and a skilled, driven team which will push the limits together with you. We are an AI-first company empowering every employee with best-in-class AI tools and agents, giving you unlimited access to the latest advancements and a true productivity edge. 31 Paid Days Off: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off Well-being Access: Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass Team Offsites: We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Italy and Greece Mentorship: Work closely with experienced engineers and get paired with a professional mentor to support your growth Our Process Intro Call (20 min): Let’s get to know each other Technical Screen (30 min): First overview of your abilities in system integration, field testing and debugging Technical Interview (45 min): We dive deeper into your hardware design skills and ability to iterate based on first principle reasoning. title: Senior Technical Architect & Developer – Marketing Automation
description: Who is Sonar? Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com , Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development. Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. Position Description We are seeking a deeply technical Marketing Technology Architect / Developer to lead the data architecture, custom code development, system integrations, and infrastructure scalability of our marketing engine. Our day-to-day stack currently relies on Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) as our primary engine, and we are actively considering next-generation architecture like Marketing Cloud Next. However, for us, specific tool proficiency takes a backseat to a genuine passion for marketing technology, AI-driven marketing innovations, robust data architecture, and technical problem-solving. We value your ability to analyze complex data models, integrate APIs, write clean code, and optimize high-throughput automation pipelines over specific certifications. If you are a platform-agnostic technologist passionate about marketing tech stack mechanics and AI marketing tools, this role provides the scope and autonomy to build world-class system infrastructure. What you will do Data Architecture & Engineering Operations Enablement: Prepare, clean, structure, and model marketing data for Marketing Operations teams to run campaigns, segment audiences, and manage daily operations friction-free. Data Modeling: Build and optimize scalable relational database structures, data extensions, custom models, and subscriber key lifecycles for operational needs. ETL & Data Pipelines: Partner with the Data Team to create automated SQL queries and ETL pipelines ingesting and transforming data warehouse datasets (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery) into production-ready data extensions. Governance & Hygiene: Maintain data hygiene, identity resolution, deduplication, and real-time ecosystem syncs to ensure efficiency. Technical Customization & Custom Development Write maintainable custom platform code (e.g., AMPscript, SSJS, WSProxy) for personalization engines. Develop dynamic rendering logic, interactive web forms, and secure landing pages. Troubleshoot automation failures, script exceptions, and data bottlenecks. API & Ecosystem Integrations Architect and maintain API integrations (REST, SOAP, Webhooks) connecting product apps, mobile backends, and third-party systems to the marketing platform. Configure native CRM and database connectors for low-latency, real-time bidirectional sync. Manage rate limits, payload efficiency, OAuth, and retry handlers. Platform Operations & System Health Monitor runtimes, script performance, and query execution to ensure 99.9% uptime. title: Reliability Engineer

In this role, you will analyze the lifecycle of our equipment, evaluate how we manage asset maintenance, and prevent potential downtime before it happens. Explore innovative ways to streamline maintenance approaches while cutting overall operational costs. How you make your mark. Maximize equipment availability and reliability while lowering maintenance costs across the plant. Develop effective maintenance strategies and clear standard operating procedures for autonomous maintenance. Lead cross-functional improvement teams to solve persistent technical problems and boost site productivity. Support capital investment projects to ensure new equipment meets strict maintainability standards and spare part requirements. Conduct risk assessments to maintain full compliance with statutory inspection requirements, safety guidelines, and product quality standards. What you bring to the team. Strong experience as a reliability engineer or production specialist in a manufacturing environment. Deep knowledge of reliability engineering techniques including FMEA, FTA, PHA, and criticality analysis. Proven ability to facilitate root cause analysis and resolve complex technical equipment failures. Practical background in developing preventive maintenance strategies, SOPs, and machine inspection criteria. Hands-on experience supporting new machine installations, engineering trials, and capital projects. Strong communication skills to guide production teams and collaborate on safety and quality standards. What sets you apart. Experience applying maintainability analysis within high-volume automated production settings. Degree or formal qualification in Mechanical, Electrical, or Reliability Engineering. title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer
description: A World-Changing Company Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more. The Role Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSEs) work directly with customers to quickly understand their greatest problems and design and implement solutions to use data against them. Our customers rely on Palantir’s platforms for some of their most critical operations, and projects often start with an open ended question like “Why are we delaying so many flights?” or “How can we better identify instances of money laundering?” As an FDSE, you’ll apply your problem solving ability, creativity, and technical skills to help organizations use their data to drive a real impact in the world. You’ll have the opportunity to gain rare insight into and contribute to some of the world’s most important industries and institutions. As an FDSE, your responsibilities look similar to those of a startup CTO: you’ll work in small teams with minimal supervision and own end-to-end execution of high stakes projects. Your day might span discussing architecture with fellow engineers, wrangling massive-scale data, coding a custom web app, speaking with customer executives, or establishing strategy for your team. Whether you aspire to be an entrepreneur or an engineering leader, we believe Palantir is the best place — with the best colleagues — to learn how. You’ll learn how to unpack a problem and understand the costs and consequences of its solution. You’ll learn new technologies and languages, and even develop them yourself. You’ll work autonomously and make decisions independently, within a community that will support and challenge you as you grow and develop. Core Responsibilities Impact: We take on meaningful and challenging projects that change the world for the better. Ownership: We see projects through from beginning to end, working through any obstacles we may encounter. Collaboration: We work internally with people from a variety of backgrounds — such as other FDSEs, product teams, and Deployment Strategists. We also work externally with our customers, often on site, to understand and solve their problems. Trust: We trust each other to effectively manage time and priorities and give people the space to think for themselves. Growth: We encourage ourselves and our peers to seek new challenges and opportunities for growth, as well as find new ways to innovate and share knowledge. Learning: We often face entirely novel problems where we need to pick up a lot of new knowledge and learn how to use it to make progress. We believe experiential learning is one of the best teachers. What We Value Strong engineering background, preferred in fields such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, and Data Science. A highly analytical mindset and eagerness to solve technical problems with data structures, storage systems, cloud infrastructure, front-end frameworks, and other technical tools. Experience or interest in working with and using large scale data to solve valuable business problems. Strong coder with demonstrated proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, C++, TypeScript/JavaScript, or similar. Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively in teams of technical and non-technical individuals, and comfortable working in a rapidly changing environment with dynamic objectives and iteration with users. Ability to continuously learn, work independently, and make decisions with minimal supervision. Willingness and interest to travel as needed to client sites. Ability to travel 25-50% preferred, but may vary by team and location. What We Require Fluency in German Security clearance or the ability to obtain a clearance. Life at Palantir We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region. In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the city and or country in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office. If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process , please and let us know how we can help. Please note that you will never be asked to submit a payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the individual and consider reporting them to the relevant authorities, such as the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3) . title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer, Internship
description: Le poste Les Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSE) travaillent directement avec les clients afin de comprendre rapidement leurs problèmes les plus importants et ainsi concevoir et implémenter des solutions qui vont utiliser leurs données afin de résoudre ces problématiques. Nos clients s’appuient sur les plateformes de Palantir pour certaines de leurs opérations les plus critiques, et les projets débutent souvent par une question ouverte, par exemple : « Comment évaluer le risque d’incendie de forêt et, par conséquent, comment optimiser le réseau électrique ? » ou « Comment évaluer rapidement notre chaîne d’approvisionnement alimentaire et l’adapter afin d’apporter à temps une aide vitale ? » En tant que FDSE, vous appliquez votre capacité à résoudre les problèmes, votre créativité et vos compétences techniques pour aider les organisations à exploiter au mieux leurs données et avoir ainsi un impact réel sur le monde. Vous avez l’opportunité d’obtenir des informations rares et de contribuer à certaines des industries et institutions les plus importantes au monde. Responsabilités principales En tant que stagiaire chez FDSE, vos responsabilités s’apparentent à celles que l’on trouve dans une petite start-up, tout en bénéficiant des ressources, de la stabilité et de l’accompagnement d’une entreprise technologique bien établie. Vous travaillerez en petites équipes avec une supervision minimale et serez responsable de l’exécution de bout en bout de projets à enjeux élevés. Votre journée peut consister à discuter de l’architecture avec d’autres ingénieurs, à gérer des données à grande échelle, à coder une application web personnalisée, à discuter avec l’équipe dirigeante du client ou à établir une stratégie pour votre équipe. Les stagiaires FDSE sont traités exactement comme des ingénieurs à temps plein, et bénéficient d’une grande liberté et d’une grande autonomie dans leur travail. Ils assument la responsabilité des projets et des résultats réels sur lesquels nos clients comptent. Nos principes: Impact : nous gérons des projets significatifs et enthousiasmants qui rendent le monde meilleur. Responsabilité : nous menons nos projets du début à la fin, en surmontant tous les obstacles que nous pourrions rencontrer. Nous nous faisons mutuellement confiance afin de gérer efficacement le temps et les priorités et donner aux individus l’espace nécessaire pour réfléchir par eux-mêmes. Collaboration : nous travaillons en interne avec des personnes d’horizons variés, tels que d’autres FDSE, des équipes Produits et des Deployment Strategists. Nous travaillons également en externe avec nos clients, souvent sur site, afin de comprendre et de répondre à leurs problèmes. Développement : nous pensons que l’apprentissage par l’expérience est l’une des meilleures écoles et nous nous encourageons nous-mêmes tout comme nos pairs à rechercher de nouveaux défis et de nouvelles opportunités de croissance, ainsi qu’à trouver de nouvelles façons d’innover et de partager les connaissances. Le profil recherché Propension et intérêt à se déplacer sur les sites client en fonction des besoins. Capacité de passer 25 à 50 % du temps en déplacement de préférence, mais les exigences peuvent varier selon l’équipe et l’emplacement. Capacité démontrée à apprendre continuellement, à travailler de manière autonome et à prendre des décisions avec un minimum de direction. Capacité à collaborer avec des équipes de personnes techniques et non techniques, et à être à l’aise pour travailler dans un environnement en évolution constante avec des objectifs dynamiques et des itérations avec les utilisateurs. Volonté de résoudre de façon créative les problèmes techniques liés aux structures de données, aux systèmes de stockage, à l’infrastructure cloud, aux frameworks front-end et à d’autres outils techniques. Intérêt à travailler avec des données à grande échelle et à les utiliser pour résoudre des problèmes opérationnels importants. Les exigences Expérience en ingénierie, de préférence dans des domaines tels que l’informatique, les mathématiques, le Software Engineering, la physique et la science des données. Maîtrise de langages de programmation tels que Python, Java, C++, TypeScript/JavaScript ou similaire. Vous devez prévoir d’obtenir votre diplôme en 2027. Il doit s’agir de votre dernier stage avant d’obtenir votre diplôme. Pour postuler, veuillez soumettre ce qui suit : Un CV à jour Des réponses réfléchies à nos questions de candidature Date limite de l’offre Afin de renforcer la transparence de notre processus de recrutement, nous aimerions vous faire part de nos attentes concernant la date limite de l’offre. En postulant à ce poste, vous vous engagez à confirmer votre décision dans les deux semaines suivant la réception de votre offre écrite. La vie chez Palantir Nous tenons à ce que chaque Palantirien(ne) atteigne son meilleur potentiel, c’est pourquoi nous célébrons les forces, les compétences et les intérêts des individus, de votre premier entretien à votre croissance à long terme, plutôt que de nous appuyer sur les échelles de carrière traditionnelles. L’attention portée aux besoins de notre communauté nous permet d’optimiser nos possibilités de croissance et contribue à garantir de nombreuses voies de réussite chez Palantir. Promouvoir la santé et le bien-être dans tous les domaines de la vie des Palantiriens n’est que l’une des façons dont nous investissons dans notre communauté. Apprenez-en davantage sur la vie chez Palantir et notez que nos offres peuvent varier selon les régions. Conformément aux valeurs et à la culture de Palantir, nous estimons que les employés sont « meilleurs ensemble » et que le travail en présentiel permet d’obtenir des résultats plus créatifs. title: Product Manager
description: Wanna join the adventure? At Loft, we are convinced that space programs should not have to be rebuilt from scratch every time. Our philosophy has been to productize them: we develop our own proprietary technology blocks, hardware and software, so that a customer payload can be integrated faster and more reliably than any bespoke program allows. That approach has delivered — it is why our customers reach orbit in months rather than years, and it is what makes working here different from working in the rest of the industry. We are now taking the next step: launching and operating our own constellations, and building a new set of services on top of them. That includes a full product suite enabling third-party AI applications to run directly onboard our satellites, and a growing ecosystem of partners whose needs we have to understand and design for. Loft is expanding at a very high pace, and the range of what we build is expanding just as fast. This is why Product Management matters so much here. Someone has to hold the whole picture — what is technically possible, what customers actually need, what we should build first — and turn it into something engineering and leadership can act on. As a Product Manager, you will own a significant perimeter and the autonomy that goes with it. We are growing the team precisely so that each of us can go deeper on our topics, anticipate rather than react, and have more impact across the company. You will need to be comfortable talking to anyone here. In the same week you might sit with a system engineer to understand a design constraint, join a BD call with an institutional customer, and present a recommendation to the executive team. Ideas at Loft get discussed openly and on their merits, wherever they come from, so being able to ask a naive question without ego — and to disagree with someone senior without making it personal — matters more than seniority. Domain experience in at least one of: earth observation, embedded systems, aerospace systems, security & defense. description: <p> </p> <p><strong>Position Overview</strong></p> <p>Agile Robots SE is seeking a Network Architect / Network Specialist to define and operate our global on‑premise network across multiple geographies and regional offices. You will lead the design and lifecycle of our campus, branch, and data‑center networks—including high‑performance NVIDIA InfiniBand fabrics that power AI/HPC workloads—while ensuring our controls meet TISAX expectations and internal ISMS requirements.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>1) Global Architecture & Standards (On‑Prem Only)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design and document end‑to‑end on‑prem architectures (core/distribution/access/WLAN; DC leaf‑spine).</li> <li>Establish and maintain global standards: IP addressing & IPAM (NetBox), routing policy, QoS, naming, security baselines, and change control (HLD/LLD, MOP/SOP, rollback).</li> <li>Define network zoning & segmentation (VLAN/VRF; optional EVPN/VXLAN where justified) across Officeand DMZ networks with clear trust boundaries.</li> </ul> <p><strong>2) Routing, Switching, WLAN & Regional Sites</strong></p> <ul> <li>Engineer BGP/OSPF for WAN & DC; deliver redundancy/failover across carriers and sites.</li> <li>Own Aruba campus/branch switching and WLAN (coverage, capacity planning, RF hygiene, roaming, WPA2/3‑Enterprise).</li> <li>Plan and execute site builds/moves/expansions (circuits, last‑mile, demarc, handoffs, cutovers) with measurable downtime windows.</li> </ul> <p><strong>3) Security, Remote Access & Identity</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead FortiGate policy architecture (zones, NAT, segmentation, IDS/IPS) and FortiGate VPN (IPsec/SSL) for site‑to‑site and remote access, including HA and posture checks.</li> <li>Implement 802.1X NAC (e.g., Aruba ClearPass) with RADIUS/Active Directory integration; enforce device posture and guest segmentation.</li> <li>Operate DMZ patterns (reverse proxying, jump hosts, constrained admin planes) and align with TISAX/ISMSrequirements.</li> </ul> <p><strong>4) High‑Performance Networking for AI/HPC</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design, deploy, and maintain NVIDIA InfiniBand fabrics (topology, cabling/optics, partitioning), including subnet managers (<strong>UFM/opensm</strong>), congestion control, and path optimization.</li> <li>Coordinate with compute/storage teams (e.g., DGX/HPC clusters) on throughput, latency, and scale; plan upgrades and fabric expansions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>5) Reliability, Observability & Automation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Deliver high availability (fast convergence, dual‑homing, link aggregation/MLAG/VLT) and tested DR/failover.</li> <li>Implement proactive monitoring/alerting (e.g., Zabbix), telemetry/SNMP, and capacity trends; maintain RCAs and SLOs.</li> <li>Centralize logging with rsyslog and FortiAnalyzer; enforce retention and integrity for audits.</li> <li>Use NetBox, Ansible/Python, and Git‑based workflows for configuration management, drift control, and repeatable changes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>6) Compliance, Risk & Vendor Management (TISAX Focus)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Map network controls to <strong>TISAX</strong> expectations (ISMS governance, secure remote access, logging, supplier access, data protection).</li> <li>Partner with ISMS owner/CISO on <strong>risk assessments, controls testing</strong>, and <strong>evidence</strong> preparation for audits (policies, diagrams, logs, change records).</li> <li>Manage <strong>carriers and vendors</strong> (Fortinet, Aruba, Dell; integrators); lead RFPs, SLAs, and lifecycle planning.</li> <li>Mentor regional IT; act as <strong>L3 escalation</strong> for incidents and major changes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Core Technologies @ Agile Robots SE</strong></p> <ul> <li>Security & Remote Access: FortiGate NGFW, FortiGate VPN (IPsec/SSL), FortiManager/FortiAnalyzer.</li> <li>Campus/Branch & WLAN: Aruba CX/AOS switching, controllers/APs, ClearPass (802.1X), AirWave (on‑prem mgmt).</li> <li>Data Center & Fabric: Dell PowerSwitch (OS10), VLT/MLAG; NVIDIA InfiniBand (UFM/opensm).</li> <li>Foundational Services: VLAN/VRF, BGP/OSPF, QoS; DHCP/DNS, Active Directory, RADIUS; NetBox(IPAM/DCIM).</li> <li>Observability & Automation: Zabbix, rsyslog (retention policy), NetFlow/sFlow; Ansible/Python, Git.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <p><strong>Required</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years in enterprise on‑prem networking across multi‑site/multi‑region environments.</li> <li>Deep hands‑on with FortiGate, Aruba (switching/WLAN), Dell data‑center switching, and NVIDIA InfiniBand basics.</li> <li>Strong routing/switching (BGP, OSPF, VLAN, VRF), segmentation, and DMZ design; HA and fast convergence patterns.</li> <li>Proven delivery of secure remote access, 802.1X NAC, and logging/monitoring at scale (rsyslog, analyzers, NMS).</li> <li>Experience aligning network controls to ISMS/TISAX (policy ↔ design ↔ evidence).</li> <li>Excellent documentation (HLD/LLD, diagrams) and stakeholder communication.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Preferred</strong></p> <ul> <li>Certifications: Fortinet NSE (4/5/7+), Aruba (ACMA/ACMP/ACSP/ACDX), CCNP/CCIE, Dell networking, and/or NVIDIA networking.</li> <li>ClearPass NAC depth, FortiManager/FortiAnalyzer, Aruba AirWave; hands-on experience with experiment tracking, model registry, serving and monitoring (ideally Databricks and MLflow); backend services on Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform and event-driven patterns.</li> <li><strong>Applied ML curiosity:</strong> solid ML foundations, ability to judge new approaches critically; exposure to graph ML, fraud or claims data is a plus.</li> <li><strong>Software design:</strong> high proficiency in Python and strong experience with OOP; proven ability to design robust, maintainable software systems and write clean code, applying the right design patterns and software engineering best practices.</li> <li><strong>Leadership:</strong> experience leading technical initiatives across stakeholders, and coaching or managing technical contributors (or a clear motivation to do so).</li> <li><strong>English</strong> fluency required; You don't wait for permission to solve hard problems.</li> <li><strong>Make things simpler:</strong> You can break down complex AI concepts and architectures into clear, executable steps for engineers, data scientists, and non-technical partners alike.</li> <li><strong>Test & learn new things:</strong> You are genuinely obsessed with the fast-moving AI landscape. You constantly experiment with new models, libraries, and papers, and know how to extract real product value from the hype.</li> <li><strong>Communicate with impact & help others grow:</strong> You lead by example and collaboration, upskilling team members through pair programming, code reviews, and pragmatic design discussions.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p></p> <h3><strong>RECRUITMENT PROCESS</strong></h3> <ul> <li>A first fit call with our Talent Acquisition Specialist</li> <li>A couple of interviews to test your leadership & technical skills</li> <li>A final round at our office with multiple interviews inc. with some of our co-founders</li> </ul> <div> <p><span style="font-size: 8pt; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-RH1 #LI-HYBRID </span></p> </div> <p></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="color: #000000;"><strong><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">To support our permanent, full time employees at every stage of their careers and lives, we provide a competitive total rewards and benefits package. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.</p> <p>We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.</p></div><p data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Role</strong> We are looking for a Technical Success Manager to join our team. This is a remote role based in Netherlands reporting to the Senior Manager, Technical Success Management in the Customer Success Organization department. You will guide customers through their Zero Trust journey as the central post-sales point of contact, helping customers adopt and maximize Zscaler's solutions to secure their digital transformation objectives. Your role centers on providing expert advice, building relationships, and ensuring successful solution adoption.</p> <p data-path-to-node="1"><strong data-path-to-node="1" data-index-in-node="0">What you’ll do (Role Expectations)</strong></p> <ul data-path-to-node="2"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="2,0,0">Understand customer goals, challenges, and technical needs to align with Zscaler solutions and drive satisfaction</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="2,1,0">Build relationships with stakeholders, conduct reviews, and identify growth opportunities</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="2,2,0">Anticipate challenges, provide proactive recommendations, and mitigate risks</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="2,3,0">Maintain deep understanding of Zscaler products and contribute to internal and customer-facing Knowledge Base best practices</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="2,4,0">Collaborate with Sales, Support, and Product teams to deliver a seamless customer experience</p> </li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="3"><strong data-path-to-node="3" data-index-in-node="0">Who You Are (Success Profile)</strong></p> <ul data-path-to-node="4"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="4,0,0">You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="4,1,0">You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="4,2,0">You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="4,3,0">You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="4,4,0">You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.</p> </li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="5"><strong data-path-to-node="5" data-index-in-node="0">What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)</strong></p> <ul data-path-to-node="6"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="6,0,0">Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="6,1,0">5+ years of experience in customer-facing roles with a blend of technical expertise and account management, including product feature implementations and best-practice adoption</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="6,3,0">Experience troubleshooting network issues and familiarity with tools such as Ping, Traceroute, and MTR</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="6,4,0">Knowledge of ISO/OSI protocols including HTTP, SSL/TLS, FTP, and DNS</p> </li> <li>Ability to travel approximately 10% for customer-related requirements, with travel costs fully reclaimed</li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="7"><strong data-path-to-node="7" data-index-in-node="0">What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)</strong></p> <ul data-path-to-node="8"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,0,0">Experience utilizing AI-powered customer success platforms or predictive analytics tools to proactively identify customer adoption risks, anticipate technical escalations, and optimize retention strategies</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,1,0">Experience running discovery discussions, building High/Low level design, and managing large-scale deployments or migrations</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,2,0">In-depth understanding of enterprise networks, cloud security technologies like SASE, SSE, and ZTNA, and authentication protocols such as SAML, LDAP, and OAuth</p> </li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="9">#LI-Remote</p> <p data-path-to-node="9">#LI-MP1</p><div
