title: Principal Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><a href="https://fin.ai/">Fin</a>, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.</p> <p>Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.</p> <p>Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.</p> <p>Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.</p></div><p>Speed is something we fight for every day at Fin, and we believe Berlin is built for people who share that instinct. We are drawn to Berlin by its rare blend of deep technical talent and rich creative culture – all within a vibrant, globally connected city that’s close to our R&D hubs in Dublin and London. It’s a place where the best of the best technical talent thrive, and where people from around the world are eager to relocate and build ambitious products.</p> <p>Our ambition is to hire 100 people in Berlin over the year ahead across engineering, AI, data science, product, and design. We believe this is the most exciting time to join, be the founding R&D talent in the region and make a lasting impact as we build the world's number one customer agent!</p> <h2>What's the opportunity? </h2> <p>Principal Engineers at Fin have the opportunity to lead the definition and execution of key strategic initiatives.<strong> </strong>You will work autonomously and be accountable for strategic execution in part of the engineering organization. You will build both back-end and front-end systems, and work closely with designers, product managers, researchers, and data analysts. You will coach and mentor other engineers and partner closely with the Group Engineering Managers on technical strategy and leadership.</p> <p>Learn more about our engineering culture at <a href="http://intercom.engineering/">intercom.engineering</a></p> <h2>What will I be doing? </h2> <p>As an experienced engineer you will:</p> <ul> <li>Have a mastery of domain knowledge and work as a leader within the R&D org to drive key strategic projects.</li> <li>Provide assessments of project progress, risks and challenges to engineering leadership to help guide resource allocation and prioritisation.</li> <li>Contribute to our technical architecture as we grow. We scale to service requests from all our customers’ customers. We’re growing and so are they.</li> <li>Care about agility as much you care for scalability and availability. Continuous deployment keeps us focused on incremental releases. Even our biggest technical achievements roll out piece by piece, feature flagged out of sight.</li> <li>Contribute to all phases of software development including ideation, prototyping, design and implementation. This role has a mix of both hands-on development as well as lead/architecture work.</li> <li>Build using the best tools in the industry. We invest heavily in AI-powered developer tools that remove friction and help you focus on solving meaningful problems.</li> <li>Play an active role in hiring, mentoring and career development of other engineers</li> <li>Raise the bar for technical standards, performance, reliability, and operational excellence</li> </ul> <h2>What skills do I need? </h2> <ul> <li>Ideally, you’ve built an exciting SaaS product in your previous roles and loved the satisfaction that comes with knowing that people around the world are using something you’ve created</li> <li>Significant, demonstrated impact that your work has had on the product and/or the teams</li> <li>Deep knowledge of a high-level programming language (for example, Ruby, Python, Perl etc.) but it doesn’t need to be a language that we use here! Great people are effective and learn what we use quickly (or introduce us to better ways of working)</li> <li>You will have experience with Distributed systems</li> <li>2+ years of experience as the primary technical leader for a team</li> <li>Experience collaborating directly with technical leaders, product teams and designers, and a proven track record of delivering value to customers or users. Engineers at Fin are pragmatists who work closely with others on cross-disciplinary teams and have a strong sense of product strategy.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>#LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Unleash Your Potential</strong></p> <p>When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.</p> <p>In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at<a href="http://fin.ai/careers"> fin.ai/careers</a>. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. </p> <p><strong>Policies </strong></p> <p>Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.</p> <p>We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our <a href="https://www.intercom.com/careers">core values</a>.  </p> <p>Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. <a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/know-your-rights-workplace-discrimination-illegal">Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal.</a> Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.</p> <p> </p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Solutions
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.</strong></p> <p>Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.</p> <p>Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.</p> <p>As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.</p> <p>We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.</p> <p>Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role:  </strong></p> <p>As a Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM) at Planet, you will drive Planet’s largest, most complex efforts that cross many teams and organizational boundaries. You will act as an accelerant, illuminating the path for teams and owning the predictability of execution through the product lifecycle. You will work closely with team leads across multiple time zones to develop and manage end-to-end program plans, including processes, schedules, metrics and risks, and communicate them clearly to stakeholders.</p> <p>This role leads internal program management for Planet’s solutions in the DACH region (Germany, Austria and Switzerland), starting with a large, multi-year dedicated satellite constellation and sovereign platform deployment for a public-sector customer. You will be the accountable program owner for Product and Engineering, working alongside the customer-facing program manager to turn contract commitments into one coordinated plan across Product, Engineering, Infrastructure and Space Systems. The role grows with the DACH portfolio. Customer meetings and documents are in German, so native German is required.</p> <p>This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin office 3 days per week.</p> <p><strong>Impact You’ll Own:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the internal program plan for DACH deliveries: scope, schedule, incremental milestones with definitions of done, and the dependencies across teams.</li> <li>Set up and maintain program governance: who is accountable for each workstream, decision levels and reporting.</li> <li>Work daily with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, Tech Leads and other TPMs, and with the customer-facing program manager and Customer Success teams who own the customer relationship.</li> <li>Translate customer requirements into clear technical requirements, and work with Product Managers to prioritize requests against the roadmap.</li> <li>Run the program’s operating rhythm (cross-team syncs, go/no-go decisions, release coordination) so each meeting ends in decisions and owned actions.</li> <li>Challenge plans for completeness, accuracy, and fit for purpose, and surface risks and conflicts between commitments, priorities and capacity while they are still small.</li> <li>Keep stakeholders from engineering teams to leadership informed of progress, risks and changes, and escalate early when needed.</li> <li>Improve ways of working so each future deployment is faster and more repeatable.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring:</strong></p> <ul> <li>6+ years of program management or software development experience in the areas of SaaS, cloud platforms, data products or geospatial systems, ideally including remote sensing and satellite domain knowledge and experience.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.</li> <li>Fluency in written and spoken German and p<span style="color: #1d1c1d; background-color: #ffffff;">rofessional working proficiency in English, the language of the company.</span></li> <li>Experience leading complex technical programs across a matrixed organization and setting priorities independently, including programs with contractual commitments to external customers.</li> <li>Experience with the product lifecycle: concept through development, launch preparation, go-to-market, deprecations, and end-of-life.</li> <li>Analytical, problem-solving, and creative thinking skills paired with the ability to communicate findings and recommendations.</li> <li>Equally comfortable explaining your analyses and recommendations to business leaders as you are discussing technical trade-offs with engineers.</li> <li>Ability to balance the tactical day-to-day with forward-looking improvements to scale operational efficiencies.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You Stand Out:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with public-sector customers in the DACH region.</li> <li>Experience with sovereign, private-cloud or on-premises platform deployments.</li> <li>Experience with remote sensing, earth observation data, or geospatial systems.</li> <li>Experience working with remote, worldwide teams.</li> <li>Actively explores AI technologies to automate workflows, improve data, or enhance team productivity.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Application Deadline:</strong></p> <p>11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to.</p> <p><strong>Benefits While Working at Planet:</strong></p> <p><em>These offerings are dependent on employment type and geographical location, based upon applicable law or company policy.</em></p> <ul> <li>Paid time off including vacation, holidays and company-wide days off </li> <li>Employee Wellness Program </li> <li>Home Office Reimbursement</li> <li>Monthly Phone and Internet Reimbursement</li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement and access to LinkedIn Learning</li> <li>Equity </li> <li>Volunteering Paid Time Off</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation:</strong></p> <p>The expected starting gross salary range for this role is listed below. Individual placement within this range is determined objectively based on gender-neutral criteria such as your skills, qualifications, and professional experience. This position may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses and/or equity.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Germany Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€77.000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€96.300 EUR</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance<br></strong>Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.<strong><br></strong></p> <p><strong>Why we care so much about Belonging. <br></strong>We’re dedicated to helping the whole Planet, and to do that we must strive to represent all of it within each of our offices and on all of our teams. title: Senior Director of Engineering - Civil Government and Commercial

This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.</p> <p>Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.</p> <p>As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.</p> <p>We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.</p> <p>Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role:</strong></p> <p>We are seeking an experienced engineering leader to become our Senior Director of Engineering for Civil Government and Commercial. In this role, you will lead the engineering strategy, execution, and team development for a rapidly growing organization of 70+ engineers spanning multiple global Planet offices. You will oversee the development, scaling, and delivery of our critical existing solutions, including Area Monitoring Service (AMS) for EU Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) compliance, Disaster and Wildfire solutions, Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem (CDSE), and a portfolio of Derived Data Products. AI is central to how Planet builds solutions, and you will make it a primary way your teams discover, build, and deliver for customers. This position is vital to delivering innovative applications to civil governments and commercial customers worldwide.</p> <p>This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin, Haarlem, or Ljubljana office 3 days per week.</p> <p><strong>Impact You’ll Own:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead, mentor, and scale a global engineering organization of 70+ engineers, managers, and directors across multiple geographies and time zones.</li> <li>Set a high bar for performance and accountability. Define measurable outcomes for every product and team, surface risks early and directly, and make the hard calls on people and priorities when results fall short.</li> <li>Drive the day-to-day engineering execution and delivery for existing flagship products, ensuring reliability and performance for AMS,  Disaster and Wildfire solutions, and the derived data portfolio.</li> <li>Champion and lead "zero to one" engineering discovery, building the technical foundation and prototypes for new emerging commercial and civil government products.</li> <li>Partner on a daily basis with Product Management, Design, and GTM teams to define product direction, prioritize feature development, and align technical strategy with business goals.</li> <li>Ensure systems are scalable, reliable, and secure for government and enterprise use, guiding architectural decisions and engineering best practices.</li> <li>Align your team's daily output with Planet’s mission of using space to help life on earth, directly enabling governments and businesses to make critical, timely decisions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring:</strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years of relevant software engineering work experience, including 8+ years of supervisory or leadership experience managing multiple layers of engineering management.</li> <li>Experience leading and scaling distributed engineering teams of 50+ employees across multiple geographic locations and time zones.</li> <li>Hands-on engagement with AI tools in your own work, and experience leading engineering teams through AI adoption.</li> <li>Track record of "zero to one" product development, including the technical discovery, architecture, and successful launch of new software solutions.</li> <li>Background in building and delivering geospatial title: System Software/Embedded Engineer (Munich)
description: System Software / Embedded Engineer (Munich) About Tensordyne AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. While we have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe, this particular role is based on-site in Sunnyvale. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence! Location: This is an on-site role based in Sunnyvale, CA (required), with flexible office hours. Responsibilities The role will require you to join Tensordyne's Platform Software team to lead requirements gathering, design, and development of system-level services, tools, and supporting tests for Tensordyne's AI inference platform software, including debugging, profiling, and analysis capabilities. The successful candidate will support cross-functional engineering teams in the bring-up and validation of platform software on AI inference systems, and partner closely with the hardware, silicon, and validation teams to deliver robust, production-quality platform software. You will work close to the hardware on firmware and board bring-up, bootloaders and BSP development, device drivers, and Linux kernel modules, collaborating directly with the silicon and hardware teams on hardware/software co-design. The role also involves system-level performance and power optimization across the AI inference platform, working with low-level interfaces such as PCIe, I2C, SPI, and JTAG. Occasional travel (e.g., to partner, customer, or contract manufacturer sites) may be required but is not mandatory. Required Qualifications 5+ years of experience developing low-level systems and embedded software, firmware, and tooling for high-performance computing systems deployed to data center customers. Hands-on experience bringing up and debugging complex Linux-based systems at the kernel and driver level, including embedded Linux, device drivers, and/or RTOS environments; experience with SoC/silicon bring-up is highly desirable. Familiarity with AI inference frameworks and data center deployment/management environments is preferred. Expert programming experience in C and C++, with proficiency in Python, Bash/Shell, and/or related programming languages. Rust experience is a plus. Comfortable interfacing directly with hardware, reading schematics and datasheets, and debugging with tools such as JTAG, logic analyzers, and oscilloscopes. Self-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable working across hardware, silicon, and software teams in a fast-paced startup environment. Excellent technical communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex technical concepts and practical solutions. BS or MS degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. Tensordyne's culture was built on the following values Put people first. We only succeed when our people succeed. Ethics and integrity always; Being open, honest, and respectful of everyone. Think Big. Be ambitious and have audacious goals. Aim for excellence. Quality and excellence count in everything we do. Own it and get it done. Results matter! Make each person better together, than they would be as an individual. Embrace each others' differences, and embrace that there will be differences. Tensordyne is an equal opportunity employer. We believe that a diverse team is better at tackling complex problems and coming up with innovative solutions. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. title: Expert Site Reliability Engineer - Edge Infrastructure (f/m/d)
description: We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you. Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future. Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter. Help us see what's possible. Join us. Your Role Orbem’s AI-powered MRI systems run on edge infrastructure deployed directly at customer sites, such as hatcheries and food processing plants. As an Expert Site Reliability Engineer, you will own the reliability, availability, and performance of this growing global fleet. You are the team’s deepest technical authority on the on-premise platform, setting architecture and standards through hands-on expertise. You will own the hardware, network, operating system, and Kubernetes layers that power teams like Data, Machine Learning, and Software. Your Day-to-Day As an Individual Contributor on the expert track, your responsibilities center entirely on deep technical ownership and execution: Edge Infrastructure Ownership Own the reliability and lifecycle of our edge racks: server hardware, network equipment, custom Linux-based OS, and the GPU-enabled Kubernetes layer running our AI classification services. Design and improve automation for provisioning our growing fleet (50+ edge clusters and counting) using tools like Terraform, BMC/IPMI, and router APIs. Maintain the secure network connecting edge deployments to our central cloud, and the tooling that enables safe software delivery to the fleet. Reliability & Incident Management Participate in the rotation of support on weekdays and own triage and resolution for escalated production issues. Lead post-incident reviews and turn findings into lasting, automated fixes. Define and monitor SLOs/SLIs/SLAs for physical edge systems running unattended in the field. Extend our observability stack (Prometheus, custom hardware exporters, Grafana, Datadog) to catch issues proactively, often before customers notice. Architecture, Collaboration & Craft Set technical direction for edge infrastructure projects and contribute to technical planning and ticket writing. Mentor fellow engineers through pairing, design/code reviews, and knowledge sharing, raising the technical bar without formal management authority. Act as the top-level technical escalation point, personally helping resolve the most complex support and production issues. Collaborate with stakeholders (with the eventual support of a Product Manager) to gather requirements and manage technical alignment. Automate away repetitive manual work, applying the same rigor to internal tooling as to a customer-facing product. Your Experience and Skills Container Orchestration: Super proficient in maintaining Kubernetes on edge machines. Programming: Fluency in at least one modern language, such as Golang or Python . Monitoring : Deep understanding of concepts and tools such as Prometheus and Grafana. Terraform is a native language to you. Linux & Server Expertise: Deep proficiency in Linux-based systems and experience with server hardware , including components like RAID controllers BIOS, and Booting . DevOps: Good understanding of release systems and proficiency with GitOps tools like Argo CD. Security Management: Proficient in security concepts like certificate management (issuing, lifecycles, etc.) and secure network tunnels (e.g., IPSec/VPN). What Makes You Stand Out Holistic Data Center Engineering Expertise : Deep understanding of how to deal with low-level hardware like routers, switches, servers, BIOS, and TPM modules . Bare-Metal Automation : Proven experience designing and implementing automation for bare-metal infrastructure provisioning. Modern Kubernetes & CI/CD Architect : Moves beyond basic deployments to architecting sophisticated, automated, and resilient delivery pipelines using cutting-edge GitOps and Kubernetes-native tooling. Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Mastery : Expert-level proficiency with Terraform to build version-controlled, repeatable, and scalable environments. Behavioral competencies Strategic Thinker: You develop a clear vision and roadmap for the edge platform, considering its long-term health, scalability, and usability. Strong Communicator: You build strong relationships with development teams and other stakeholders, communicate changes clearly, and secure buy-in. High Ownership: You take end-to-end ownership of your technical output, including reliability, documentation, and continuous improvement. Data-Driven: You use metrics on uptime, incidents, and support requests to prioritize the work that delivers the most value. Customer-Focused: You keep developer and end-customer experience front of mind in your planning and execution. Fit to Our Values We Own Every Challenge: we enjoy complexity and thrive under uncertainty. We Strive for Better: we seize any opportunity for growth and challenge the status quo. We are constantly learning and improving. We Imagine New Frontiers: we think beyond “doable” and “reasonable”. We design a sustainable and healthy future together. What We Offer International Environment: Join a team with 40+ nationalities across 5 continents, all driven by a shared purpose: shedding light on the world’s toughest challenges. Comprehensive Benefits: Stock Options: Share in Orbem’s success. Relocation Support: Seamless support for your move to Germany. Learning & Development: €1,750 annual budget for personal growth. Fitness Membership: Access to Urban Sports Club or Wellpass. Childcare Reimbursement: Support for Kita/Kindergarten fees. Deutschland Ticket: Monthly subsidy towards public transportation costs. Work-Life Integration: Flexible Hours & Home Office: Work when and where it suits you. WFH Perks: Get €185 to upgrade your home office + an external monitor on us! 30 Days Paid Leave: Plenty of time to recharge. Personal Leave: Flexibility for life’s important moments. Work From Anywhere: Experience new cultures and environments for up to 60 days per year. Make a Difference: Join an ambitious, fast-growing team working on breakthrough technology. In our scale-up environment, you'll have the freedom to lead your projects and make an impact. We provide a platform for you to explore, innovate, and define your vision for the future. At Orbem, we're committed to helping you discover your strengths, and while we aim to teach you, we also want to learn from you. Your Team: You'll become part of our diverse and international team. Learn more about the team members, their work, and challenges here: https://orbem.ai/company/ At Orbem, we're committed to building a smart, diverse team, and we recognize that self-doubt can prevent talented individuals from applying. If you feel you don't meet every requirement, we'd love to hear from you anyway! title: Payments Risk Analyst
description: Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋 Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place! We’re looking for an experienced Payments Risk Analyst II based in Belfast to join our Global Risk team. In this role you will independently manage less-defined and more complex risk work while contributing to team projects and operational improvements. This role builds on Analyst I capability by recognising patterns, expanding findings, suggesting solutions, and applying sound judgement with minimal direction. What you’ll be doing: Reporting to the Risk Operations Lead, you will be responsible for daily monitoring within multiple risk queues along with various operational tasks including but not limited to: Manage complex transaction, merchant, onboarding, fraud, credit, and compliance cases across risk queues, owning end-to-end assessments using merchant,business, account, transaction, and other risk signals. Apply company, partner, supportability, and restricted-product policies to less-defined reviews with minimal direction, weighing competing factors and making sound decisions with imperfect information. Use reports, risk signals, case trends, operational data, and web-service tools to identify emerging threats, high-risk or suspicious activity, and opportunities for proactive mitigation. Balance portfolio protection and chargeback risk by assessing chargeback likelihood alongside the merchant’s capacity to repay. Resolve compliance violations and complex cases, identify material risks, escalate unresolved issues appropriately, and contribute to resolution and follow-up. Identify recurring issues, control gaps, and risk patterns across tools, workflows, queues, policies, and playbooks, and recommend practical improvements. Produce concise case summaries, findings, recommendations, and decision rationale; maintain accurate documentation and contribute to knowledge material, playbooks, and team learning. Lead complex customer communications and collaborate with Support, FS Merchant Services, Product, risk analysts, and other teams to resolve shared problems. Contribute to incidents, complex reviews, trend investigations, projects, process improvements, and team best practices while prioritising competing work effectively. What you need to bring: We are looking for a highly analytical and collaborative professional with experience within a relevant analyst role along with: 2 years of experience in payments, fraud, credit risk, compliance, or financial services operations or related discipline. Exposure to structured workflows, case management, queues, or service-level targets. Experience working with written procedures and maintaining accurate records. Interest in deepening existing knowledge on fraud, credit risk, merchant risk, and payments and suggesting improvements based on said knowledge. Knowledge of Card Scheme rules and regulations Understanding of the full Chargeback flow and process - Understanding chargeback risk timeframes. Strong working knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets Good conceptual thinking with proven analytic, problem-solving and effective reporting skills Experience managing structured case work with increasing complexity and limited direction. Ability to work independently and make decisions based on available information Ability to work in a dynamic fast-paced environment with tight deadlines We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try! What’s in it for you: Come live the Lightspeed Experience… Genuine career growth opportunities based on performance within a company that's continuously expanding Work with highly skilled people who are as passionate about Fraud & Risk as you are An environment that encourages initiatives and leadership Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact Fun activities with your teammates & social events throughout the year Opportunity to learn, expand your skill set, forge wonderful relationships and make your mark within the diverse and inclusive Lightspeed culture, a true Canadian tech success story … and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy and healthy: Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners) Flexible Paid Time Off - providing you the freedom to take time off however you like Private Medical Insurance and cash health plan for optical, dental and more. Health & Wellness Credit- expense up to 400 GBP per year towards your gym membership, yoga classes, a new bike or whatever else you do for your health Mental Health Support through the LifeWorks and Modern Health Apps- whether it is meditation, coaching or counselling you need - each employee gets access to this platform Time off to volunteer and give back to your community Transit / parking benefit - for when you need to travel to the Belfast office A variety of drinks & snacks in our offices in Belfast. To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Where to from here? Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here . Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs. Who we are: Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks. Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries. description: Principal Thermal Solutions Engineer – Paris/Grenoble About Vinci We are building Physics AI for hardware design. Our first product bridges the gap between the accuracy and determinism of traditional simulation and the speed and scaling of AI, and is redefining how the world's most advanced semiconductors are designed, verified, built, brought to market, and integrated into complex systems. Role Overview As a pivotal leader within our European technical sales team, you will drive the adoption of Vinci's platform among the region's top engineering organizations. In this strategic role, you will build, mentor, and guide a high-performing team of thermal engineers dedicated to engaging prospective customers and demonstrating the transformative value of our software. By acting as trusted technical advisors, you and your team will use deep simulation expertise to help enterprise customers validate and optimize complex, real-world designs. Through these collaborative engagements, you will champion Vinci's value proposition, showcasing how our platform delivers systemic improvements in thermal performance, product reliability, and accelerated time-to-market. Leveraging strong fundamentals in thermal physics and cooling strategies, you will guide analyses of complex thermal management systems, fluid flow dynamics, and heat dissipation challenges, including both steady-state and transient thermal behavior. Your team will help customers evaluate critical factors such as thermal risk, component reliability, power density, and cooling efficiency to architect cutting-edge thermal management systems for next-generation hardware. You will work closely with customer engineering teams to understand their technical challenges, provide expert guidance, and clearly articulate Vinci's capabilities in solving real-world problems. You will also serve as a key feedback channel to product and engineering teams, translating customer insights into actionable inputs that shape product direction and drive continuous improvement. This is a remote role, with close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Engineering in Palo Alto, CA, USA. The role includes moderate travel, primarily within continental Europe. Some infrequent intercontinental travel may be required for discussions and collaboration with the US team. Responsibilities Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of thermal engineers, setting the technical direction, hiring, mentoring team members, and driving field execution across Europe. Collaborate closely with the sales team to lead technical discussions, scope proof-of-concept (PoC) evaluations, and deliver compelling product demonstrations to prospective enterprise customers. Guide customer engineering teams through the evaluation phase by overseeing simulation setup, running complex test cases, and interpreting results to explicitly prove Vinci's technical and business value. Own customer enablement through onboarding, deployment pipeline, and account expansion, providing senior technical guidance, structured training sessions, and advanced troubleshooting. Provide product guidance and feedback, identify customer pain points and workflow bottlenecks, and partner directly with internal product and engineering teams to transform field feedback into critical new product features. Represent Vinci at major industry conferences and semiconductor events, engaging technically with key prospects and partners through technical presentations and live platform demonstrations. Maintain a strong understanding of competitive technologies, industry trends, and market positioning to communicate Vinci's differentiators effectively. Qualifications (Minimum Qualifications) Education: Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field. Technical depth: Expert-level mastery of commercial simulation software (Flotherm, Ansys Icepak/Fluent, Simcenter STAR-CCM+, or equivalent), with 15+ years of hands-on experience in thermal management and cooling solutions, either as a practitioner running simulations or as a technical account manager for commercial physics simulation software. Industry domain: Deep familiarity with semiconductor electronics packaging, advanced packaging technologies (e.g., 2.5D/3D IC), or foundry ecosystems. Customer engagement: Prior experience in dedicated customer-facing roles, with a strong ability to build trust and manage engineering client relationships. Automation & scripting: Practical programming experience using Python or C++ to automate workflows or parse simulation data. Leadership impact: Proven track record of prior managerial or technical leadership experience, with the ability to scale, mentor, and drive execution across engineering teams. Communication: Elite interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex physics and simulation results into clear, high-impact narratives for both deep technical panels and business-oriented executives. Preferred (Desirable Differentiators) Multiphysics breadth: Familiarity with structural mechanical simulations (FEA/stress) and/or Electrical Signal Integrity and Power Integrity (SI/PI) workflows. Commercial track record: Direct experience commercializing technical software, ideally electronic design automation (EDA) or CAE simulation tools, into major semiconductor and electronics enterprises. Go-to-market experience: Prior experience within technical pre-sales, application engineering (FAE), or strategic technical sales environments. Emerging tech adjacency: Ability to rapidly adopt and champion next-generation, physics-based workflows and AI-assisted design or simulation tools. Why Join Us Don't just use AI; help redefine how next-generation hardware is designed. Work at the convergence of state-of-the-art AI models, fundamental physics, and high-stakes enterprise engineering. Collaborate with world-class engineers and researchers in a fast-moving startup environment. À propos de Vinci Vinci développe une IA fondée sur la physique (Physics AI) pour la conception de systèmes hardware. Notre plateforme donne aux équipes de conception et de simulation des prédictions physiques précises, obtenues en une fraction du temps d'une simulation classique, et qui s'intègrent à leurs outils existants. C'est la première solution à offrir à la fois la rigueur de la simulation traditionnelle et la vitesse de l'IA. Elle transforme la façon dont les semi-conducteurs les plus avancés au monde sont conçus, vérifiés et mis en production. Présentation du poste En tant que membre clé de notre équipe européenne de Forward Deployment , vous jouerez un rôle déterminant dans l’adoption de la plateforme Vinci par les principales organisations d’ingénierie de la région. Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous constituerez, accompagnerez et dirigerez une équipe performante de spécialistes en ingénierie thermique, chargée d’accompagner nos clients et prospects et de démontrer concrètement la valeur de notre logiciel. En tant que référent technique de confiance auprès de nos clients , vous et votre équipe mettrez à profit votre expertise approfondie en simulation pour aider nos clients industriels à valider et optimiser des conceptions complexes dans des conditions représentatives de leurs applications réelles. À travers ces collaborations, vous démontrerez comment la plateforme Vinci permet d’améliorer les performances thermiques et la fiabilité des produits, tout en accélérant les cycles de conception et la mise sur le marché. Grâce à votre solide maîtrise de la physique thermique et des stratégies de refroidissement, vous guiderez l’analyse de systèmes complexes de gestion thermique, notamment les phénomènes de transfert de chaleur, d’écoulement des fluides et de dissipation thermique, en régime permanent comme transitoire. Votre équipe aidera les clients à évaluer des paramètres critiques tels que les risques thermiques, la fiabilité des composants, la densité de puissance et l’efficacité des solutions de refroidissement, afin de concevoir des systèmes de gestion thermique performants pour les équipements de nouvelle génération. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d’ingénierie de nos clients afin de comprendre leurs problématiques techniques, de leur apporter une expertise approfondie et de démontrer clairement comment Vinci peut répondre à leurs cas d’usage concrets. Vous jouerez également un rôle essentiel d’interface entre les clients et nos équipes Product et Engineering , en transformant les retours du terrain en informations exploitables pour orienter la feuille de route produit et contribuer à l’amélioration continue de la plateforme. Ce poste est basé en France et exercé en télétravail , avec une collaboration étroite avec les équipes Sales, Product et Engineering basées à Palo Alto, en Californie. Il implique des déplacements réguliers mais modérés, principalement en Europe continentale, ainsi que des déplacements occasionnels aux États-Unis pour collaborer avec l’équipe américaine Responsabilités Construire, diriger et développer une équipe performante d’ingénieur·es thermiques, en définissant l’orientation technique, en recrutant et accompagnant les membres de l’équipe, et en pilotant l’exécution sur le terrain à travers l’Europe. Collaborer étroitement avec l’équipe Sales pour diriger les discussions techniques, définir le périmètre des évaluations en proof-of-concept (PoC) et réaliser des démonstrations produits convaincantes auprès de clients industriels potentiels. Accompagner les équipes d’ingénierie des clients pendant la phase d’évaluation en supervisant la mise en place des simulations, l’exécution de cas de test complexes et l’interprétation des résultats afin de démontrer concrètement la valeur technique et business de Vinci. Piloter l’accompagnement technique des clients, notamment l’onboarding, le déploiement et l’expansion des comptes, en fournissant une expertise technique de haut niveau, des sessions de formation structurées et un support avancé pour la résolution des problèmes. Fournir des orientations et des retours sur le produit, identifier les difficultés rencontrées par les clients et les points de friction dans leurs workflows, et collaborer directement avec les équipes Produit et Engineering internes afin de transformer les retours du terrain en fonctionnalités produit clés. Représenter Vinci lors de grandes conférences industrielles et d’événements dédiés aux semi-conducteurs, en échangeant avec des prospects et partenaires stratégiques à travers des présentations techniques et des démonstrations en direct de la plateforme. Maintenir une excellente compréhension des technologies concurrentes, des tendances du secteur et du positionnement du marché afin de communiquer efficacement les éléments différenciants de Vinci. Qualifications (Qualifications minimales) Formation : Diplôme d'ingénieur ou équivalent (Master, doctorat) en génie mécanique, génie électrique ou dans un domaine technique étroitement lié. Expertise technique : Maîtrise approfondie de logiciels de simulation commerciaux (Flotherm, Ansys Icepak/Fluent, Simcenter STAR-CCM+ ou équivalent), avec plus de 15 ans d'expérience pratique en gestion thermique et solutions de refroidissement — que ce soit en réalisant vous-même des simulations ou dans une fonction de Technical Account Manager pour des logiciels commerciaux de simulation physique. Domaine industriel : Solide connaissance des technologies de packaging électronique pour les semi-conducteurs, des technologies de packaging avancé (par exemple, IC 2.5D/3D) ou des écosystèmes de fonderies. Relation client : Expérience préalable dans des fonctions directement orientées

title: Chief Information Security Officer
description: Make security the reason people trust Ockto Own security at the platform people use to share their most personal data Every day, people use Ockto to share their identity, income, assets and bank data: when they apply for a mortgage, rent a home or take out a lease. Banks and other large organisations choose Ockto partly because of the level of assurance we offer around that data. At Ockto, security is not a support function. It is part of the product and organisational culture. As our CISO, you make sure it stays that way as we grow. Part of that growth is adopting an AI driven operating model with strong guardrails. You own Ockto's security programme, from risk and controls to incidents, suppliers and audits. You set the standard, check that it is met, and make security measurable in a way that the whole organisation (and specifically our engineers and spec leads), clients, auditors and regulators all recognise. You do this with a real mandate and short lines to the people who decide. What you'll do You own the information security programme of a supervised financial company and make it work in daily practice, not just on paper. As CISO, you: Own Ockto's ISMS and security policy framework, and keep our ISO 27001 certification (held since 2017) and our SOC 2 assurance current and credible. Translate the risk appetite set by management into a security strategy, an annual plan and clear standards that teams can build to. Keep Ockto ahead of what's coming. You track developments such as eIDAS2 and the EU Digital Identity Wallet, NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act and the AI Act, assess what they mean for Ockto and our clients, and translate them into our security strategy and standards in time. Verify and challenge. Our engineering teams operate the technical controls; you check that they work and that findings get fixed. You approve risk acceptance for serious vulnerabilities and commission penetration tests. All control owners are challenged and prepared to show evidence and reproduce controls. Lead the response to security and privacy incidents, approve notifications to regulators, and make sure root causes lead to structural fixes. Manage security risk in our supply chain, from onboarding new suppliers to the annual review of critical ones, in line with DORA. Make sure our continuity and recovery arrangements are tested and hold up, together with Engineering. Make security measurable. We judge it by how quickly and how structurally we resolve what we find, not by counting incidents. Represent Ockto's security towards clients, auditors and supervisors: from a bank's due diligence questionnaire to our external audits and contact with DNB and AFM. Build a security-aware culture with an awareness programme people actually remember. Who you work with You report to our Product & Trust Director, who sets Ockto's trust framework and risk appetite. Within that framework, the security strategy and its execution are yours. On security matters you also have a direct line to our CEO, and you are involved early in the product and architecture decisions that shape our risk. Our Information Security Officer is part of your team and runs day-to-day control monitoring with you. You also work closely with our Engineering Director and the value stream teams that build and run the Ockto platform. They operate the technical controls as the first line; you set the requirements, verify and challenge as the second. Outside Ockto, you work with the security, risk and procurement teams of our clients and with our external auditors. For audits you are the first line of planning, execution and communication with the auditor(s). Together with the Product & Trust Director, you are Ockto's security contact for DNB and AFM. What you bring You combine depth in security with the judgement to apply it pragmatically in a scale-up. We're looking for someone who: • Has 8+ years of experience in information security, including at least 3 years leading a security function as CISO, Head of Security or similar. • Has run an ISMS end to end and taken an organisation through ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II audits. • Knows regulated financial services and works comfortably with DORA, PSD2, GDPR and supervision by DNB or AFM. • Has solid grounding in cloud security, preferably AWS, and enough technical understanding to challenge engineers and judge designs. • Thinks in risk: turns threats into priorities, and weighs security against cost and delivery speed. • Communicates clearly at every level, from the management team and auditors to developers and a client's security officer. • Is independent and principled: comfortable saying no, and good at finding the route to yes. • Speaks and writes English fluently; Dutch is a strong advantage. Will be a plus: • CISSP, CISM, CCSP or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor or Lead Implementer certification. • Experience with privacy governance and DPIAs. • Experience leading incident response, including notification to regulators. • Experience with third-party risk management and assurance reporting such as ISAE 3402 or ISAE 3000. • Familiarity with digital identity, eIDAS2 and EU digital identity wallets. • Experience governing the safe use of AI tooling in a data-sensitive environment. What you get You get a role with real influence on how far clients, supervisors and consumers can trust Ockto. • Ownership of security at a company where assurance is one of the reasons clients choose us. • A real mandate : a direct line to the CEO on security matters, a voice early in product and architecture decisions, and the final word on accepting serious security risk. • Influence on what we build next , as Ockto grows into new markets and propositions. • Short lines and room to shape the security function the way it should work. • Experienced colleagues across product, engineering and compliance. Ockto also offers: • A good salary: between €5500,- and €6800,- per month, depending on experience • Room and budget for personal and professional development • A MacBook Pro and smartphone of choice • Phone and travel allowance • Great home and remote working facilities • Lunch fee • Plenty of activities, including our annual ski trip, a 1.5-day team offsite, drinks and team outings You'll join a team that values diversity and collaboration, in a friendly, ambitious and innovative atmosphere. About Ockto Ockto is the leading platform for future-proof wallet services. For more than ten years we have been taking the friction out of sharing, verifying and enriching personal data, so that organisations and people can trust each other faster, based on the right information. From our office in Naarden, a team of specialists builds data-driven customer journeys that are right the first time. Ockto. Built for trust. Ready to join? Do you see yourself as our new CISO? title: Product Manager – Operations Systems (m/f/x)
description: Ready to become part of the most important mission on this planet? We are rebuy, pioneers in the sustainable reuse of electronics and media, and we are looking for you! Our mission: to make circular living accessible to all, one transaction at a time. By giving products a second chance, we reduce resource consumption and avoid unnecessary e-waste. Our global team of 500 drives things forward collaboratively, takes personal responsibility, values constructive critical thinking, and is dedicated to serving our customers and planet. The Role We are looking for a Product Manager to join our Product team and own the internal, backend-heavy products behind our operations. Every item rebuy sells has been through our hands. Before a pre-owned book, DVD, or game reaches a customer, it has been bought in, received, identified, tested, graded, stored, picked, packed, and shipped. The systems that run this flow are the focus of this team, and the users are the hundreds of colleagues in our operations teams. You will own the tools and services behind inbound processing, grading and quality control, fulfillment, and returns. Your users are warehouse operators, graders, pickers, and operations leads. Your customers are, in the end, every rebuy buyer and seller who relies on the condition and delivery promise we make. For this role we need someone who is genuinely detail-oriented, who reads the data before forming an opinion, who understands systems and data flows end-to-end, and who can translate operational reality into precise requirements and measurable outcomes. As a Product Manager you work hand in hand with operations leadership, team leads, engineering, and data to deliver measurable efficiency and quality improvements. You will spend time on the floor with the people who use your products, translate their goals and constraints into a roadmap you own, build the business case with unit economics together with operations and finance, and negotiate scope and timing with engineering. Improvements are co-created with the people who run the operation, not handed to them. Key Responsibilities: Drive domain product roadmap: Translate ops strategy (throughput, unit cost, quality, lead time) into a 6–12 month roadmap with the Strategy Manager and Ops Product Lead. Make and document trade-off decisions with ops leaders Understand operational reality: Spend time at the warehouse mapping processes and data flows end-to-end to uncover system gaps and unmet needs early Drive data-backed decisions: Analyze KPIs, pull data, avoid measurement traps, and connect feature changes to unit economics improvements Write precise requirements: Specify business rules, edge cases, data models, state transitions, integrations, and failure modes for engineering Ship iteratively without disruption: Sequence releases safely using pilots, feature flags, parallel runs, change management, and pre-defined metrics Collaborate across teams: Engage in technical discussions and manage scope, time, and urgency trade-offs with tech and ops leads Build stakeholder buy-in: Align ops, CS, tech, finance, and leadership on shared metrics via clear written communication Requirements: 3+ years of experience in product management , with a focus on backend, internal, workflow, or operational products (for example warehouse, logistics, supply chain, fulfillment, order management, inventory, marketplace operations, fintech back-office, or similar) Hands-on data skills : you can specifications covering business rules, edge cases, data models, and failure modes, and catching problems before they reach production Systems thinking : you can map a multi-step operational process and the data flowing through it, identify bottlenecks and inconsistencies, and reason about second-order effects of a change Experience collaborating with engineering on technical decisions, including integrations and data migrations, and negotiating scope and time-to-market trade-offs Clear, structured communication skills, written and verbal, with the ability to build buy-in with operations team leads, engineering, and product leadership Comfort using AI tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) to accelerate daily work such as analysis, writing, and prototyping Fluency in English and German Location: Berlin Hybrid model (Must be willing to have regular presence at our operations sites located in Rudow) Purpose, a great company culture and incredible benefits - what to expect at rebuy: Work with a friendly team that is passionate about circularity and wants to make the world a little more sustainable, one transaction at a time. Feel comfortable in an environment where independence and new ideas are welcome. Benefit from flat hierarchies and the greatest possible transparency so that things don't take longer than they have to and you always feel well informed. title: Afstuderen: Integratie van machine data voor resourceplanning
description: WAT GA JE DOEN? Bij onze internationale klanten wordt voor de dagelijkse productie gebruikgemaakt van verschillende LogicSteel software applicaties. LogicSteel MRP ondersteunt hierbij operationele processen, zoals het plannen van productie, het beheren van projecten, inkooporders en het aansturen van medewerkers. Daarnaast zijn er systemen zoals Insights die machine- en prestatiegegevens inzichtelijk maken. Doordat informatie verdeeld is over meerdere applicaties, ontbreekt vaak één centraal overzicht voor resourceplanning en capaciteitsbeslissingen. Tijdens deze afstudeeropdracht onderzoek je hoe relevante gegevens uit deze systemen beter gecombineerd en gepresenteerd kunnen worden, zodat gebruikers sneller de juiste inzichten hebben voor het plannen van mensen, machines en productiecapaciteit. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Het analyseren van het huidige resourceallocatieproces en de rol van machine- en productiegegevens hierin; Het voeren van interviews met gebruikers om hun doelen, behoeften en knelpunten in kaart te brengen; Het onderzoeken welke data uit Insights en MRP relevant is voor besluitvorming; Het analyseren van gebruikersstromen, beschikbare data en bestaande schermen; Het ontwikkelen van wireframes, gebruikersflows en ontwerpconcepten; Het valideren en verbeteren van ontwerpen door middel van feedbacksessies met gebruikers en stakeholders; Het vertalen van gebruikersbehoeften naar functionele requirements; Het opstellen van een advies voor de integratie en presentatie van machinegegevens over verschillende platformen. Het eindresultaat is een onderbouwd ontwerp- en implementatievoorstel waarmee gebruikers sneller en beter onderbouwde beslissingen kunnen nemen op het gebied van resourceplanning en machinebezetting. WIJ VRAGEN HBO- of WO-opleiding in de richting van UI/UX Design, Human Computer Interaction, Interaction Technology of vergelijkbaar. WIJ BIEDEN Een vergoeding: €600,- per maand; Reiskostenvergoeding: zodat jij geen onnodige kosten maakt; Apparatuur en materialen: bijvoorbeeld een laptop, speciaal gereedschap of software; Ervaren coach: goede begeleiding is belangrijk en dus krijg je een vaste coach om je te ondersteunen; Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Met een team van meer dan 750 collega’s wereldwijd ontwikkelen en bouwen we niet alleen high-end machines, maar ook slimme software en service waarop klanten kunnen vertrouwen. title: Senior Solutions Architect
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.</p></div><p><strong>The Role:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"><br></span></p> <p>Every Celonis outcome starts with data. As a Solutions Architect, you make sure our customers’ data gets into the Celonis Platform reliably, securely, and at scale, and that insights and actions flow back out into the systems and AI tools where work actually happens.</p> <p>You’ll join our customer project teams as one of the first technical faces of Celonis. You’ll work hands-on across the full integration toolkit: deploying our out-of-the-box extractors, building custom API connectors in a low-code environment, writing code for push-based ingestion, connecting Celonis to customer lakehouses and LLMs, and configuring writebacks, SSO, and user provisioning. Part implementation consultant, part integration engineer, part trusted technical advisor, this role is ideal for someone early in their career who wants broad exposure to enterprise architecture and modern data and AI integration patterns.</p> <p><strong>The work you’ll do:</strong></p> <p><strong>Data integration and ingestion:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Implement standard extractors. </strong>Install, configure, and troubleshoot Celonis out-of-the-box extractors in customer landscapes, including SAP (ECC and S/4HANA), JDBC-based databases, and cloud applications such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, and others.</li> <li><strong>Build custom API connectors. </strong>Design and build custom connectors with Celonis Extractor Builder for source systems that expose data through REST or SOAP APIs, handling authentication (OAuth 2.0, API keys, certificates), pagination, rate limits, and incremental (delta) loads.</li> <li><strong>Enable push-based ingestion. </strong>Help customers design and develop scripts and pipelines (typically in Python) that push data to Celonis via the Data Ingestion API, and advise on file formats, scheduling, and error handling.</li> <li><strong>Connect to the lakehouse. </strong>Set up zero-copy data sharing between Celonis and customer lakehouses such as Databricks and Microsoft Fabric, including Delta Sharing configuration, access controls, and data freshness.</li> <li><strong>Unblock infrastructure. </strong>Work through on-premise agent deployments, networking, proxies, firewall and IP allowlisting, certificates, and service-account permissions with customer IT and infrastructure teams.</li> <li><strong>Keep pipelines healthy. </strong>Tune extraction schedules and delta strategies, monitor pipeline health, and resolve data load failures so customers get timely, trustworthy data.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Actions, AI, and platform connectivity:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Close the loop with writebacks. </strong>Configure Action Flows and other integration patterns that write back to customer systems (for example, updating records in SAP, Salesforce, or ticketing tools) so Celonis insights turn into action.</li> <li><strong>Connect Celonis to AI. </strong>Help customers connect Celonis to their LLMs and AI agents through MCP (Model Context Protocol), covering authentication, permissions, and governance.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Identity, security, and governance:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Own authentication and provisioning. </strong>Configure SSO (SAML, OIDC) with identity providers such as Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, and Ping, and set up SCIM-based user and group provisioning.</li> <li><strong>Be the security translator. </strong>Support customer security, privacy, and compliance reviews, explain the Celonis architecture and data flows, and advise on topics like data minimization, pseudonymization, and least-privilege access.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Customer and team impact:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Scope with confidence. </strong>Run technical discovery, document integration architectures and requirements, and estimate effort so projects start on solid footing.</li> <li><strong>Partner across teams. </strong>Serve as a technical point of contact for customer IT, data, and security stakeholders, and work closely with Value Engineers, Data Engineers, Project Managers, Partners, Support, and Product & Engineering.</li> <li><strong>Be the voice of the field. </strong>Escalate product gaps and bugs with clear, reproducible detail, and share field feedback that shapes our integration roadmap.</li> <li><strong>Build reusable assets. </strong>Contribute reusable connector templates, scripts, runbooks, and best-practice documentation that scale across customers and partners.</li> </ul> <p><strong>The qualifications you need:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in a technical, customer-facing role such as solutions engineering, integration or implementation consulting, data engineering, or technical consulting.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with REST APIs and common authentication patterns (OAuth 2.0, API keys, tokens); comfort using tools like Postman to explore and test APIs.</li> <li>Solid programming skills in Python (or a similar language) and strong SQL skills.</li> <li>Working knowledge of data pipelines and ETL/ELT concepts, including incremental loads, scheduling, and handling large data volumes.</li> <li>Familiarity with identity and access management concepts such as SSO (SAML/OIDC) and SCIM provisioning.</li> <li>A basic understanding of networking and security fundamentals (TLS and certificates, proxies, firewalls, VPNs).</li> <li>The ability to explain technical topics clearly to both engineers and business stakeholders, and to manage your own workstreams across multiple customer projects.</li> <li>Curiosity, ownership, and a bias toward solving problems hands-on.</li> <li>A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with SAP data structures, tables, or extraction (for example, RFC, ODP, or S/4HANA).</li> <li>Experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP) and/or lakehouse platforms such as Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, or Snowflake.</li> <li>Exposure to iPaaS or low-code integration tools (for example, MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, or Power Automate).</li> <li>Familiarity with LLMs, AI agents, or MCP.</li> <li>Experience with Docker or Linux server administration.</li> <li>Relevant certifications (for example, Celonis, cloud, or SAP certifications).</li> </ul><div description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Anthropic</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p></div><h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>As an Enterprise Account Executive at Anthropic, you'll join the foundational team at the forefront of introducing our cutting-edge AI productivity API and SaaS solutions to retail organisations across France. You'll drive the adoption of safe, frontier AI by securing strategic deals with retail, grocery, fashion, and e-commerce companies. By driving deployment of Anthropic's emerging products, you will help enterprises obtain new capabilities while also advancing the ethical development of AI.</p> <h2><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Win new business and drive revenue for Anthropic within the retail sector. You feel strongly about ensuring frontier AI systems are developed safely and ethically for retail use</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>À propos du poste</strong></h2> <p>En tant qu'Enterprise Account Executive chez Anthropic, vous rejoindrez l'équipe fondatrice chargée de faire découvrir notre API de productivité IA de pointe et nos solutions SaaS aux entreprises du secteur de la distribution et du commerce en France. title: Field Marketing Manager, EMEA
description: <p><strong>About SiTime</strong></p> <p>SiTime is the Precision Timing company.</p> <p>Timing is the heartbeat of all electronics, ensuring performance, resilience and scalability. For decades, quartz devices, non-silicon technology, have kept systems in sync, but they struggle in harsher, more demanding environments. MEMS-based Precision Timing delivers greater accuracy, smaller size and resilience. Today, MEMS timing powers over 400 applications, including high-growth ones in AI datacenters, automated driving, industrial and humanoid robots, wearables and IoT.</p> <p>Our semiconductor MEMS programmable solutions offer a rich feature set that enables customers to differentiate their products with higher performance, smaller size, lower power, and better reliability. With more than 4 billion devices shipped, SiTime is changing the timing industry.
