title: Staff Engineer, EU Infrastructure
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">About Wolt</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.<br><br>Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.</span></p></div><h2>About the Team</h2> <p>Our Infrastructure teams build the foundation that engineers at Wolt, Deliveroo, and DoorDash build on: the compute, cloud, and networking capabilities that enable Engineering teams to develop, deploy, and run services at global scale. The EU Compute team has a specific focus on provisioning, scaling, and the efficient operation of GPU infrastructure for AI and ML workloads. This is an emerging space with plenty of greenfield opportunities.</p> <p>We're looking for a Staff Engineer to be a hands-on technical leader for this infrastructure work that crosses team and brand boundaries. You'll set direction for the platform, turn complex problems into deliverable plans, write and review production code, and help other engineers make sound decisions. It's an exciting time to join: we're building a global platform and the choices made now will shape how engineers across the company ship for years.</p> <h2>What you’ll be doing</h2> <p>You'll own some of the hardest infrastructure problems in the company and make the platform easier to operate and safer to build on. We’re determined to build great platform products and user experiences, and you’ll be pivotal in making this reality.</p> <h3>Day-to-day in this role you’ll:</h3> <ul> <li>Set technical direction for shared AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure, balancing reliability, security, developer experience, and cost.</li> <li>Lead substantial initiatives from design through rollout and operation, coordinating dependencies and decisions across Wolt, Deliveroo and DoorDash, focusing on workloads targeting GPUs.</li> <li>Evolve Kubernetes clusters, cloud networking, identity, and infrastructure provisioning to support growing and varied workloads.</li> <li>Build reusable Terraform patterns and self-service tooling that help teams provision infrastructure safely and consistently.</li> <li>Improve deployment and operational practices, including GitOps, observability, capacity planning, incident response and recovery.</li> <li>Use production signals and developer feedback to find platform friction, choose where to invest and measure whether changes actually help.</li> <li>Assist with supporting the platform, with deep focus on GPU infrastructure, as well as broad focus on compute in general.</li> <li>Gracefully sunset legacy infrastructure and tooling, and create strategies to reduce toil.</li> <li>Mentor engineers through design reviews, implementation and incidents, raising the quality of infrastructure work across teams.</li> </ul> <h2>Our humble expectations</h2> <ul> <li>Deep experience building and operating Kubernetes and AWS infrastructure in production. Familiarity with GPU workloads and orchestration is a plus.</li> <li>Strong software engineering skills: you use Go, Python or a similar language to build maintainable tools and automation.</li> <li>Experience with infrastructure as code (we use Terraform) and with designing systems that other engineering teams depend on.</li> <li>A track record of leading complex technical work across teams, including architectural decisions, delivery, and operational follow-through. You have the breadth to collaborate and design across team and domain boundaries, and the depth to have hands-on impact.</li> <li>Strong judgment on trade-offs in distributed systems, networking, security, reliability, and cloud cost.</li> <li>Clear communication, and the ability to bring people together around a practical technical direction.</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Scope and influence.</strong> Shape infrastructure used globally, while staying close to the engineering. Your work will help product teams ship services with greater ease and confidence.</li> <li><strong>Real problems at global scale.</strong> Multi-cluster Kubernetes, AI / ML workloads, cloud networking, GitOps, and progressive delivery across a global company.</li> <li><strong>Autonomy and ownership.</strong> Set direction and see it through from design to operation, with the backing of a global engineering organisation spanning Europe and the US.</li> <li><strong>Growth.</strong> Room to expand your scope, whether through deeper technical leadership or broader cross-domain influence.</li> <li><strong>Great people.</strong> Work with talented engineers and leaders in a diverse, international environment, mentoring and learning from others.</li> </ul> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/GoL541_xj9w" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.</span></p> <p><em>Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at <span class="_80om1qgj _1e0c1nu9" data-testid="smart-link-draggable-inline"><span class="loader-wrapper"><span class="hover-card-trigger-wrapper" data-testid="hover-card-trigger-wrapper"><a class="_1yt4x7n9 _2rko1ssi _v56415x0 _1e0c1nu9 _16d9qvcn _syaz13af _1rkwglyw _4cvx1w55 _19itia51 _bfhkhp5a _1a3b18uv _4fprglyw _5goinqa1 _9oik18uv _1bnxglyw _jf4cnqa1 _1nrm18uv _c2waglyw _1iohnqa1 _uizt1kdv _nt751r31 _49pcglyw _1hvw1o36 _1372tlke _7ehiw5lj _1j5pglyw _1di615s3" href="https://careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness" data-testid="inline-card-resolved-view"><span class="_19itglyw _vchhusvi _r06hglyw _o5721jtm _1nmz9jpi _16d9qvcn _ca0qv77o _u5f31b66 _n3tdv77o _19bv1b66" data-testid="inline-card-icon-and-title"><span class="_19itglyw _vchhusvi _r06hglyw">Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash</span></span></a></span></span></span> .</em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Front-End Engineer (React) - Personalization
description: <h2>In a nutshell</h2> <p>At Picnic, we're revolutionising the way people buy groceries with our affordable and sustainable grocery service. In the Personalization team, you’ll build the experimentation platform that lets Picnic try new ideas safely and at scale: from which promotions to highlight to which emails to send. Your work lets business teams run experiments and control the customer experience themselves, without needing an engineer for every change. It’s a product that is foundational to our business, and it directly improves how customers shop every day. <br>We use React, React Native and TypeScript across the board, together with <span style="text-decoration: underline;"><a href="https://blog.picnic.nl/faster-features-happier-customers-introducing-the-platform-that-transformed-our-grocery-app-b38e57a85531" target="_blank">our server-driven UI framework</a>,</span> and we’re working towards a single platform for mobile and web. </p> <h2>Tricks of the trade</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Think like a product owner.</strong> You don’t just implement requirements, you question them. Together with product owners and designers, you shape specifications for new features, discuss trade-offs, push back when something doesn’t add up, and help build a long-term vision for where the platform should go.</li> <li><strong>Build bridges.</strong> You work with cross-functional teams across the whole business: the business teams who rely on the platform, fellow engineers, and the other consumer-facing teams whose features run through it. You make it easy for others to succeed.</li> <li><strong>Drive things forward.</strong> You don’t wait for someone to hand you the next task. You spot what could be better, in the codebase, the platform or how the team works, and you take the lead on fixing it. You’ll take on increasingly challenging projects with full ownership of your contributions.</li> <li><strong>Our Tech:</strong> React, React Native, TypeScript and RxJS, Redux, Styled Components, Jest, Storybook</li> </ul> <p>If you want ownership, real influence on product direction, and to see your work reach millions of customers, you’ll feel at home here.</p> <h2>We’re looking for</h2> <ul> <li>7+ years of building and shipping frontend applications end-to-end. You’ve taken products from idea to millions of users, and you’ve stayed around to make them better.</li> <li>A strong conceptual thinker. You thrive in ambiguity and lead the way to the right solution.</li> <li>Sharp judgement on trade-offs. You know when to build it right and when to ship it now, and you make that call yourself.</li> <li>Real curiosity about the customer. You care whether your work changes how people shop, not just whether the code is clean.</li> <li>Clear, structured communicator. You collaborate effectively with product, design, backend, analytics, and frontend teams.</li> <li>Genuine motivation to build consumer and e-commerce experiences used by millions, with willingness to work from<strong class="text-green1 list-item-text"> Picnic’s Amsterdam office-first environment</strong>.</li> </ul> <h2>Picnic Perks</h2> <p>✍🏼Every expert was once a beginner! </p> <p>You’ll get plenty of opportunities to challenge yourself and grow, including the Picnic Tech Academy, Lunch & Learn sessions, and tailored soft skills training. Coffee snob? Don’t worry, our amazing Picnic barista has you covered.</p> <p>🚴🏽Stay healthy </p> <p>Mental health is important. As well as having the option to speak with Picnic colleagues who act as confidential advisors, our collaboration with OpenUp gives you easy access to professional psychologists, along with workshops and materials. </p> <p>There are plenty of sports communities and events to get involved with, from tennis to yoga, to climbing! </p> <p>🔋Attractive package</p> <p>We offer competitive compensation and a pension plan that looks out for your future self, as well as 25 vacation days per year, so you can recharge your batteries </p> <p>🌍Benefits for expats </p> <p>It can be daunting starting a new job AND moving to a new country. That’s why we offer lots of support for our many expat colleagues, if you want to find our relocation benefits, see<a href="https://jobs.picnic.app/en/relocation"> here</a>.</p> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Sr Agent Architect (France)
description: <h2><strong>About Parloa</strong></h2> <p>Parloa’s mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience - one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.</p> <h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>As a <strong>Sr Agent Architect</strong> at Parloa, you will act as a solution architect for enterprise AI Agent deployments. You will design end-to-end system architectures that connect Parloa's platform to complex enterprise environments, solve multi-system integration challenges, and apply systems thinking to build reliable, scalable AI solutions for global enterprise clients.</p> <p>You will also shape the conversational experience layer, using prompt engineering and your knowledge of LLMs to translate customer requirements into agent behavior. Architecture and integration depth are the core of this role. Conversational design skills are valued and can be developed on the job.</p> <h2><strong>Areas of ownership</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Design end-to-end solution architectures for AI Agent deployments, the expertise of the Agent Architect team.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <ul> <li>3+ years of experience in enterprise customer-facing roles, with proven expertise in solution transformation and field mapping logic.</li> <li>Analytical and critical thinker with expertise in risk assessment and problem-solving.</li> <li>Strong project and stakeholder management skills, with a passion for meeting milestones and effective communication.</li> <li>Entrepreneurial mindset with initiative, results orientation, and ability to identify opportunities for impact.</li> <li>Ability to analyze customer requirements and translate them into LLM prompts and conversational flows, with attention to subtle conversational nuance and A/B testing to assess agent performance. </li> <li>Prior conversation design, prompt engineering (e.g., chain-of-thought, few-shot learning), or A/B testing experience is a plus, not a requirement - we will train this.</li> <li>Fluency in French and English is required</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Our Recruiting Process:</strong></h2> <p>Talent Acquisition → Hiring Manager → Technical Interview(s) → Bar Raiser</p> <h3 class="text-text-100 mt-3 -mb-1 text-[1.125rem] font-bold">Why Parloa?</h3> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">We're at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn't just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We're building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren't just support tickets; they're defining experiences. We're here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments, this is where you do it.</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">At Parloa, ownership isn't a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that's evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">We've grown beyond the earliest startup phase, but we've kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">Backed by leading global investors like General Catalyst, EQT Ventures, and Altimeter Capital, we're scaling with a clear ambition: to become the global category leader in enterprise-grade conversational AI.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><iframe style="display: table; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/P4d-iyx7RQM" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p> <p> </p> <hr> <p>Parloa is committed to upholding the highest data protection standards for our clients' and employees' data. All our employees are instrumental in ensuring the utmost care, GDPR, and ISO compliance, including ISO 27001, in handling sensitive information.</p> <p>Parloa is an e-verify employer in the USA. <a class="c-link" href="https://www.e-verify.gov/about-e-verify/what-is-e-verify" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.e-verify.gov/about-e-verify/what-is-e-verify" data-sk="tooltip_parent">Please click here to learn more</a>.</p> <p><strong>* </strong><strong>We provide equal opportunities to all qualified applicants regardless race, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, national origin, disability status, socioeconomic background and other characteristics.</strong></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Technical Programme Manager, Systems Software
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About IonQ: </strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2F&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=IonQ%2C+Inc&index=7&md5=0818ffbedc6dbad8c4d1611ac94c2a0f" target="_blank">IonQ, Inc</a></u>. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including <u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=Amazon+Web+Services%2C&index=8&md5=a7f94ee9b71a392dca3cd6c413722e51" target="_blank">Amazon Web Services, </a></u><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=and&index=9&md5=2bed627b388878763f41ffe0e4edb16c" target="_blank">and </a></u><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=AstraZeneca&index=10&md5=757c1f2c2ec94cf3982700106122164f" target="_blank">AstraZeneca</a></u> achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, <u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-achieves-landmark-result-setting-new-world-record-in-quantum-computing&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=setting+a+world+record+in+quantum+computing+performance&index=11&md5=32e9cb88afbd439026a352666cc72c91" target="_blank">setting a world record in quantum computing performance</a></u>.<br><br>Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  </p></div><p><strong>Role:</strong></p> <p>System Software builds the software that runs IonQ's quantum computers: the runtime, orchestration, quantum tools, controllers and transport software that sit between the Quantum Operating System and the hardware. It is where a next-generation system either comes together or doesn't.</p> <p>We're hiring a Staff Technical Programme Manager to lead delivery across this stack. You'll report to the Group Program Manager, Software in our Programme Management Office and be matrixed to the VP, Software for day-to-day work.</p> <p>You'll work across five engineering teams (runtime, orchestration, quantum tools, controllers and transport) and the interfaces between them and their cross-functional stakeholders, serving several next-generation system programmes at once, with hardware being co-developed alongside the software and teams in both Oxford and the US. Those programmes draw on the same engineers, so the central problem of this role is making sure that capacity is spent by decision, not by default.</p> <p>We run a centralised PMO model. This role will not own engineering headcount or define product but it will make the programme around those things run. It carries real ownership of delivery: the plan, the trade-offs put in front of decision-makers, and the honesty of the status. In this role you will interface with everyone from technical software engineers to a wide range of the most senior stakeholders. You will also coordinate with your fellow programme managers, across Science, Infrastructure and broader Software teams, making sure all plans are shared and coordinated, rather than operating in silos.</p> <p>Turning a research-grade quantum system into a dependable product is a problem nobody has finished solving, and the delivery standard you'll work within is being built now. If writing the first version of the plan sounds like the interesting part, we should talk.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <p>In this role you will own the end-to-end delivery of the Systems Software roadmap across several concurrent programmes including managing dependencies between hardware, science and systems integration teams. You will partner closely with engineering leadership, the engineering teams run the day to day planning and boards, you will provide the direction that creates incremental milestones that ship.</p> <p>You will identify risks and blockers early and work with the teams to resolve them. You will also run intake and triage, so requests reach the right team with the right priority and engineers can stay focused on planned work.</p> <p>Key responsibilities include:</p> <ul> <li> <p>Make contention visible: when two programmes need the same team in the same quarter, bring it to the right decision-maker with the options and a recommendation before it becomes a slip.</p> </li> <li> <p>Keep the systems of record honest. Requirements, plans, schedules and Jira drift apart; you'll close the gap and automate the checking.</p> </li> <li> <p>Make invisible work visible: on-call load, sustaining work and technical debt tracked as rigorously as feature delivery.</p> </li> <li> <p>Surface risks early, before you have a full solution or complete alignment. We'd rather hear it messy and on time.</p> </li> <li> <p>Run intake and triage so requests reach the right team, with priority set by the people who own it, and engineers stay on planned work.</p> </li> <li> <p>Work hand in hand with the Quantum Systems Infrastructure and Science TPMs in Oxford and the Software TPMs in the US: shared processes where teams meet, and no duplicated ceremonies, boards or reports.</p> </li> <li> <p>Write concise, plain-English status on progress, risks and decisions for programme directors, engineering leaders and senior leadership.</p> </li> <li> <p>Help shape how IonQ runs software delivery across sites, working with the Group Program Manager, Software on the shared delivery standard.</p> </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p> <p>You will have significant experience running technical programmes across several software teams, ideally in systems, embedded, compiler or platform software. You can discuss scope and trade-offs directly with engineering leads, read and reason about code, and re-plan when a timeline is no longer realistic. You will have a track record of leading teams through genuine ambiguity, writing the first version of the plan when there isn't one, not just executing a defined one.</p> <p>You can break broad problems down into specific, assignable actions, and you have designed a team's operating cadence before. No quantum background is needed. Experience of software that works closely with hardware, for example in labs, robotics, aerospace or scientific instruments, would be beneficial.</p> <p>You’d be a great fit with:</p> <ul> <li> <p>A habit of turning diffuse problems into specific, minimal, assignable asks.</p> </li> <li> <p>Technical fluency to engage engineering leads directly on scope and trade-offs, and comfort reading and reasoning about code.</p> </li> <li> <p>Willingness to re-baseline against reality rather than defend dates that have stopped being true, and the judgement to tell a target that motivates from one that just generates fiction.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with software that works closely with hardware: labs, robotics, aerospace, scientific instruments or similar.</p> </li> <li> <p>A chase-without-nagging, escalate-without-drama style, and a clear sense of the difference between a risk and a noise.</p> </li> <li> <p>AI as a core part of how you work, for example agent-driven tracking, reconciliation or reporting.</p> </li> <li> <p>Clear, concise written and verbal communication with both technical and senior stakeholders.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Additional desirable skills include capacity and staffing modelling, designing operating cadences and experience leading work across sites and time zones. Experience working with programmes and systems such as Jira, Confluence and GitHub, with a preference for lightweight processes, is also helpful.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About IonQ: </strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2F&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=IonQ%2C+Inc&index=7&md5=0818ffbedc6dbad8c4d1611ac94c2a0f" target="_blank">IonQ, Inc</a></u>. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  </p></div><p><strong>Location:</strong> This role will work onsite at our office located in Oxford, England (UK).<br><strong>Job ID:</strong> 1948</p> <p><strong>The Role: <br></strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Receiving Inspector to join our Quality team. As a Senior Receiving Inspector, you’ll be part of a cross-functional team whose mission is to lead IonQ on its journey to build the world’s best quantum computers to solve the world’s most complex problems. </p> <p>You will make sure that incoming, in-process and finished components meet their mechanical, electrical and PCBA specifications. You will also own the inspection side of the Material Review Board process, from handling and containing nonconforming material, through the inspection actions the board assigns, to verifying, closing and tracking nonconformance records once the Quality Engineer has given the disposition. As the senior technical resource for inspection, you will allocate the daily inspection work and guide less experienced inspectors. The ideal candidate combines technical expertise with the integrity to hold quality standards under production pressure.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong>:</p> <p>Day to day, you will inspect incoming parts, in-process production and finished goods against approved specifications, drawings and purchase order requirements, deciding the inspection method and sequence with little instruction. You will interpret drawing callouts and datum structures to GD&T and ASME Y14.5, turn them into inspection plans and acceptance criteria, apply statistical sampling plans and use the right metrology instruments, including programming and running CMM, OMM or vision systems. You will support the calibration schedule, remove out of tolerance equipment from service and keep the inspection area to the local 5S procedure.</p> <p>When something is wrong, you will control it. You will carry out the actions the board assigns, verify scrap disposal so nothing returns to the supply chain, and feed inspection data to the Quality Engineer for root cause analysis and supplier corrective action. You will also support internal, customer and regulatory audits, and keep to the quality management system, export control and customer contract requirements for controlled material and data.</p> <p>Key responsibilities include: </p> <ul> <li>Leading daily inspection of incoming, in-process and finished goods, including allocating the workload and verifying other inspectors' results and records before release</li> <li>Writing nonconformance records, presenting inspection evidence at the Material Review Board and completing assigned actions such as screening, sorting and rework verification</li> <li>Verifying and closing nonconformance records against the Quality Engineer's disposition, and keeping the MRB log and ageing report up to date</li> <li>Drafting and releasing inspection procedures and work instructions, and reporting metrics such as first pass yield, defect Pareto, NCR ageing and inspection turnaround</li> <li>Working with engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and suppliers on source inspection, first article inspection and quality problems</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p> <p>You will bring six or more years of related experience in a regulated manufacturing environment, including proven PCBA inspection to IPC-A-610 and experience of aerospace inspection processes and standards. You will have hands-on experience of controlling nonconforming product and of the Material Review Board process, and of using a Quality Management System or ERP nonconformance module to raise, track and close records and actions.</p> <p><br>You read and interpret complex technical drawings with a thorough understanding of datum structures to ASME Y14.5, and you are expert with layout tools such as surface plates, height gauges, indicators, callipers, micrometers, gauge blocks and thread gauges. You have allocated work to, trained and guided less experienced inspectors, and you are confident with standard office software for data analysis and documentation. The role involves lifting up to 18 kg and standing for long periods, with strict adherence to safety and PPE requirements.</p> <p><br>You’d be a great fit with:</p> <ul> <li>Clear communication at every level, from management to engineers and physicists, when resolving complex quality issues</li> <li>Working knowledge of root cause analysis methods such as 5 Why, Ishikawa or 8D</li> <li>Experience of first article inspection to AS9102 and of source inspection at supplier sites</li> <li>An ASQ Certified Quality Inspector or Certified Quality Technician qualification, or equivalent</li> <li>A quality first, self-starting approach, with precision under pressure and a willingness to support other quality functions</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. description: <p><strong>Senior Product Manager - Retrieval | Storage, Peripherals & Retrieval | Hybrid Working | Hatfield</strong><strong><br></strong><strong><br></strong><strong>About Us</strong></p> <p>We are Ocado Group and we're bringing world-class automation to online grocery. Our Ocado Smart Platform (OSP) combines cutting-edge robotics, AI and IoT within our advanced CFCs (Customer Fulfilment Centres). We've mastered the single pick, transforming online delivery for our global partners. Join us and be part of a team pushing the boundaries of retail technology.</p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>Storage, Peripherals & Retrieval is the product area behind the automated systems at the heart of Ocado's automated warehouses: the grid, the peripherals and the bots that run on it. Our mission is to develop the world's leading ASRS: highly cost-competitive, reliable, easy to launch and support and suitable for diverse global use cases.</p> <p>As the Senior Product Manager for Retrieval, you will own the product strategy and roadmap for our bot, battery and charger fleet. Retrieval is the core driver of grid movement - bots transport stock and customer orders between grid locations, stations and ports, meaning every customer order depends on their availability, reliability and cost-effectiveness.</p> <p>Operating at the intersection of hardware, firmware, wireless and cloud software, you will lead a critical product domain where even a small change to a bot scales across every operational site globally. You will collaborate closely with mechanical, mechatronics, firmware, wireless and cloud engineering teams, as well as manufacturing and field support teams, driving complex problem-solving and cross-domain alignment.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Product Vision & Strategy:</strong> Shape and execute the product vision for complex initiatives across the bot, battery and charger domain, balancing short- and long-term goals to lower Capex, Opex and lead time.</li> <li><strong>Commercial & Data Leadership:</strong> Define key domain metrics connected directly to business outcomes. Manage financial rationale, balance KPI impacts and make informed Build vs. Buy decisions.</li> <li><strong>Execution & Problem Solving:</strong> Lead discovery and problem-solving across cross-functional teams, setting high standards for scoping, requirements and data-driven hypothesis testing.</li> <li><strong>Product Adoption & Scale:</strong> Build adoption metrics into domain capabilities, monitor usage across customer segments and collaborate with Solutions, Partner Growth and Partner Success teams to drive global rollout.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholder Management & Evangelism:</strong> Manage relationships across engineering crafts, leadership levels and external partners. Articulate complex technical decisions clearly and build strong buy-in.</li> <li><strong>Domain Expertise & Leadership:</strong> Serve as the recognized go-to expert for Retrieval, providing strategic guidance, mentoring surrounding PMs and stepping into leadership moments for the Product Director when needed.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We’re Looking For</strong></p> <ul> <li>Substantial, battle-tested product management experience owning end-to-end product lifecycles for complex engineering products shipped at scale.</li> <li>Proven track record of leading product discovery, setting product strategy in uncertain environments and making high-impact strategic trade-offs.</li> <li>Strong experience building product roadmaps alongside Design and Engineering peers, owning the business case and ROI.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across Engineering, UX, Data, delivery teams and external partners or clients.</li> <li>Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment and deliver on commitments.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to Haves</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with products that combine hardware and software (e.g., robotics, connected devices or industrial automation).</li> <li>Experience mentoring or coaching other Product Managers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>We believe in supporting our people with meaningful, flexible benefits that prioritise well-being and work-life balance. We are committed to making reasonable adjustments to provide a positive, barrier-free recruitment process and supportive work environment. title: Senior Bilanzbuchhalter*in (m/w/d)
description: Werde Teil unseres Teams Apaleo ist die offene Hospitality-Plattform, die Hotels die Freiheit gibt, ihre Technologie so zusammenzustellen, wie sie sie wirklich brauchen. Du arbeitest eng mit externen Steuerberater*innen und Wirtschaftsprüfer*innen zusammen. Du gestaltest mit, wie sich unser Finance-Tech-Stack mittelfristig zu einem AI-native Accounting- und ERP-Setup entwickelt: von Tool-Auswahl und Datenmodell über saubere Stammdaten und Schnittstellen bis zu skalierbaren End-to-End-Prozessen, die mit uns mitwachsen. Sehr gute DATEV- und Excel-Kenntnisse sowie ein ausgeprägtes Prozess- und Systemverständnis: Du denkst in Datenflüssen, nicht in Einzelbuchungen. Erfahrung mit Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen unter echtem Zeit- und Deadlinedruck im Unternehmen. Nahezu muttersprachliches Deutsch (für die Kommunikation mit Steuerberater*innen, Wirtschaftsprüfer*innen und Behörden sowie für statutarische Meldungen) und gutes Arbeitsenglisch (für die Zusammenarbeit mit Legal und weiteren internationalen Stakeholdern). Strukturierte, eigenständige und proaktive Arbeitsweise, du sprichst Unklarheiten direkt an, statt sie auflaufen zu lassen. Erfahrung in einem Software-/SaaS-Unternehmen oder einem wachstumsstarken Start-up/Scale-up; Vertrautheit mit SaaS-Kennzahlen. Erfahrung in einem Private-Equity-Umfeld. Faire und transparente Vergütung – Profitiere von einem klaren Peer-Review-System und einem Career Progression Plänen, der Ihr Wachstum unterstützen. Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung! Du kannst Dich direkt über unsere Karriereseite mit Deinem Lebenslauf bewerben. Warum Apaleo? Bei Apaleo zu arbeiten bedeutet mehr als nur eine Stelle anzutreten : Es geht darum , echte Veränderungen in der Hotellerie voranzutreiben . Deine Beiträge gestalten unsere innovative, API-first und zunehmend AI-first Plattform direkt mit , beeinflussen unternehmensweite Entscheidungen und helfen , die Zukunft der Hospitality-Technologie neu zu definieren . Bei Apaleo zählt deine Meinung, deine Ideen werden geschätzt , und dein Einfluss ist spürbar . Werde Teil eines Teams, in dem deine Arbeit den Fortschritt vorantreibt , Zusammenarbeit Innovationen hervorbringt und Wachstum ein gemeinsames Ziel ist . Wir sind stolz darauf, ein Arbeitgeber zu sein, der Chancengleichheit und Gleichstellung fördert und sich für einen vielfältigen, integrativen und einladenden Arbeitsplatz einsetzt. Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen von Menschen aller Herkunft, unabhängig von Rasse, Hautfarbe, Religion, Geschlechtsidentität oder -ausdruck, Geschlecht, nationaler Herkunft, Alter, Familienstand, Behinderung oder anderen Merkmalen, die durch geltendes Recht geschützt sind. title: Account Executive, Deployments
description: Accelerating embodied AGI. The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century. microagi is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data. We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries. Most sales roles hand you a territory, a playbook and a quota. This one hands you a market that does not exist yet. We are looking for a builder: someone who would rather create a market than inherit one. Our first enterprise customers are live and the signal is clear. Everything after that is yours to build. Putting physical AI onto a production line is not a software sale. It reaches the plant manager, the COO, the works council, safety and compliance, IT, procurement, and often the CEO. Deals take time, run through site visits and technical assessments, and are won on trust. Your job is to close our first deals in DACH and turn them into a market we own. We look for ownership, high agency and low ego, someone who wants to shape both our customer base, shape how we sell and succeed. What You Will Do Close our first enterprise deals in DACH. Own each one end to end, from first conversation to signed contract. Run the full cycle: discovery, NDAs, use cases and footage, site visits, and a technical deployment assessment covering hardware, data, investment and timeline. Seek the truth on every deal. Find out what Atlas can and cannot do on each customer’s line, say it plainly, and never sell what we cannot deliver, even when it costs the deal. Navigate the whole buying group: plant managers, COOs, works councils, safety and compliance, procurement, and the board. Bring each of them along. Build your own pipeline. Find the industrial champions in your market and get in the room. Develop the playbook as you go: who we sell to, how we price, what wins and what does not. The next ten sellers will run on what you build. Take what you learn on the floor back to product, research and deployment. Requirements A track record of building, wherever you earned it: a market, a team, a company, a product line. Something that exists because you made it. Enterprise sales experience. You have closed long, complex deals with many stakeholders, and you know how to keep them moving when they stall. At your best in ambiguity. No map, no precedent, no one to ask. You sell a vision and people trust you with it. Honest, likeable, low ego, high standards. Willing to get your hands dirty. You build the account lists, write the proposals, and go to site yourself. Fluent German and English. Based in Munich, in the office, with regular travel to customer sites. Nice to Have You have sold to operations buyers: plant or site managers, COOs, heads of manufacturing or logistics. You have run pilots, POCs, or hardware-plus-software deals. You have been early somewhere: founding AE, first sales hire, or early Head of Sales. A background in operations consulting, VC, or as a founder. Who Will Thrive at microagi Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits: Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it. Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it. Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them. Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes. This is for you if: You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec. You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one. You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do. This is not for you if: You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5. You would forward output you cannot explain. "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer. How We Hire We read every application and reply within five working days. Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways. Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it. Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO. Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem. Then a decision, usually within a few days. Pay Transparency Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting. What We Offer Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter. Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval. A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage. Free food and drinks in the office. Equal Opportunity microagi welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity. title: IT System Engineer (w/m/d), 80–100 %
description: Kunden begleiten. Lösungen umsetzen. Verantwortung übernehmen. Du willst die IT deiner Kunden nicht nur am Laufen halten, sondern verstehen, weiterentwickeln und verantworten? Bei Dukers betreust du eigene Kundenumgebungen von A bis Z – mit einem Team im Rücken, das sein Wissen teilt und bei kniffligen Fragen zusammensteht. Über Dukers Dukers ist ein Spin-off der Swisscom mit Sitz in St. Gallen. Wir planen, implementieren und betreiben die IT von Organisationen, die ihre Informatik in verlässliche Hände geben wollen. Unsere Kunden erhalten eine Lösung aus einer Hand: Arbeitsplätze, Netzwerk, Server, Cloud-Dienste und Kommunikation werden von uns aufgebaut, laufend überwacht, aktuell gehalten und abgesichert. Die Verantwortung für den Betrieb liegt bei uns – mit festen Ansprechpersonen, die die Umgebung ihrer Kunden kennen. Besondere Tiefe haben wir in Cloud-Infrastrukturen und UCC, gestützt auf starke Partnerschaften mit Swisscom und Microsoft. Unser Team besteht aus Spezialisten mit langjähriger Erfahrung – mit den Standards eines grossen Anbieters und der Verbindlichkeit eines Partners, der seine Kunden persönlich kennt. Deine Rolle Du bist die technische Ansprechperson für deine Kunden. Du kennst ihre Umgebungen, betreibst sie zuverlässig und setzt Anpassungen, Installationen und Rollouts selbstständig um – von der Konfiguration über die Inbetriebnahme bis zur Dokumentation. Bei Migrationen und grösseren Projekten arbeitest du mit unseren Spezialisten für Netzwerk, Security und Cloud zusammen. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Aufgaben und entscheidest im Alltag selbst. Bei anspruchsvollen Fragen steht das Team hinter dir. Deine Aufgaben Du betreust die IT-Umgebungen deiner Kunden, kennst ihre Anforderungen und bist ihre verlässliche technische Ansprechperson. Du administrierst Microsoft-365-Tenants: Entra ID, Intune, Microsoft Defender, Exchange Online. Du betreibst Clients, Netzwerke und Serversysteme, analysierst Störungen und behebst ihre Ursachen nachhaltig. Du setzt Anpassungen, Installationen und Rollouts selbstständig um und arbeitest bei Migrationen und Projekten mit. Du erkennst, wo eine Umgebung sicherer oder stabiler werden kann, und bringst konkrete Vorschläge ein. Du dokumentierst deine Arbeit sauber, damit jede Umgebung für das ganze Team nachvollziehbar bleibt. Womit du arbeitest Microsoft 365 und Cloud: Entra ID, Intune, Defender, Exchange Online, Azure Virtualisierung: VMware Cloud Director, Hyper-V, Proxmox Netzwerk: Ubiquiti UniFi, Cisco, HPE Aruba Security: Fortinet, Versa, Cisco Rechenzentrum: Eigene Infrastruktur in einem der sichersten und nachhaltigsten Rechenzentren der Schweiz, auf der wir unsere Lösungen und die unserer Kunden betreiben Betrieb: Backup, Monitoring und Ticketing mit Tools, die wir selbst entwickeln und weiterentwickeln Netzwerk und Security betreiben wir als Managed Services – als Value Added Reseller der Swisscom für unsere gemeinsamen Kunden. Wer hier Tiefe aufbauen will, findet bei uns das Umfeld dafür. Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im IT-Bereich, beispielsweise als Informatiker/in EFZ, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation Erfahrung in der Administration von Microsoft-365-Umgebungen – idealerweise mit Entra ID, Intune und Defender Solide Netzwerkkenntnisse: IP-Adressierung, VLANs, DNS und DHCP sind dir vertraut, Routing und Firewall-Regelwerke kein Fremdwort Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt und die Fähigkeit, technische Themen verständlich zu erklären Selbstständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise Lernbereitschaft und Interesse, dein Wissen im Team einzubringen Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Führerausweis Kategorie B Idealerweise hast du bereits Kundenumgebungen eigenständig betreut. Stehst du noch am Anfang deiner Laufbahn, bringst aber die fachlichen Grundlagen und den Willen mit, dich einzuarbeiten, möchten wir dich ebenfalls kennenlernen. Deine Aufgaben und deine Verantwortung wachsen mit deinem Können – das Onboarding ist darauf ausgelegt. Dein Arbeitsort und deine Einsätze Dein Arbeitsalltag verbindet Einsätze bei Kunden in der Ostschweiz und im Raum Zürich mit Arbeit und Austausch in unserem Büro in der Stadt St. Gallen. Wir suchen dich in St. Gallen und Umgebung. Das Büro liegt verkehrsgünstig: Die Autobahnein- und -ausfahrt Kreuzbleiche ist drei Minuten entfernt, Winkeln fünf. Die Bushaltestelle Schönenwegen liegt eine Minute vor der Tür. Parkplätze sind kostenlos. Dazu kommen ein eigener kleiner Park, ein Balkon direkt am Büro mit Grill – und der Blick auf die Geissli nebenan. Was dich bei Dukers erwartet Einarbeitung, die den Namen verdient: Du startest mit einem intensiven Training und arbeitest in den ersten Wochen im Tandem mit einer erfahrenen Kollegin oder einem erfahrenen Kollegen, bis du deine Umgebungen selbst verantwortest. Fünf Weiterbildungstage pro Jahr: Bezahlt und für Zertifizierungen, Kurse oder Herstellertrainings nutzbar – wir fördern deine fachliche Entwicklung aktiv. Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg: Dukers wächst, und wer diesen Erfolg mit erarbeitet, soll daran teilhaben. Deshalb beteiligen wir unser Team jedes Jahr am Unternehmenserfolg – zusätzlich zum Lohn. Fünf Wochen Ferien, bei Bedarf mehr: Bis zu zwei zusätzliche Ferienwochen pro Jahr kannst du unkompliziert dazukaufen. Arbeit, die zu deinem Leben passt: Familie, Weiterbildung, Sport oder ein Projekt, das Zeit braucht: Wir richten die Anstellung nach deiner Lebenssituation aus – mit einem Pensum von 80 % oder 100 %, Gleitzeit und Remote Work nach Absprache. Und wenn sich dein Leben verändert, verändern wir das Modell mit. E-Firmenfahrzeug mit Privatnutzung: Ohne Zusatzkosten für dich, inklusive Ladepauschale. Und wenn du zu Hause laden willst, beteiligen wir uns an deiner eigenen Ladestation. Geschäftshandy mit Mobilabo: Gehört zur Ausstattung. Bei uns entscheidest du mit. Wer eine Umgebung betreut, kennt sie am besten – also liegt die Entscheidung dort, wo das Wissen ist. Siehst du eine bessere Lösung, bringst du sie ein, und wir setzen sie gemeinsam um. Lernen wir uns kennen Stellenantritt: per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung. Und wenn du vor deiner Entscheidung einen Tag mit dem Team verbringen möchtest – gerne. Deine Ansprechpersonen: Livia Julia Tanner, Leitung Personal, nimmt deine Bewerbung entgegen und beantwortet Fragen zur Stelle und zu den Anstellungsbedingungen. Aaron Herceg, Gründer und Governance Manager, leitet das Engineering-Team, mit dem du arbeitest, und beantwortet deine technischen Fragen. Schreib uns an ----- mit Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätzen dazu, warum diese Stelle zu dir passt. Dukers GmbH | St. Gallen Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Director, Account Management & Sales Development – Mirakl Connect
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Mirakl:</strong></p> <p>Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.<br><br>Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).<br><br>With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="http://www.mirakl.com">www.mirakl.com</a>.</p> <p><strong>Mirakl in Numbers:</strong></p> <ul> <li>🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40</li> <li>👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo</li> </ul> <p><strong>Our Values:</strong></p> <p>Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. The team consists of up to 5 Account Managers and Business Developers covering the EMEA region. Together, you'll be scaling AI-driven revenue growth for Mirakl Connect across retention, expansion, and pipeline generation.</div> <div class="my-4 border-b border-primary-150"> </div> <h2 class="pb-2 pt-4 heading-xl text-foreground">2. title: Senior Paid Social Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>A</strong><strong>BOUT TIDE</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.</p> <p>Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.</p> <p>Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.</p> <p><strong>Tide facts:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs</li> <li>Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing</li> <li>Over $300 million raised in funding</li> <li>3,000 Tideans globally</li> <li>Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026</li> <li>We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg</li> </ul></div><h3><strong>About You</strong></h3> <p>We’re looking for a Senior Paid Social Manager who can strategically lead and scale our acquisition efforts across paid social channels in the UK and Europe. You’ll bring deep expertise in managing multi-million-pound budgets, a data-driven approach, and a proven track record of driving large-scale growth. You will be responsible for leading strategy, execution, and innovation in our paid social performance, ensuring we stay ahead of platform changes and industry trends. You’ll also have a clear view on how AI is changing performance marketing, and you’ll build a team that uses it well.</p> <p>You’ll be a Meta expert, with hands-on experience across bidding strategies, audience segmentation, attribution, and creative testing. Additionally, you’ll have experience scaling campaigns across TikTok, Twitter, LinkedIn. You’ll be a martech-savvy professional, comfortable with tracking solutions, first-party data activation, working with MMPs and advanced attribution modeling.</p> <p>You will play a key role in shaping Tide’s international expansion and long-term paid social strategy, ensuring that performance marketing continues to be a key growth driver. This is an opportunity to lead and grow Tide’s in-house Paid Social team as an AI-enabled team, making a significant impact on the business.</p> <h3><strong>Some of the things you’ll be doing:</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Owning and scaling paid social performance globally</strong>, ensuring we maximise efficiency and return on investment across all platforms.</li> <li><strong>Managing and optimising multi-million-pound budgets</strong>, using advanced bidding strategies and automation tools to drive sustained growth.</li> <li><strong>Building an AI-enabled paid social team</strong>, deciding which work AI should handle (creative production, reporting, bid and budget management) and which stays with people, then training the team to work that way.</li> <li><strong>Embedding AI into creative and testing workflows</strong>, using generative tools to develop concepts, copy and variants faster, with clear quality, brand and compliance checks.</li> <li><strong>Using AI and automation across the account</strong>, from platform tools such as Advantage+ to custom scripts, agents and reporting workflows that cut manual work.</li> <li><strong>Developing and executing the paid social roadmap</strong>, identifying new opportunities, testing innovative strategies, and expanding our presence across emerging platforms.</li> <li><strong>Driving a full-funnel approach</strong>, from awareness campaigns to high-intent lead generation and conversion, leveraging creative and audience insights.</li> <li><strong>Collaborating with cross-functional teams</strong> (Data, Product, Web, Creative, and more) to align paid social strategies with Tide’s wider growth objectives.</li> <li><strong>Championing attribution and measurement</strong>, ensuring best-in-class tracking, incrementality testing, and first-party data activation.</li> <li><strong>Leading creative strategy</strong>, working closely with designers and copywriters to continuously test and optimise assets for performance.</li> <li><strong>Staying ahead of industry changes</strong>, including privacy regulations (SKAD, ATT, IFDA), <strong>AI-driven platform updates</strong>, and new advertising solutions.</li> <li><strong>Building and mentoring a high-performing, AI-literate paid social team</strong>, shaping the function as we scale both in the UK and internationally.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>You’ll be a great fit if:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You have 7+ years of experience in paid social marketing, managing large-scale campaigns across multiple platforms.</li> <li>You have a proven track record of driving large volumes of B2B acquisition through paid social.</li> <li>You’re an expert in Meta advertising (Facebook & Instagram), with deep knowledge of bidding strategies, audience segmentation, and ad creative best practices.</li> <li>You have extensive hands-on experience with LinkedIn Ads, Twitter, TikTok, and other secondary paid social platforms.</li> <li>You’re highly analytical, comfortable with incrementality testing, MMM, and data-driven decision-making.</li> <li>You have strong technical knowledge of tracking solutions, attribution modeling, and martech tools (Appsflyer, GA4, GTM, CDPs, Looker/Tableau, etc.).</li> <li>You have hands-on experience using AI in marketing, such as generative tools for creative and copy, LLMs for analysis, and automation for reporting and optimisation.</li> <li>You have experience building or leading a team that uses AI day to day, including setting standards, sharing prompts and workflows, and measuring the productivity gain.</li> <li>You’re comfortable with Meta’s AI-led campaign products (Advantage+, automated bidding) and know when to trust automation and when to override it.</li> <li>You have sound judgement on AI risk, including brand safety, accuracy of claims and data privacy, ideally in a regulated industry such as financial services.</li> <li>You understand how to drive performance across web traffic, mobile apps, and lead generation channels.</li> <li>You have a test-and-learn mindset, with a structured approach to experimentation and optimisation.</li> <li>You can effectively communicate complex insights, using data visualisation tools to tell compelling performance stories.</li> <li>You have experience managing agency relationships, but also thrive in an in-house, hands-on environment.</li> <li>You’re a natural leader, with experience mentoring and growing a team of paid social professionals.</li> <li>Fluency in a second language (French or German) is preferable.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you’ll get in return:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Make work, work for you! We embrace flexible working and remote-first arrangements.</li> <li>25 days holiday + bank holidays.</li> <li>Vitality Health and Dental Insurance, with a proactive focus on mental and physical well-being.</li> <li>£1,000 L&D budget per year, plus up to three L&D paid days off.</li> <li>Enhanced family-friendly leave.</li> <li>Work abroad for up to 90 days a year.</li> <li>Snacks, drinks, and social events in our offices.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Tidean Ways of Working</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we’re Member First and Data Driven, but above all, we’re One Team. We trust our employees to work in a way that suits them while delivering great results. Our offices are always available for those who want to collaborate in person, and we support remote work across the UK.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE</h3> <p>At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. </p> <p>We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.</p> <p> </p> <p><em>At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.</em></p> <div class="p-rich_text_section"> </div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><strong>Disclaimer</strong></div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"> </div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><em>It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. title: Lead Country Commercial Manager for Business Management Software
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>A</strong><strong>BOUT TIDE</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.</p> <p>Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.</p> <p>Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.</p> <p><strong>Tide facts:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs</li> <li>Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing</li> <li>Over $300 million raised in funding</li> <li>3,000 Tideans globally</li> <li>Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026</li> <li>We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg</li> </ul></div><h2><strong>About the team </strong></h2> <p>The Business Management Software commercial team are responsible for driving adoption and usage of essential products for Small Business Owners. This includes Tide’s range of accounting packages, as well as invoicing, expense management, payroll and Company Formations / Company consistent value to members and a consistent revenue stream to Tide. The team works closely with Product, Finance, Business Insights, CRM and Operations teams to translate member and commercial insights into appealing product enhancements, effective positioning, and strategies that enhance engagement and retention. </p> <p><strong>About the role </strong></p> <p>We’re looking for an exceptional Lead Country Commercial Manager to scale revenue growth across our Accounting, Tax and Payroll products (part of our BMS suite, known internally as ‘Admin Services’) and build an indirect distribution channel via Partners & Accountants.</p> <p>You will sit at the heart of Tide’s commercial function and be responsible for collaborating with cross-functional teams (mainly Marketing, Product, Finance) to understand funnel conversion, campaign(s) performance and product prioritisation, whilst owning competitor and market insight and leading new product go-to-market (GTM) launch plans. Excellent organisation, strategy and communication skills essential.</p> <p><strong>Key areas of this role:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Revenue Ownership & Forecasting</strong>: Partner closely with Finance and key stakeholders to set, track, and refine commercial projections for the Accounting, Tax & Payroll products ensuring revenue accountability and proactive identification of risks and opportunities.</li> <li><strong>Accountants Strategy & GTM planning</strong>: Research UK Accountants market and build a clear, concise and financially robust indirect model to help Tide scale their BMS products and others with Accountants.</li> <li><strong>Competitor and Market insight:</strong> Regularly analyse key competitor movements and wider industry trends - relevant to Accounting, Tax, Payroll and Accountants - translating insight into actionable strategies that strengthen and differentiate Tide’s positioning and value proposition.</li> <li><strong>Analytics-Driven Insight: </strong>Analyse (via BI team) member behaviour, segment audiences, subscription cohort performance and create clear recommendations to shape product prioritisation, pricing, positioning and communications.</li> <li><strong>Product Development: </strong>Partner with the Product teams to assess opportunities to shape product positioning, product led growth, aligning on roadmaps and supporting  successful product launches with tailored GTM strategies.</li> <li><strong>Launch Strategy</strong>: Support new feature launches across channels and operational teams to deliver best-in-class experiments. </li> <li><strong>Stakeholder Management: </strong>High levels of communication with a wide range of stakeholders, including Tide’s Senior Leadership Team and Executives.</li> <li><strong>Member Obsession:</strong> You will be or become an expert in the core motivations of our members in order to focus on bringing their voice to commercial and product design discussions.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we are looking for </strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Strong commercial acumen</strong>:  Proven experience in driving commercial impact, partnering with finance to understand performance and identify opportunities to improve.  Able to set and track clear KPIs across all initiatives to meet revenue goals.</li> <li><strong>Accountancy software experience</strong>: Understanding of software and experience scaling software at either an Accountancy software company or with Accountants.</li> <li><strong>5+ years’ experience leading ‘always on’ activity to drive commercial performance.  </strong> This will ideally be with specific experience in Accounting, Invoicing or Expense Management products, ideally in a fintech environment – key is demonstrated ability to plan and deliver consistent activity that drives commercial impact.</li> <li><strong>Strong analytical mindset</strong>: Able to review and interpret data to develop hypotheses and assumptions, turning insights into clear, actionable plans.</li> <li><strong>Proven GTM track record</strong> – delivering holistic, high impact omni-channel campaigns  (across sales, CRM, in-app contact points)</li> <li><strong>Exceptional project management skills</strong>, able to juggle multiple launches and tactical tests in a fast-moving environment.</li> <li><strong>Creative collaborator: </strong>Builds relationships across teams, crafts compelling messaging and navigates ambiguity with confidence.</li> <li><strong>Self-starter attitude</strong>: Works backwards from targets, removes blockers proactively and adapts when priorities shift.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll get in return</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Competitive salary </li> <li>Vitality Health Insurance, with a proactive focus on mental and physical wellbeing</li> <li>Hundreds of perks and discounts through Vitality Health Insurance (fitness watches, Waitrose cashback, gym membership etc.)</li> <li>24/7 Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>25 days holiday with the ability to buy extra days</li> <li>Professional L&D budget per year</li> <li>Referral bonus when you bring your friends to join title: Senior Electrical Product Engineer - Maritime Engineering
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.</p></div><h2>About the Role</h2> <p>The Senior Product Engineer is the primary electrical design engineering presence on the production floor, bridging the gap between design intent and production execution. To hold that authority credibly, this role also contributes to upstream electrical design - architecture, analysis, schematics, and design reviews - so they have the depth needed to make sound disposition decisions on the floor. This is a senior individual contributor role requiring strong technical judgement in electrical and power systems engineering, the ability to operate autonomously in a fast-paced production environment, and the credibility to influence both design engineers and production teams. You will be expected to drive systemic improvements, cutting repeat nonconformances through changes to the design and documentation, as well as resolving individual issues.<br><br></p> <h2>Key Responsibilities</h2> <h3>Production Floor Engineering Support</h3> <ul> <li>Serve as the primary electrical design engineering point of contact on the production floor for assigned programs and product lines</li> <li>Represent the design authority at Material Review Board (MRB) for electrical systems, working with Quality and Manufacturing to minimise production hold time without compromising product safety and integrity</li> <li>Resolve production process-blockers, design ambiguities, and schematic/drawing interpretation issues in real time, exercising engineering judgement within defined authority boundaries</li> <li>Provide rapid-response engineering support and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to Production, Quality, and Test teams for electrical nonconformance resolution, use-as-is/rework/scrap decisions, and repair dispositions</li> <li>Identify and escalate systemic electrical design issues to core Design Engineering teams with clear problem statements, data, and recommended corrective actions</li> <li>Perform detailed electrical calculations, simulations, and analysis to support MRB dispositions, deviation requests, and use-as-is justifications (e.g. power budgets, thermal derating, circuit analysis, connector/harness assessments)</li> </ul> <h3>Electrical Design Contribution</h3> <ul> <li>Contribute to the design, development and integration of electrical systems and subsystems, maintaining the technical depth needed to hold disposition authority on the production floor</li> <li>Perform detailed electrical calculations, simulations and analysis (circuit analysis, power budgets, thermal derating, EMC/EMI) to support both design decisions and MRB dispositions</li> <li>Participate in design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR) and contribute to system-level trade studies</li> <li>Collaborate cross-functionally with mechanical, software, and systems engineering to integrate electrical systems into the vehicle</li> </ul> <h3>Design Intent Translation & Multi-Site Support</h3> <ul> <li>Support the translation of electrical design intent into production-executable work across multiple product versions, configurations, and manufacturing sites</li> <li>Support the stand-up and ramp of production at new or expanding manufacturing sites, ensuring electrical design engineering knowledge transfers effectively</li> <li>Raise and implement engineering changes to correct production issues that originate in the electrical design, through the Anduril configuration management and change process</li> <li>Feed production observations, failure modes and DFM/DFA opportunities back into Platform Electrical design work through structured feedback, prioritised using data</li> </ul> <h3>Design to Production Interface</h3> <ul> <li>Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering on work instruction (WI) development, tooling validation, and First Article Inspection (FAI) activities for electrical assemblies, communicating the design intent and acceptance criteria</li> <li>Own the resolution of EBOM discrepancies found in production for electrical assemblies, and give engineering input to Configuration Management and Manufacturing Engineering on PLM workflows, BOM reconciliation and work instruction tooling</li> <li>Identify patterns across electrical nonconformances, test failures and build issues, and lead engineering root cause analysis and design corrective action implementation</li> <li>Collaborate on the improvement of key tool and functional interfaces (PLM workflows, digital work instructions, BOM reconciliation) that impact design-to-production efficiency</li> <li>Support the development of scalable frameworks for multi-site production: configuration management alignment, site-specific work instruction adaptation, and cross-site lesson-learned sharing</li> <li>Build repeatable playbooks for standing up production of new product variants, reducing ramp time and first-unit defects at each additional site</li> </ul> <h3>Cross-Functional Collaboration & Metrics</h3> <ul> <li>Maintain strong working relationships with Quality, Supply Chain, Manufacturing Engineering, and Program Management to ensure aligned priorities and rapid issue resolution</li> <li>Collate and drive corrective actions on design-originated production issues, providing data-backed prioritisation to core Design Engineering teams</li> <li>Participate in Production readiness reviews, design reviews (P&DFMEA, DFM/A/T) and engineering change assessments</li> </ul> <h2>Key Competencies & Attributes</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Engineering Judgement:</strong> Technical depth in electrical and power systems combined with production pragmatism - able to make sound engineering decisions under time pressure without over-engineering solutions</li> <li><strong>Design Authority Integrity:</strong> You protect product safety and integrity under schedule pressure, understand the limits of your delegated authority and escalate when you should</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Influence:</strong> Credibility with both design engineers and production operators; able to speak both languages and bridge communication gaps</li> <li><strong>Autonomy & Initiative:</strong> Comfort with ambiguity and competing priorities in a fast-moving production environment; able to self-direct and prioritise without constant direction</li> <li><strong>Systems Thinking:</strong> Thinks beyond individual issue resolution to identify patterns, root causes, and scalable solutions that prevent recurrence across sites and variants</li> <li><strong>Communication:</strong> Clear, concise technical communication - written dispositions, engineering reports, and presentations to leadership</li> </ul> <h2>Required Qualifications</h2> <ul> <li>Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field</li> <li>Proven experience in a senior role within defence, tech or any fast-paced environment, driving successful electrical engineering projects from concept to market launch</li> <li>Expertise in electrical engineering principles, techniques, and technologies, with a track record of delivering innovative solutions</li> <li>Proficiency in using industry-standard electrical design and simulation software</li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to motivate and mentor junior engineers while fostering a culture of collaboration and innovation</li> <li>Strong time management and organisational abilities, with a demonstrated ability to deliver projects on time Support Engineer with delegated design or disposition authority</li> <li>Experience with first article inspection (e.g. AS9102) and production test development</li> <li>Familiarity with IPC/WHMA-A-620
