title: Software Engineer, Deploy at Scale
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Location: </strong>Austin, TX (US), San Francisco, CA (US), New York City (US), London (UK)</p> <p>Cloudflare’s Infrastructure Team builds and runs the systems and software that support our solutions that handle trillions of requests per month. We ensure that all of the new and existing features and functionality that Cloudflare offers can be managed at scale and meet the needs of our massively growing, global customer base.</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>As a Software Engineer, Deploy at Scale, you will be responsible for building and maintaining the platform that powers safe, reliable, and automated deployments across Cloudflare. We are looking for engineers to join the Deploy@Scale team and help shape the next phase of deployment automation, release safety, and AI-assisted operations. The Release Manager platform is pivotal in ensuring service resiliency by orchestrating progressive deployments, supporting health-mediated rollouts, and automating release workflows at scale. Our mission is to make deployments seamless, predictable, observable for all engineering teams across Cloudflare.</p> <p><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>At least 4 years of hands-on software development experience on meaningfully complex systems.</li> <li>Experience building both backend systems and frontend widgets.</li> <li>Ability to contribute to planning, development, and execution to meet commitments and deliver with predictability.</li> <li>Experience implementing tools, processes, internal instrumentation, and methodologies.</li> <li>Comfortable working on projects with tight deadlines and short release cycles.</li> <li>Strong verbal and written English language skills.</li> </ul> <p>This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For San Francisco based hires: Estimated annual salary of $157,000 - $216,000</li> <li>For New York City based hires: Estimated annual salary of $150,000 - $206,000</li> </ul> <h4><strong data-path-to-node="3" data-index-in-node="0">Equity</strong></h4> <p data-path-to-node="4">This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p data-path-to-node="4"><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p data-path-to-node="4">Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p data-path-to-node="4"><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="4"><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="4"><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Senior Hardware DevOps Engineer (Linux & Bare Metal)
description: Votre mission Vous aimez comprendre les systèmes de bout en bout, du matériel jusqu’aux services Linux, et résoudre des problématiques techniques complexes ? Au sein de l’équipe Infra Core d’Exotec, vous concevez, déployez et fiabilisez les infrastructures qui supportent nos solutions robotiques. À la croisée du hardware, des systèmes Linux et du DevOps, vous intervenez sur des problématiques techniques variées, du diagnostic bare metal à l’exploitation de clusters Kubernetes on-premises, en laboratoire comme en production et sur les sites clients. Vous contribuez également à l’automatisation des opérations et à l’amélioration continue de la fiabilité et de la qualité des systèmes. Vos responsabilités Hardware, Linux et fiabilité : diagnostiquer et résoudre les incidents bare metal, administrer et optimiser les systèmes Linux Debian, notamment la gestion des services et l’analyse des performances. Réseau et interopérabilité : analyser les communications de bout en bout pour identifier et résoudre les problèmes de connectivité, de configuration et d’interopérabilité entre les systèmes et les équipements. Kubernetes et déploiement : contribuer à la conception, au déploiement et à l’exploitation de clusters Kubernetes on-premises, en tenant compte des contraintes matérielles, réseau et stockage, de leur intégration à leur cycle de vie. Automatisation et qualité : développer des scripts et outils en Bash et Python, automatiser les opérations avec Ansible et promouvoir l’Infrastructure as Code, les tests, les revues de code et les pratiques CI/CD. Expertise et collaboration : prendre en charge des problématiques techniques complexes, identifier les causes racines des incidents, accompagner les équipes projets lors des déploiements et contribuer à la montée en compétence des profils juniors. Le poste implique des astreintes et des interventions possibles sur les sites clients. Votre profil Formation supérieure en informatique ou équivalent, avec au moins 5 ans d’expérience sur un poste similaire. Solide maîtrise de Linux, idéalement dans des environnements Debian, et expérience du diagnostic d’incidents bare metal. Bonne compréhension des interactions entre matériel, système d’exploitation, réseau et équipements. Bonne maîtrise de Bash, Python et Ansible pour automatiser les opérations système. Maîtrise de Docker ou des runtimes compatibles avec l’interface CRI. Connaissance des outils de gestion de code source et des pipelines CI/CD. Capacité à formaliser des solutions techniques et à rédiger des spécifications claires. Anglais courant, autonomie, esprit d’équipe et orientation résultats. Les plus pour votre candidature Expérience de Kubernetes, notamment en environnement on-premises. Pratique de GitLab et d’autres langages de programmation. Expérience en environnement Agile ou sur des plateformes d’infrastructure et de développement. Benefits Couverture mutuelle et prévoyance santé compétitive Primes collectives Politique famille avantageuse Programme de mobilité interne et internationale Nombreuses opportunités de formation et de développement Chez Exotec, nous garantissons l’égalité des chances dans notre processus de recrutement. L’ensemble des candidatures reçues sont étudiées indépendamment de l’âge, du genre, de l’origine, de la religion, de la couleur de peau, de la nationalité, du sexe, du handicap, de l’orientation sexuelle ou de toute autre distinction protégée par la loi. Nous mettons en place un environnement de travail inclusif et respectueux de toutes les différences. En rejoignant le Pacte Parité, Exotec s’engage pour un écosystème French Tech plus paritaire. title: Learning Experience Architect (m/f/d)
description: About the role: As a Learning Experience Architect at Quantum Systems, you will work with our Training & Demo Team to shape learning around our unmanned systems (UxS). You will help our international customers and employees understand complex technology and use it safely. You will define the instructional approach for our training portfolio and support its implementation. Working with trainers and subject matter experts, you will digitize and scale existing training and develop new offerings. You will combine digital learning with practical exercises and assess how well learners can apply what they have learned. You will have the freedom to take your ideas from concept to launch and put your own stamp on UxS training at Quantum Systems. Your work will improve the technical and instructional quality of our training and make its impact measurable. What is your Day to Day Mission: You will design modular learning paths that combine digital self-study with instructor-led training and simulator exercises. You will turn technical expertise into interactive learning modules and assessments and coordinate media production. You will build scalable offerings in learning management systems such as Moodle and define standards for quality and reusable content. You will test learning concepts with target users and improve them using feedback, usage data and learning results. You will evaluate learning outcomes and practical application and use the findings to improve our training portfolio. You will advise and support our trainers in using effective instructional methods for digital and blended learning. You will prioritize portfolio improvements and deliver learning projects with UxS experts, the Simulator Team and external providers. You will analyze learning needs and define measurable objectives for new and existing offerings with the Training & Demo Team. What you bring to the team: You have a degree in education, instructional design, media or e-learning, or a comparable qualification with relevant practical experience. You have solid experience in adult learning and modular, digital and blended learning, demonstrated through project examples or a portfolio. You can analyze learning needs, define measurable objectives and test learning concepts with target users. You are proficient in authoring tools and experienced in designing and publishing digital learning in learning management systems such as Moodle. You know how to evaluate learning outcomes and practical application and use feedback and learning data to drive improvements. You can understand complex technical topics, explain them clearly with subject matter experts and advise trainers on new learning formats. You work independently and methodically and coordinate learning projects with different stakeholders. You have excellent written and spoken German and English communication skills. Experience with AI in learning, media design (images, audio, video) or learning management system administration is a plus. Why Quantum-Systems: We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus. We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary. We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data. We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth. Our benefits: Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later. Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance. Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance. Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership. Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy. Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia. Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together. Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored. Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday. About us: Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. At Quantum Systems, you’ll work alongside experts across disciplines, take ownership from day one and help turn ambitious ideas into technology with real-world impact. We move fast, think beyond boundaries and give our teams the space to shape what comes next. The Future is Unmanned - But the responsibility is not. Our commitment: We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success. At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: SAP Koordinator (m/w/d) – Schnittstellen, Berechtigungen & Dienstleistersteuerung
description: Sie kennen SAP aus dem laufenden Betrieb, bis in Tabellen, Logs und Transporte? Das Unternehmen wächst auf einer sehr soliden Auftragsbasis, und die IT soll dieses Wachstum mit stabilen Systemen tragen. Warum diese Rolle? Das SAP-System läuft auf ECC 6.0, ist über Jahre gewachsen und soll auf S/4HANA umgestellt werden. Die Basis betreibt ein externer Dienstleister, in den Fachbereichen entsteht ein Key-User-Konzept. Gesucht wird die Person, die das Ganze technisch zusammenhält. • Weil Sie die Verantwortung für ein SAP-Backend tragen, das zuverlässig läuft. • Weil Sie den Weg von ECC zu S/4HANA von Anfang an begleiten. • Weil Sie Zuständigkeiten klären und Strukturen schaffen, die bleiben. Das sind Ihre Aufgaben • Sie behalten Hintergrundjobs, IDoc-Verarbeitung, RFC-Verbindungen, EDI-Strecken und angebundene Drittsysteme im Blick. Fehler analysieren Sie über Dumps, Logs und Traces und verfolgen sie bis zur Lösung. • Sie koordinieren den Basis-Dienstleister bei Upgrades, Patches und Performance-Themen, später auch beim Wechsel auf S/4HANA, und fordern Ergebnisse ein. • Sie prüfen Anforderungen und legen fest, ob Sie selbst umsetzen, den Dienstleister beauftragen oder die Aufgabe an den Fachbereich geben. • Sie unterstützen die Fachbereiche beim Aufbau ihrer Key-User-Rollen. • Sie erledigen selbst Benutzer und Rollen, SAPscript- und Smartforms-Anpassungen, Jobeinplanung, Systemnachrichten und kleinere technische Änderungen. • Sie halten Systemlandschaft und Abläufe schriftlich fest, sodass Wissen im Unternehmen bleibt. Zur Einordnung: Installation, Datenbank und Betriebssystem verantwortet der Basis-Dienstleister. Sie steuern ihn und sind die Ansprechperson für alles im SAP-Umfeld, wofür es noch keine klare Zuständigkeit gibt. Das bringen Sie mit • Eine IT-nahe oder kaufmännische Ausbildung oder ein Studium • Mehrere Jahre SAP-Erfahrung im Inhouse-Betrieb eines Unternehmens, idealerweise mit ECC 6.0 • Technischen Tiefgang: Sie lesen Dumps und Traces, kennen Jobs, Transporte und Tabellen und sprechen mit dem Basis-Dienstleister auf Augenhöhe • Praxis mit IDocs, RFC und EDI sowie mit Rollen und Berechtigungen (PFCG, SU53) • Erfahrung in Projekten und in der Steuerung externer Partner, dazu Ausdauer beim Nachhaken • Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch • Von Vorteil: Erfahrung mit Middleware und erste Berührungspunkte mit S/4HANA Das erwartet Sie • Arbeitsplatz im Großraum Kassel: Die Rolle lebt vom direkten Austausch, deshalb arbeiten Sie überwiegend vor Ort • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket, Bikeleasing und Weiterbildung Interesse? Our goal is to make automated, reliable diagnostic analysis accessible on any phone connected to a microscope. The role We're looking for an engineer who wants to own the whole platform behind a medical product: services, data, infrastructure, security and identity. A first version runs today. The hard part is making it trustworthy enough for clinical use: patient data that stays safe, an audit trail that holds up for years, and a system that recovers when something breaks. You'll own all of it, working closely with the founders and our CTO. What you'll do Own the platform end to end: backend, data, infrastructure and security. Get it ready for clinical use, and keep it reliable as we grow. Build identity, access and data handling that clinics and auditors can trust. Make the architecture calls: what to build now, what to defer, what to cut. Set the engineering standard and help hire the team that follows. What you bring Platforms you've built and run. You've built backend platforms from scratch and run them in production, through outages, data incidents, migrations and growth. Database depth. You know what happens under the query: indexing, locking, transactions, replication, zero-downtime schema changes, and backups you've actually restored. Security by default. Authentication and authorisation, tenant isolation, secrets, audit logging. You think about how a system gets attacked before it ships. Identity done properly. Identity providers, sessions and tokens, roles and permissions, onboarding and offboarding. Infrastructure. Infrastructure as code, containers, Linux, networking and cloud are everyday tools for you. Beyond the backend. The backend is your home, but when the product needs it, you read and change the app yourself. Systematic troubleshooting. You reproduce first and fix root causes. A product that matters: a medical device for real clinics, built together with clinicians and lab staff. Flexible hours and office days. title: Senior Software Engineer - Open Source
description: <p>Cambridge, UK | Full-time | Permanent</p> <p>Salary: £81,000 - £95,000 DOE</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>About us </strong></p> <p>Riverlane’s mission is to master quantum error correction (QEC) and unlock a new age of human progress. From advances in material and climate science, to complex chemistry simulation for new drug design, quantum computers will help humanity solve some of its most important challenges. But without QEC, the industry’s defining technical challenge, such breakthroughs can never be achieved.  Riverlane is the world leader in QEC technology. QEC is a complex problem that requires a range of skills, talent and passion. </p> <p>Having raised more than $125M in funding to date to accelerate our cutting-edge R&D in quantum error correction (QEC), Riverlane partners with many of the world’s leading quantum hardware providers and government agencies to make fault-tolerant quantum computing a reality. We are making remarkable progress and growing fast. </p> <p> </p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>At Riverlane, our mission is to make it possible for anyone to write and run fault-tolerant programs on a quantum computer. A key part of that mission is <a href="https://github.com/Deltakit/deltakit">Deltakit</a>, our open-source, user-facing platform for building, simulating and interpreting QEC experiments. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will own and lead the development of <a href="https://github.com/Deltakit/deltakit">Deltakit</a>, shaping its direction and ensuring it evolves to meet the needs of a growing and highly technical user community.</p> <p>This role sits at the intersection of research and engineering. You will take cutting-edge ideas from the forefront of QEC and turn them into robust, intuitive software that researchers can rely on. Day to day, this means driving the design and delivery of new features, improving performance and usability, and ensuring the platform scales as adoption grows. You’ll play a key role in planning and prioritising the development roadmap, aligning technical delivery with research milestones, user needs, and broader organisational goals, as well as defining technical direction, making architectural decisions, and setting the standard for high-quality, well-engineered code.</p> <p>You will also be closely connected to the people who use what we build. By engaging with researchers, engineers and the wider QEC community, you’ll help support adoption of <a href="https://github.com/Deltakit/deltakit">Deltakit</a>, understand how it’s being used in practice, and translate real-world feedback into meaningful improvements. You’ll also play a key role in planning and prioritising the development roadmap, aligning technical delivery with research milestones, user needs, and broader organisational goals. Through this, you’ll ensure the software not only reflects the latest research, but is accessible, reliable and impactful.</p> <p>Riverlane operates at the forefront of a fast-moving and evolving field. You’ll work as part of a collaborative, multidisciplinary team where ideas are shared openly and learning is continuous. As priorities shift and the technology develops, you’ll help guide the platform forward through both technical leadership and thoughtful planning, bringing clarity, direction and momentum to complex challenges, and playing a central role in advancing Riverlane’s leadership in QEC software.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>What you will do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead significant parts of both the internal and external software stack for error-corrected quantum computing systems  </li> <li>Turn internal tools into external and public ones. Own the complete software cycle process: design, development, testing, builds, workflows, releases</li> <li>Mentor, guide and lead engineers in the team</li> <li>Lead collaboration with other engineering teams to integrate their software and hardware artifacts with <a href="https://github.com/Deltakit/deltakit">Deltakit</a></li> <li>Engage with the community of users and researchers to identify needs and formulate adequate response</li> <li>Contribute actively to open-source projects and lead the <a href="https://github.com/Deltakit/deltakit">Deltakit</a> open-source community</li> <li>Organise and run workshops and tutorials for the community of users</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What we need</strong></p> <p><em>We are considering a range of experience and are therefore advertising this role at different levels of seniority.  Please apply to the role you feel best suits your skills and experience.</em></p> <ul> <li>Strong technical foundation (e.g. computer science, mathematics, physics or similar)</li> <li>Experience designing and building high-quality scientific or technical software, primarily in Python</li> <li>Ability to translate complex, research-driven concepts into robust, scalable and user-friendly solutions</li> <li>Broad understanding of software systems (e.g. compilers, operating systems, computer architecture)</li> <li>Experience shipping software to users and maintaining high engineering standards</li> <li>Curiosity and a strong drive to learn and solve complex problems</li> <li>Collaborative mindset, with experience working across diverse teams</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills</li> <li>Ability to shape technical direction, drive best practices, and support others through mentorship and leadership</li> <li>Interest in contributing to the quantum open-source ecosystem</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Even better if you have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with a strongly typed language (e.g. C++ or title: Senior FPGA Engineer - Systems Team
description: <p><strong>Senior FPGA Engineer – Systems Team </strong></p> <p>Cambridge, UK | Full-time | Permanent | Hybrid</p> <p>Salary: £70,000 to £108,000, DOE</p> <p><em>The salary range for this role is broad, as we are able to consider varying levels of experience.  Any offer made will carefully take into account level of experience (including relevant industry experience), transferable relevant skills and previous relevant achievements.</em></p> <p><em>We will also consider part-time applications for this role. Please indicate your preferred working schedule in your cover letter. </em></p> <p><strong>About us</strong></p> <p>Riverlane’s mission is to master quantum error correction (QEC) and unlock a new age of human progress. From advances in material and climate science, to complex chemistry simulation for new drug design, quantum computers will help humanity solve some of its most important challenges. But without QEC, the industry’s defining technical challenge, such breakthroughs can never be achieved.  Riverlane is the world leader in QEC technology. QEC is a complex problem that requires a range of skills, talent and passion.</p> <p>Having raised more than $125M in funding to date to accelerate our cutting-edge R&D in quantum error correction (QEC), Riverlane partners with many of the world’s leading quantum hardware providers and government agencies to make fault-tolerant quantum computing a reality. We’re making remarkable progress and growing fast. </p> <p><strong>About the role </strong></p> <p>Systems Engineering bridges the gap between Riverlane and its customers. They act as the primary technical interface for our customers’ engineers to guide them through product integration and help with troubleshooting complex quantum systems. They are key to securing design wins and driving product development.</p> <p>As an FPGA Engineer, you will configure our Deltaflow Hardware to connect Quantum Computers to provide low-latency, high throughput systems that perform complex operations in a predictable and guaranteed way.  You will use your knowledge and expertise to adapt the hardware to an ever-changing quantum control system to support scientists that are running quantum experiments.</p> <p>This is a fantastic opportunity to join Riverlane’s team, that is developing the world’s most advanced quantum error correcting algorithms.  The Riverlane team is a mix of mathematicians, physicists and engineers, working together on a range of exciting and cutting-edge projects.    </p> <p><strong>What you will do:</strong></p> <p><strong>Technical pre-Sales:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Host Technical Workshops on Riverlane’s QEC Interface</li> <li>Evaluate Customers Control System and Data Communication requirements.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Integration On-Site: </strong>End-to-End System Deployment:</p> <ul> <li>Writing RTL to adapt to customers control systems and ensure data packets are received correctly.</li> <li>Work with Riverlane’s Quantum Application Team to design experiments to test the system.</li> <li>Benchmark and discover hardware latency limitations.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Troubleshooting and Debugging: </strong>Managing Customer Issues:</p> <ul> <li>Report issues and help replicate the setup with the QA team in Riverlane.</li> <li>Writing script to debug and trace faults</li> <li>Update verification environment and the test vectors based on data gathered from the experiments that were conducted.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Customer Advocacy: Voice of the Customer to Riverlane Product Team:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Highlight the success, issues and trends on customer’s Quantum Systems</li> <li>Feedback key features that will be needed to win current and next generation products</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we need:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with state-of-the-art FPGA platforms (e.g. AMD/Xilinx MPSoCs/RFSoCs, Altera Stratix 7 or Stratix 10) </li> <li>Experience in writing SystemVerilog or VHDL</li> <li>Proven professional experience in <strong><em>at least one of</em></strong> the following areas:  <ul> <li>Implementation of modern classical decoders on FPGA e.g. LDPC, turbo-codes; </li> <li>Implementation of Ethernet and High-Speed Protocols </li> <li>Implementation of customs protocols and standards.</li> </ul> </li> <li>Proven capability to test, debug and improve UVM Verification Environment.</li> <li>Good knowledge of Python and C++</li> <li>Ability to convert product requirements into technical specifications to document and share your work</li> <li>A curious nature and a passion for learning and continuous improvement </li> <li>Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively as part of a team</li> </ul> <p>Typically, our Senior FPGA Engineers have around 4–8 years of relevant experience, though this can vary by background.</p> <p><strong>Even better if you have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience of working on scientific instrumentation</li> <li>PhD in a relevant subject</li> <li>Good knowledge of quantum mechanics.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What can you expect from us:</strong></p> <ul> <li>A comprehensive benefits package that includes an annual bonus plan, private medical insurance, life insurance, and a contributory pension scheme</li> <li>Equity, so that our team can share in the long-term success of Riverlane</li> <li>28 days annual leave, plus bank holidays and enhanced family leave</li> <li>A diverse work environment that brings together experts in many fields (including software and hardware development, quantum information theory, physics and maths) and over 20 different nationalities</li> <li>A learning environment that encourages individual, team and company growth and development, including a regular programme of learning events and training and conference budgets</li> </ul> <p><strong>How to apply</strong></p> <p>Please title: Senior AI Software Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p><strong>The team</strong></p> <p>NiCE Labs (nice.com/nice-labs) is where NiCE explores what's next in AI for customer experience. This role is on AI Innovation, the Labs pillar that builds and validates new AI capabilities through prototypes, so the company can make better product decisions, faster.<span data-ccp-props="{"335559739":160}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We're a deliberately small, senior team of builders inside NiCE Cognigy, the AI agent platform. We operate in fast iteration cycles: spot an emerging capability, build a working prototype, validate it against real metrics (quality, latency, cost, user impact), and then decide: kill it, iterate, publish it, or hand it off to a product team. Some of our work is public, like the open-sourced Cognigy Platform MCP server; most of it shapes the product roadmap from the inside.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335559739":160}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We hire for product mindset and builder mentality. Everyone on the team takes ideas from zero to working software, shows them to real users, and argues from evidence.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335559739":160}"> </span></p> <p><strong>So, what’s the role all about?</strong></p> <p>You'll work at the intersection of frontier AI capabilities and a real enterprise product. The field moves faster than any roadmap can track. Your job is to close that gap: turn new models, protocols, and agent patterns into working systems, prove what matters in realistic scenarios, and produce the insights and reference implementations that let product and engineering teams move with confidence.<span data-ccp-props="{"335559739":160}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">You'll need to be comfortable with ambiguity, at home where best practices don't exist yet, and quick to move on when the results point elsewhere.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335559739":160}"> </span></p> <p><strong>How will you make an impact?</strong><strong> </strong><strong> </strong></p> <ul> <li>Build agentic systems and full-stack prototypes end-to-end, shipping a first version in days and learning from real use</li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Track the frontier (new models, agent patterns, protocols like MCP) and turn the promising ones into working prototypes rather than slideware</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Design experiments that show whether a concept holds up, measured in quality, latency, cost, and user impact</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Work directly with internal users, product managers, and customers to validate concepts early and iterate quickly</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335559739":100}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Turn validated prototypes into reference implementations and write-ups that product teams can build on, then hand off cleanly and move to the next bet</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Give product and platform teams concrete feedback on where AI capabilities shine and where they fall short</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Move between initiatives as priorities shift. What you learn on one bet compounds into the next</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Have you got what it takes?</strong><strong> </strong></p> <ul> <li>Have 4+ years building full-stack software, including things you started from nothing. We weigh what you've shipped more than years on a CV<span data-ccp-props="{"335559739":100}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Have shipped LLM-powered systems to production:features real users depended on, not demos or notebooks</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335559739":100}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Understand AI agents below the framework level: message arrays, tool calling, context management, prompt caching. You could build an agent loop from scratch and explain why it works</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Use AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar) as your default way of working, and it makes you measurably faster, not just busier</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Are full-stackin practice: comfortable taking a prototype from API to demo UI on your own (our stack centers on TypeScript/Node.js and React)</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335559739":100}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Do your best work when the ground is still moving. New territory energises you more than a settled plan</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Think in user problems first, solutions second</span></li> </ul> <p>You will have an advantage if you also have:</p> <ul> <li>A strong eye for UX/UI: you can make a prototype feel like a product, and you notice when one lacks that eye</li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Experience with voice and real-time AI: streaming, speech-to-text/text-to-speech, voice-to-voice models</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Open-source work on agent tooling (MCP servers, harnesses, evals)</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Experience designing evaluations for AI systems</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Background in conversational AI or customer-experience products</span></li> </ul> <p data-ccp-border-top="0px none " data-ccp-padding-top="0px" data-ccp-border-bottom="0px none " data-ccp-padding-bottom="0px"><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Enjoy NICE-FLEX! </span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559740":240,"335572083":0,"335572084":0,"335572085":4278190080,"469789810":"nil"}"> </span></p> <p data-ccp-border-top="0px none " data-ccp-padding-top="0px"><span data-contrast="auto">At NICE, we work according to the NICE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335551550":6,"335551620":6,"335559740":240,"335572083":0,"335572084":0,"335572085":4278190080,"469789810":"nil"}"> </span></p> <p>Requisition ID: 11563<br>Reporting into: Manager, Engineering, AI Innovation<br>Role Type: Individual Contributor</p> <p>#LI Hybrid</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><strong>About NiCE </strong></em></p> <p><em>NICE Ltd. title: Territory Account Executive, Saudi Arabia - Startups
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Dubai, UAE</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>We are seeking a highly accomplished and strategic Account Executive to join our <strong>Digital Natives</strong> team in Dubai. The ideal candidate possesses a deep blend of advanced sales acumen and sophisticated technical understanding, enabling them to lead engagements at all levels, from the C-suite to technical leaders (e.g., Head of/VP of Networking or Security).</p> <p>As an Account Executive, you will consistently demonstrate advanced proficiency in all sales activities, ensuring highly accurate forecasting, proactive and strategic pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets. You will be a key driver of digital transformation for our customers, understanding their broader market trends and how Cloudflare uniquely enables their strategic initiatives.</p> <p><strong>Regional Focus: Saudi Arabia - Startups</strong></p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic Revenue Generation:</strong> Architect and execute advanced territory and account plans to consistently exceed multi-million dollar sales targets and annual quotas, with a strong focus on new business acquisition and expansion within complex enterprise environments.</li> <li><strong>Expert Pipeline & Forecasting:</strong> Lead proactive and strategic pipeline management efforts, demonstrating a sophisticated understanding of sales cycles and customer buying processes. Deliver highly accurate forecasts, providing clear insights and strategic guidance to sales leadership.</li> <li><strong>Deep Customer & IT Architecture Understanding:</strong> Develop a profound understanding of customers' IT architectures, including applications and third-party technologies. Architect and align Cloudflare Reference Architectures to customer environments, driving comprehensive platform solutions.</li> <li><strong>Multi-Engagement Leadership:</strong> Orchestrate and manage multiple complex customer engagements simultaneously across various business units within an organization. Strategically connect disparate needs to strengthen Cloudflare's platform sale, actively involving and influencing technical C-level minus one executives.</li> <li><strong>Virtual Team Leadership:</strong> Set clear direction and lead a virtual team of in-GEO specialists, Product Managers, Deal Desk, and Legal to collaboratively manage and close complex customer opportunities. Proactively identify and navigate through situations to address colleague and customer needs, escalating as appropriate to drive urgency and efficient delivery.</li> <li><strong>Digital Transformation Authority:</strong> Act as an authority on digital transformation, understanding key drivers (e.g., new offering development, enhanced customer capabilities) and the broader market trends influencing these decisions. Position Cloudflare as a critical enabler of these transformations.</li> <li><strong>Compelling Value Creation:</strong> Articulate highly compelling, strategic value propositions for Cloudflare's services, directly linking them to customer business outcomes and strategic objectives. Demonstrate advanced closing skills across new business and expansion opportunities.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisor & Coach:</strong> Build long-term, executive-level strategic relationships, ensuring deep customer adoption, retention, and expansion. Consistently provide clear, direct, and constructive feedback to team members, coaching them to improve communication, learn from mistakes, and enhance the quality of work. Share learnings proactively to build trust across the organization.</li> <li><strong>Organizational Impact & Leadership:</strong> Consistently focus on the long-term needs of the team and the business, understanding how decisions impact other teams and openly sharing these insights. Leverage company-wide learnings to improve department and team execution. Serve as a leader within Cloudflare, making significant contributions while elevating the work of others by bringing diverse perspectives and strategic long-term thinking.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Language Skills: Fluency in both English and Arabic (written and spoken).</strong></li> <li><strong>5+ years of advanced experience selling complex technology solutions in a B2B enterprise model</strong>, with a significant track record of consistently exceeding targets.</li> <li><strong>Deep expertise and fluency in Cloud Networking, Security, and Edge Computing technologies</strong>, with an exceptional ability to articulate features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments (e.g., SMBs, enterprise, vertical markets).</li> <li><strong>Proven ability to deeply understand complex customer IT architectures</strong> and effectively map them to Cloudflare Reference Architectures for successful platform sales.</li> <li><strong>Demonstrated success leading and influencing virtual cross-functional teams</strong> (e.g., Solution Engineers, Product Managers, Legal) to drive complex deals to closure.</li> <li><strong>Exceptional strategic communication and presentation skills</strong>, with a focus on articulating the "why" and conveying the whole picture to executive leadership and technical decision-makers (C-level minus one).</li> <li><strong>Advanced negotiation skills</strong> with a track record of closing large, complex, six-figure and multi-million dollar deals.</li> <li><strong>Expert-level sales acumen:</strong> unparalleled proficiency in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and expansion strategies within enterprise accounts.</li> <li><strong>Authority on digital transformation trends</strong> and their impact on enterprise customers, with the ability to position Cloudflare as a key enabler of strategic business outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Strong coaching and mentorship abilities</strong>, with a passion for helping colleagues grow and improve.</li> <li><strong>Highly self-motivated, entrepreneurial, and resilient</strong>, thriving in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with a consistent focus on long-term goals.</li> <li><strong>Proficiency in advanced sales and business intelligence platforms</strong> (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite, MSFT suite, MEDDPICC framework application).</li> <li><strong>Bachelor's degree required</strong>, with a technical background (e.g., engineering, computer science, MIS) highly preferred.</li> <li><strong>Ability to travel</strong> <strong>up to 50%</strong> to engage with key customers and internal teams.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes title: HR Stagiair
description: Ben jij een HR-student die niet alleen wil meekijken, maar echt wil meewerken? Bij Quatra krijg je geen stage met alleen opdrachten en meekijken vanaf de zijlijn. Je draait mee in het team, krijgt verantwoordelijkheid en leert hoe HR er in de praktijk aan toegaat. Wat ga je doen Als HR-stagiair bij Quatra werk je mee aan alles wat met mensen te maken heeft. Praktisch, operationeel en dichtbij de business. Je zit niet alleen achter je laptop, maar schakelt veel met collega’s en ziet direct wat jouw werk oplevert. Je komt terecht in een klein en betrokken HR-team. We werken informeel, helpen elkaar en zeggen waar het op staat. Geen hiërarchiegedoe, wel korte lijnen. Bij Quatra werken we volgens onze kernwaarden: Connect, Commit, Create. Dat merk je in hoe we samenwerken en verantwoordelijkheid nemen. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Ondersteunen bij werving en selectie, onboarding en offboarding; Opstellen van arbeidsovereenkomsten en verwerken van personeelsmutaties; Bijhouden van tijd-, verlof- en verzuimadministratie; Meewerken aan lopende HR-projecten en verbeteringen in onze processen; Uitvoeren van je stageopdrachten, afgestemd op jouw opleiding en leerdoelen. Wat breng jij mee? Je volgt een HRM-opleiding (HBO of MBO) of een vergelijkbare opleiding; Je bent enthousiast, gedreven en digitaal handig; Je wilt leren door te doen en durft vragen te stellen; Je werkt zorgvuldig en neemt verantwoordelijkheid; Je communiceert duidelijk in het Nederlands, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk; Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar (stageduur ± 4 maanden). Waarom stage lopen bij Quatra? Een meewerkstage waarin je echt onderdeel bent van het team; Veel verantwoordelijkheid en hands-on ervaring binnen een snelgroeiende en duurzame organisatie. Een informele, directe en betrokken werksfeer waarin jouw ideeën welkom zijn. Goede stagevergoeding en de kans om echt impact te maken. Persoonlijke begeleiding en coaching om jouw HR-skills naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Over Quatra: Quatra is een internationale snelgroeiende groep, gespecialiseerd in het inzamelen en recyclen van gebruikte frituurolie. Geen marketingverhaal: duurzaamheid is hier het verdienmodel. We verwerken jaarlijks meer dan 250.000 ton UCO tot grondstof voor hernieuwbare brandstoffen, waaronder Sustainable Aviation Fuel, en opereren vanuit 10 landen met ruim 250.000 klanten in horeca, catering, industrie en scheepvaart. In Nederland bouwen we naast de klassieke inzamelactiviteiten aan een groeiende trading-operatie waarbij we wereldwijd volumes aankopen en via ons Europese netwerk vermarkten. Bij Quatra Nederland ​ werken wij met ± 160 collega's. Bekijk ook eens onze YouTube filmpjes op onze Quatra website. Klaar om je HR-carrière te kickstarten? Solliciteer direct! Heb je vragen? title: Team Lead - Platform Engineering
description: About the role: We are looking for a new team lead for one of the teams within our Infra Platform Group. Your mission in this role is to architect and deliver foundational services that empower the product engineering teams building our e-commerce platform. Together with your team, you will be tackling challenging engineering problems, working on high-performing and scalable services written in Haskell and Rust, while also providing a high-quality developer experience for the teams that use them via Python. Your time will be split approximately 50-50 between leadership tasks and hands-on development. In your leadership role, you are a mentor to your team members, unblocking them when they face challenging roadblocks, and you help them grow both their hard and soft skills. As part of your hands-on work, you are contributing to the architecture and the ongoing development and maintenance of our services. You will initially be managing a team of four experienced Haskell and Rust engineers, and you will be working closely together with the other teams in the group, the engineering manager of the Infra Platform Group, and the stakeholders from other engineering teams that consume our services. If you don't have direct experience with Haskell, but you have solid experience with Rust or Scala and a willingness to learn Haskell, please submit your application, as we are still happy to consider it! Your responsibilities: Your Team Lead tasks will include: Organizing the work and managing priorities Collaborating with the other team leads in the Infra Platform Group on the long-term roadmap Mentoring team members, helping them grow and holding half-yearly performance reviews with them Setting up project teams and mentor project leads Hiring new team members Implementing and improving upon our processes for the team Establishing the team culture and fostering a collaborative environment Your Development tasks will include: Designing, developing and testing new features in our services Improving the reliability and robustness of our application Working on scalability and performance improvements Collaborating with and review PRs of other engineers Breaking down big projects into smaller issues Writing clear and actionable issues Debugging and fixing issues, and teaching team members to do the same Working together with our product engineering teams and DevOps team on requirements and issues Who are you? You like working in a dynamic team of skilled engineers, discussing technical decisions openly and collaboratively. It is easy for you to break down big issues into smaller tasks and to prioritize work pragmatically. To set you up for success in this role, we think you'll benefit from having the following skills and experience: You have previous experience leading an engineering team, or you are an experienced engineer, excited to start your career as a leader. You can give detailed code reviews both from a high-level and a low-level perspective. You have the technical depth to help your team members grow and can remove roadblocks for them. You have substantial backend development experience, you are experienced with functional programming concepts, and are comfortable working with either Haskell, Scala, or Rust. Experience with Python is a plus. You are familiar with relational databases (ideally PostgreSQL), Linux and git. You have experience with web development, web technologies, and APIs You have strong communication and problem-solving skills You are a people-oriented individual who helps others with an open and approachable attitude. You value high software engineering standards. You are pragmatic and empathic towards your team members and other stakeholders (i.e. colleagues from other departments etc). You like helping the team focus on the most important tasks, making sure its priorities and plans align with the rest of the company (we use the OKR framework for this). Practical requirements: EU citizenship or a valid work permit for the Netherlands; you are preferably already living in the Netherlands Available for at least 32 hours a week, with two days spent at the Utrecht office Important note: We understand that studies show women may only apply for roles when they feel they meet 100% of the requirements; therefore, we strongly encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box, as we are looking for passionate individuals with potential and a willingness to grow. Who are we? Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht and is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform that offers a fully integrated way to market your products online. We empower marketers and online businesses to manage, scale, and optimize their marketing. We are now a strong team of 320+ diverse individuals from more than 40+ nationalities. Joining Channable means you’re looking for a bit more than just a job. Diverse as we are, we all share our love for growth, to help, to take ownership, and create an awesome journey together. Feel free to take a further look at who we are here and on our Instagram or LinkedIn ! Wanna get to know us even more? Give our Culture Playbook a read. Why Channable? At Channable, you’ll find a culture that values openness, craftsmanship, and collaboration. We invest in our people and give them the autonomy to drive meaningful change. You'll work on technical challenges that matter, with colleagues who care deeply about the product and each other. What do we offer? Gross annual salary ranging from € 77k-103k, including 8% holiday allowance and based on a 40-hour work week. This salary range reflects our career framework. Your final role level will be determined throughout the recruitment process, based on alignment with this framework. Savings for old age: we have a savings scheme for old age, which can accrue up to 5% of your monthly salary, or you can get an additional +2.5% to your monthly base salary. Annual L&D budget of €1000 to spend on your professional growth. Stock Appreciation Rights: you can profit from Channable’s success. Company-wide performance bonus, up to 10% of your annual salary, determined yearly by our founders based on financial planning and targets. 26 vacation days + 2 reload days based on 40 hours, with the possibility of buying up to 5 extra vacation days per year. Are you going to become a parent? Enjoy 5 weeks of 100% paid partner leave! Commuting to our office? Choose between an NS Business Card or a €0.25/km travel allowance for alternative transport. Work from our office in central Utrecht at least 2 days a week, and from home for the rest (we'll provide the gear and a budget for extra supplies). Plus, enjoy flexible working hours with a morning start window between 8:00 AM and 10:00 AM. We offer a 3-week-long workcation; and an additional 3 weeks if you live as an expat in the Netherlands! Your well-being matters: we offer a discounted Urban Sports Club subscription and anonymous access to OpenUp psychologists and resources. Fresh daily lunch: enjoy fresh meals prepared Monday to Thursday by our in-house Chef (fully catering to vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free diets). On Fridays, we switch it up by ordering in tasty sandwiches and salads. Additional working conditions include massages, even personal training sessions at our Channagym, video games, an in-office bar, and many more! Channaweek & Channaweekend: connect with your global colleagues at our annual team gathering in Utrecht, and pack your bags for Channaweekend, our annual company-wide getaway. How can you introduce yourself to us? Are you interested? To ensure your application reaches the right team quickly, please submit it in English directly through our careers page by clicking the “Apply” button. Applications submitted via email won’t be considered. If it's a match, Ioana (Tech Talent Acquisition Partner) will get in touch with you for an introductory call. After that, you'll be invited for interviews. We look forward to hearing from you as soon as possible! Contact by job agencies and recruiters will not be appreciated. Each recruiter or headhunter who approaches us agrees with a donation of €250 for Make-A-Wish. At Channable, we strive to create and foster an environment of belonging and collaboration and we believe in diverse and inclusive teams. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Working Student / Intern (f/m/d) Business Development in MedTech
description: Who We Are BTT Health manufactures medical devices for bone health. It produces the Marodyne LiV device – a leading clinically validated low-intensity vibration device for bone density, muscle function and mobility; a mega market for osteoporosis patients which represents one of the TOP 10 diseases in the western world according to the WHO. Moreover, it manufactures and distributes Bone4ce/Melmak for bone regeneration, both with distribution partners in the US, Canada, Australia and Central Europe. In summer 2026, an investor group acquired the company. Now we're rebuilding BTT Health as a start-up with proven products: a sharper strategy, new markets and a broader portfolio. You'll work directly with our Head of Growth, one of the investors – and since we use AI to move fast as a small team, that's exactly where you come in. What You'll Do AI-Powered Workflows & Automation ● Spot the potential – find tasks in marketing, sales and admin that AI chatbots and agents can do faster and better ● Build it – set up AI workflows and automations (e.g. Power Automate, Zapier, HubSpot), from prototype to daily use ● Digitize sales – help shape our CRM, sales reporting and dashboards ● Enable the team – create prompt templates, quick guides and mini-trainings Sales & Business Development ● Partner support – help manage our distribution partners in the US, Canada, Australia and Central Europe ● New markets – research and qualify potential new distribution partners and markets ● Portfolio scouting – evaluate new products and technologies, from first research to a decision paper for management ● Deal prep – presentations, quotes, analyses and partner meetings Marketing & Market Analysis (strategic focus) ● Campaigns & content – for our website, LinkedIn, newsletters and professional audiences – AI-assisted from idea to launch ● Market intelligence – research markets, competitors, trends and growth opportunities ● Science to story – turn clinical study data into clear content for partners, clinicians and patients What You Bring ● Studies – Bachelor's or Master's student in business, industrial engineering, medtech, life sciences, informatics, healthcare management or similar ● Curiosity – real interest in medtech, medicine and technology – and in the business side ● AI-native – you use ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot & co. daily; Power Automate, Zapier or Python is a plus ● Structured thinking – analytical, well organized and confident in Excel and PowerPoint (old school, we know, but we use it and need it) ● Languages – fluent in English, German is a big plus but no requirement ● Start-up energy – hands-on, full of ideas, at home in a fast-paced start-up ● Availability – up to 20 hours/week (more during semester breaks) for min. 6 months What We Offer ● €1,500 gross per month – based on 20 hours/week, adjusted pro rata for fewer hours ● Start-up spirit with substance – help rebuild a medtech company with established products and partners ● Real ownership – your own projects from day one that shape the rebuild ● Direct line to the top – work with our Head of Growth; flat hierarchies, fast decisions ● AI playground – test new tools and put your ideas into practice right away ● Hybrid & flexible – hours around your lectures; Kissing is 30 min by direct train from Munich Hbf ● Real impact – products for bone health (Marodyne LiV vibration therapy, LIPUS) and the option to write your thesis with us How to Apply Ready to help us rebuild BTT Health? Just send your CV – that's all we need. A short motivation letter is welcome but optional. Please mention your earliest start date. Bonus: tell us in two or three sentences one skill that would definitely help you to excel at this job (e.g., medtech knowledge, technical skills..). Humans will read your application; we do not use AI in the hiring process. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: Dentons is designed to be different. We are driven to always be the firm of the future, to challenge the status quo, and to provide holistic business solutions to our clients in new and innovative ways. We are the lightbulb moments. The bold ideas. We are the world's largest global law firm, with 12,000+ people across 80+ countries. Driven by the diverse perspectives of our people, our clients, and our communities, we combine local knowledge with global insight. About the Role Dentons is seeking a commercially focused Senior Manager to support the Europe Competition & Antitrust Practice. A track record of turning practice strategy into commercial plans, campaigns and measurable activity across jurisdictions. Experience supporting a Competition, Antitrust, Regulatory, Disputes or Transactional legal practice. Strong commercial judgement, analytical capability and an ability to translate market and client insight into action. Experience using CRM systems, Microsoft Office tools, proposal processes, directory submissions and AI tools. Fluency in English. Additional European languages are an asset. title: Monteur Bouwplaatsbeveiliging
description: Job Description Ben jij een techneut die graag onderweg is en energie krijgt van het installeren van moderne beveiligingssystemen? Werk je graag zelfstandig en vind je het leuk om met de nieuwste technologieën te werken? Dan is de functie van Monteur Bouwplaatsbeveiliging bij RECO iets voor jou! Jouw baan als Monteur bij RECO Als Monteur Bouwplaatsbeveiliging ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het installeren en in bedrijf stellen van onze innovatieve beveiligingsoplossingen. Je werkt met slimme camerasystemen en hoogwaardige beveiligingsoplossingen. Denk aan snel inzetbare mobiele cameramasten, slimme detectiesystemen, mobiele brandmeldinstallaties, alarmsystemen en toegangscontrolesystemen. Zo draag jij elke dag bij aan veilige bouwplaatsen en projectlocaties. Je gaat zelfstandig op pad naar uiteenlopende projecten, waar je beveiligingsinstallaties monteert, configureert en gebruiksklaar oplevert. Daarnaast heb je nauw contact met onze werkvoorbereiders en planners die jouw werkzaamheden optimaal voor jou voorbereiden. Dankzij jouw technische kennis, improvisatievermogen en oog voor kwaliteit kunnen onze klanten rekenen op een betrouwbare beveiligingsoplossing die dag en nacht optimaal functioneert. Jouw belangrijkste werkzaamheden: ✅ Installeren, configureren en in bedrijf stellen van slimme camerasystemen, toegangscontrolesystemen en beveiligingsinstallaties. ✅ Testen, controleren en opleveren van complete beveiligingsoplossingen. ✅ Signaleren en oplossen van technische uitdagingen tijdens de installatie. ✅ Het analyseren en oplossen van storingen en het uitvoeren van preventief onderhoud. ✅ Je bent klantgericht en communiceert proactief en prettig met klanten en collega’s. ✅ Je hebt oog voor de veiligheid van jezelf, collega’s en andere personen op- en in de buurt van jouw werkplek. ✅ Samenwerken met collega's van werkvoorbereiding, planning, service en techniek om ieder project succesvol op te leveren. Geen werkdag is hetzelfde. De ene dag installeer je een compleet camerasysteem op een bouwplaats, de volgende dag werk je aan een beveiligingsoplossing op een industriële locatie. Je werkt zelfstandig, met de ondersteuning van je collega's wanneer dat nodig is en je krijgt alle ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Requirements Wat breng jij mee? 👍 Je hebt basiskennis van elektrotechniek of installatietechniek; 👍 Je werkt graag zelfstandig, maar schakelt ook makkelijk met collega’s; 👍 Je vindt het leuk om op verschillende locaties te werken; 👍 Je werkt netjes en denkt in oplossingen; 👍 Een VCA-certificaat of de bereidheid dit via RECO te behalen. 👍 Je beschikt over een rijbewijs B. Een VOG-aanvraag is vanwege onze certificering een verplicht onderdeel van het sollicitatieproces. Bij RECO willen we jou blij maken met: ✅ Een goed salaris; ✅ 28 vakantiedagen per jaar, oplopend tot 31 dagen als waardering voor geen ziekteverzuim; ✅ Daarnaast krijg je een telefoon en laptop van de zaak, zodat je goed van start kunt. ✅ Overwerkvergoeding; ✅ Buitendienstvergoeding; ✅ Een collectieve zorgverzekering én goede pensioenregeling met maar 3,3% eigen bijdrage, de rest betaalt RECO; ✅ Een moderne werkbus gevuld met het nieuwste gereedschap; ✅ Veel opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden via onze RECO Academy; ✅ Werken in een hechte organisatie: iedereen kent elkaar bij naam, de lijnen zijn kort en je loopt gemakkelijk bij elkaar binnen. Daarnaast organiseren we een goed verzorgde zomerbarbecue en een groots eindejaarspersoneelsfeest! Klik hier voor een kijkje in onze . title: Head of Product
description: Head of Product (m/f/d) | Berlin | Full-Time Location: Berlin, Germany (office first) Start date: As soon as possible Company: Venture-backed AI startup, early stage About the Company We’re a fast-growing AI company building agents for complex, high-stakes enterprise workflows in public procurement, one of Europe’s largest and least digitised markets. Our product takes on the slow, manual, document-heavy work behind public tenders. That saves businesses and the public sector a great deal of wasted time and money. The Role We’re hiring a Head of Product to own and scale our product function. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You’ll be the most senior product person in the company and work directly with the founders and engineering team. You’ll personally drive discovery, prioritisation and delivery. As we grow, you’ll set up how the product function works: its processes, rituals and culture. When the time is right, you’ll hire the team around you. What You’ll Do Own the product strategy and roadmap, setting direction alongside the founders, engineering and customers. Lead core product initiatives end to end, from discovery and scoping through launch and iteration. You’ll ship AI products that enterprise customers rely on. Stay close to the product: test, refine and pressure-test our agents, and understand how prompts, context and evaluations shape quality. Spend real time with customers. Uncover requirements, turn noisy feedback into clear priorities and become a trusted partner to their business. Build the product function. Define how we discover, prioritise, ship and measure, and lay the foundations for a future product team. Work with GTM on positioning and join sales conversations where product insight wins deals. Who You Are 5+ years in product management or a closely related role (founder, early operator, consulting into product), with a strong record of shipping. A startup operator at heart. You’ve done your best work at early-stage companies, ideally as one of the first product hires or as a founder. Experience only at large corporates won’t be the right fit for this role. A strong all-rounder, as comfortable setting strategy as writing a detailed spec, debugging an edge case or jumping on a sales call. Exceptional product sense and user empathy. You look past the surface of a feature request to find the root problem. Technically curious. You don’t need a CS degree or coding skills, but you’re confident working with engineers and exploring what AI can and can’t do. A clear communicator who uses both qualitative and quantitative reasoning to make and explain decisions. Based in Berlin or ready to relocate. Fluent in English and German (required for our customer base). Nice to have: B2B or enterprise software experience (strongly preferred), hands-on work with AI/LLM products, or exposure to public sector or regulated markets. You’ll Thrive If You love building from 0 to 1. You don’t need a roadmap handed to you, and you enjoy creating structure where there is none. You move fast and are energised by an intense, ambitious environment. You have a “no task is too small” mindset and lead by doing. You love being in the office and believe in-person collaboration drives speed. What’s In It For You Ownership from day one. You’ll define the product, with direct access to the founders and zero red tape. A role that grows with you. As the company scales, so do your scope and your team. Shared upside: top-of-market compensation and generous equity. A mission that matters. You won’t be optimising ad clicks. You’ll be helping businesses and the public sector cut waste on a huge scale. Our Process Review: All applications reviewed within 5 days. Intro call: 30 minutes on your background and motivations. Product deep dive (remote): 1 hour on your product thinking and problem-solving. On-site (half day): Work through a real product use case with the team, followed by 1:1s with Engineering and GTM. Offer: A quick final decision and transparent feedback straight after the on-site. How to Apply Apply through this posting with: Your CV A few lines on what excites you about this role Optional: links to products you’ve shipped Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
