and migration between classical X.509 certificates and post-quantum authentication mechanisms.</li> <li>Define trust boundaries, security properties, and threat models covering key compromise, unauthorized issuance, software supply-chain compromise, operator error, malicious insiders, infrastructure failure, split views, and cryptographic migration.</li> <li>Design systems that make CA behavior observable and independently verifiable through transparency mechanisms, reproducible builds, cryptographic attestations, public operational telemetry, tamper-evident evidence, and audit controls.</li> <li>Design failure containment and recovery mechanisms that support safe certificate replacement, revocation, key rotation, and incident response without creating avoidable Internet availability failures.</li> <li>Translate CA/Browser Forum requirements, browser and operating-system root-program policies, audit criteria, and certification requirements into concrete technical and operational controls.</li> <li>Review protocols, architecture, and implementations with an adversarial mindset, identifying assumptions and failure modes that do not hold at Internet scale.</li> technical mentorship to engineers implementing and operating the CA platform.</li> <li>Represent Cloudflare in relevant standards and industry work, collaborating with browser vendors, root programs, researchers, auditors, CA operators, and the wider Web PKI community.</li> </ul> <h2>What You'll Bring</h2> <ul> <li>Substantial experience designing or operating security-critical systems, with deep expertise in at least one of: public Certificate Authorities, Web PKI, applied cryptography, TLS and Internet security protocols, Certificate Transparency, hardware-backed key management, or implications of CA design decisions.</li> <li>Experience defining system trust boundaries, threat models, security invariants, and failure-handling strategies.</li> <li>Ability to reason about systems in which a subtle architectural or operational mistake can affect a significant fraction of the Internet.</li> <li>Experience leading architecture across multiple engineering teams without relying solely on organizational authority.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain cryptographic and architectural tradeoffs to engineers, auditors, standards participants, and senior stakeholders.</li> <li>Comfort operating with substantial autonomy in an evolving technical and policy environment.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Singapore</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p><strong>About the Role</strong> At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. As the architectural complexity of enterprise solutions scales, we are evolving how we partner with our customers. The Customer Engineer (CE) represents the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted advisor who owns the technical relationship from the initial discovery phase through to long-term adoption and ongoing account expansion.</p> <p>Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to the Regional Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> <li><strong>Language skill: </strong>Bilingual in English and Cantonese as you will be supporting Hong Kong customers.</li> Workers AI and AI Gateway.</li> <li><strong>Applied AI Knowledge:</strong> Experience with prompt engineering, Large Language Model (LLM) orchestration, or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.</li> <li><strong>Coding/Scripting:</strong> Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <p><strong>Compensation</strong> This role features a competitive base salary and a variable commission structure tied directly to the successful execution of full-lifecycle commercial targets, including new business acquisition, ongoing adoption milestones, and overall account expansion.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Location: Spain, Madrid<br></strong></h3> <p><strong>About Us</strong></p> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. </p> <p> </p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p> <h3><strong>What you will do as a Customer Engineer</strong></h3> <p>The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization: </strong>Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices.  Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services,  Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).</li> <li>Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.</li> <li>Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.</li> <li>Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> <li>Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Education</strong></p> <p>Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. </p> <p><strong>Travel</strong></p> <p>This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team c

You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. We are seeking a highly skilled, forward-thinking <strong>Senior Enterprise Systems Developer</strong> to join our Enterprise Systems team with a dedicated focus on our Procurement and Spend Management ecosystem.</p> <p>In this role, you will be the primary technical owner for our Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) applications. Your core tech stack will include <strong>Zip (Intake/Orchestration), Ironclad, Oracle Fusion Cloud (Procurement), and managing the transition out of Coupa</strong>. Your primary customer will be the Procurement Organization, and you will partner closely with them to optimize the way Cloudflare sources, contracts, and purchases at scale.</p> <p>If you are a builder at heart who enjoys solving complex supply chain and procurement workflow challenges, leveraging AI and automation, and designing seamless enterprise integrations, this role is for you.</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Application Administration & Environment Management</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Serve as the primary subject-matter expert and developer for Cloudflare’s Procurement technology stack (Zip, Ironclad, Oracle Procurement, Coupa).</li> <li>Manage user provisioning, complex role-based access control (RBAC), and security settings specific to purchasing limits and contract approvals.</li> <li>Manage application environments (e.g., Production vs. Sandbox/Demo), ensuring alignment across all environments from both a data and release perspective.</li> <li>Monitor ongoing application performance and reliability, managing incident workflows to ensure ticket SLAs for the Procurement organization are consistently met.</li> <li>Provide Tier 3 support and end-user enablement, serving as the ultimate technical escalation point for procurement system issues.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>System Development, Integrations & AI Initiatives</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Act as the Subject-Matter Expert for integrations across the procurement lifecycle. Ensure the seamless flow of data (e.g., syncing vendor intake data from Zip, passing contract metadata from Ironclad to Oracle Fusion, and managing purchase order syncs).</li> <li>Design, build, and deploy custom system enhancements, automated workflows, template generation, and API integrations between our procurement platforms and core ERP.</li> <li>Lead the evaluation, implementation, and governance of native AI features within the P2P stack (e.g., Ironclad AI for contract analysis and redlining, Zip AI for vendor onboarding/intake routing) to accelerate procurement cycles.</li> <li>Proactively monitor vendors' quarterly updates and product roadmaps (especially for Zip and Ironclad). Lead impact assessments, manage versioning/upgrades, and educate Procurement stakeholders on new functionality and AI opportunities.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Process Management & Workflow Design</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Partner directly with the Procurement organization, Legal, and Finance to deeply understand their operational processes and translate business requirements into sophisticated system solutions.</li> <li>Own the design, configuration, and delivery of complex workflows (e.g., global Procure-to-Pay rules, dynamic intake routing, and automated contract approvals) to eliminate manual bottlenecks.</li> <li>Support the strategic migration and sun-setting of legacy systems (e.g., Coupa), ensuring zero disruption to business continuity during the transition to our modernized stack.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Security, Compliance, & Data Governance</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Partner closely with Internal Audit, Risk, and Compliance teams to maintain robust IT General Controls (ITGC) and strict enterprise-wide data governance for spend and vendor data.</li> <li>Spearhead and execute <strong>Quarterly Access Reviews (UAR)</strong> for all Procurement and CLM applications, ensuring accurate access levels and enforcing strict Segregation of Duties (SoD) within the purchasing cycle.</li> <li>Ensure newly implemented AI features and data-sharing protocols strictly adhere to SOX compliance, vendor risk policies, and maintain audit readiness for all financial and contract records.</li> <li>Maintain comprehensive system architecture documentation, process If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Madison or Milwaukee, WI</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>We are seeking an exceptionally accomplished and visionary Senior Majors Account Executive to join our Enterprise/Field Sales team. In this expert-level role, you will be the driving force behind Cloudflare's most strategic customer engagements, leading the charge in securing and expanding critical platform sales within focused accounts. The ideal candidate possesses unparalleled sales leadership, a profound grasp of enterprise architecture across all four pillars (business, data, applications, technology), and the ability to articulate how Cloudflare seamlessly integrates into modern cloud operating models.</p> <p>As a Senior Majors Account Executive, you will demonstrate the highest level of sales proficiency, ensuring highly accurate forecasting, strategic pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets. You will be a recognized subject matter expert, providing in-depth education to customers and partners alike on Cloudflare’s extensive product ecosystem and its place within the broader security landscape. This role demands the ability to apply executive sponsorship programs, actively engaging with CIOs, CISOs, and CTOs, and leading virtual teams that include VPs and SVPs to navigate and close complex, transformative opportunities. You will shape our customers' digital transformation journeys, identifying opportunities within broader market trends and positioning Cloudflare as their indispensable strategic partner.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Executive-Level Strategic Revenue Leadership: Own and execute the most critical territory and account plans, consistently exceeding multi-million dollar sales targets and annual quotas by architecting and closing large-scale platform sales within highly focused, strategic accounts.</li> <li>Precision Forecasting & Pipeline Mastery: Lead with unparalleled accuracy in forecasting and demonstrate complete mastery of proactive pipeline management. Provide visionary insights and strategic guidance that shapes the direction of the sales organization.</li> <li>Enterprise Architecture & Business Model Expertise: Exhibit an expert-level understanding of customer Enterprise Architecture across all four pillars (business, data, applications, technology), seamlessly mapping these to customer business models. This position will manage a focused set of ~20-30 accounts with $1B -$25B in annual revenues. The Enterprise Account team will shape and lead Cloudflare’s Go To Market.</li> <li>We will leverage the strength of all Cloudflare functions to become a strategic partner to our customers and their digital transformation efforts. Our product and services and our methods of engagement will differentiate and delight our customers.</li> <li>The AE will interact with both C-level clients and senior technical decision makers, utilizing Cloudflare solutions and resources to drive a business partnership focused on joint success with our customers.  Success requires consultative, solutions-oriented sales, and customer service skills in addition to intense personal energy and focused activity. The AE must be expert in identifying business opportunities with customers, developing Enterprise Account Plans, driving execution across functional stakeholders, and closing revenue. The Enterprise Account Executive should be comfortable engaging in business level outcome conversations with the C-suite, presenting Cloudflare’s vision and plan for value creation to all levels, and negotiating win-win scenarios for all parties. The AE will be accountable to obtaining new business and expansion of Cloudflare wallet-share within existing customers. The role involves handling multiple accounts and will require high degrees of attention to detail and coordination with customers, partners, and internal resources. Lastly, the AE should thrive in an entrepreneurial environment where initiative is celebrated and enthusiasm for the possible is expected.</li> </ul> <h3>Enterprise Account Team Core Values:</h3> <ul> <li>Be Successful – Success comes from hitting your goals on a consistent basis. Have a plan for “how” you’ll hit your goals and evaluate often; that way you always know where you stand. Be in a position and ready to demonstrate your plan for success.</li> <li>Provide Customers with a Premium Business Experience - Solutions, Empathy, Proactiveness, Anticipation of needs, Company Support, Creativity, and Urgency to Deliver Value are core principles of a Cloudflare Strategic Account Experience. We are successful when we are all overachieving as a group.</li> <li>Proactively manage and grow a portfolio of assigned Enterprise level clients.</li> <li>Close new and expansion business monthly, quarterly, and annual basis, meeting or exceeding assigned quota.</li> <li>Manage customer relationships and assume ownership of deadlines and deliverables to ensure Cloudflare is correctly positioned to win business.</li> <li>Develop C level and Decision Maker relationships within accounts for the purpose of establishing strategic alignment to customer’s transformative objectives.</li> <li>Develop pipeline by maintaining a high level of activity/outreach directly and indirectly, deeply understanding the customers goals and objectives, and analyzing where Cloudflare can add value.</li> <li>Maintain accurate forecasts and report to the sales leader on the status of New and Expansion opportunities for weekly sales meetings. Understand the purchasing process fully and be able to document progress against required steps to closure.</li> <li>Organize and deliver executive level presentations, proposals, commercial terms with Customers.</li> <li>Leverage the Executive Briefing Center and process to establish key sponsorships and support of accounts with Cloudflare Executives.</li> <li>Build and maintain relationships with channel partners to establish joint value propositions and Customer value.</li> <li>Participate in team meetings and deliver GTM guidance on how to better partner with accounts.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li><strong>This is a remote role but the location requirement is that you reside in the DC Metro area</strong></li> <li>6+ years of experience coupled with proficiency in Cloud Networking and Security Technology with industry awareness.</li> <li>Demonstrated track record of meeting and exceeding quota.</li> <li>Expert Sales Acumen (Discovery, Position, Compete, Negotiate, Close, Expand).</li> <li>Ability to lead a multidisciplinary team over a long term account horizon.</li> <li>Able to identify key players in organizations and possess the ability to convert business issues into solutions.</li> <li>Comfortable selling to obtain new business or expand existing business. Strong closing skills are essential.</li> <li>Ability to build meaningful relationships quickly.</li> <li>Someone who acts with integrity and honesty in all situations.</li> <li>Be able to demonstrate a positive attitude internally and externally.</li> <li>Expert at building rapport and owning the room.</li> <li>Aggressiveness in execution and planning.</li> <li>Ability to take successes and challenges in stride.</li> <li>Discipline to work w/o instant gratification.</li> <li>Someone who is bold in their actions and never satisfied with complacency.</li> <li>A strong will and fortitude to work a plan in the face of challenge.</li> <li>A business professional who loves the sales profession.</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <h4>For Washington DC, based hires: Estimated annual salary of $269,000 - will scale as the team grows.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Collaborate Cross-Functionally: </strong>Work with Trust & Safety, Data Science, Billing/Fintech, Support, and Product teams to understand fraud vectors and turn them into engineering requirements.</p> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p>Five or more years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent practical experience.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience building and operating distributed systems or backend services in production.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience designing and building data or event pipelines (e.g., Kafka, Pub/Sub, or similar).</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, service security, and API standards such as OpenAPI, OAuth, or JWT.</p> </li> <li> <p>Working knowledge of SQL, data modeling, and relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.</p> </li> <li> <p>Comfort owning ambiguous, 0-to-1 problems with limited existing infrastructure or precedent.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong troubleshooting, cross-functional communication, and project ownership skills.</p> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>Bonus Points</strong></h3> billing, subscriptions, or other financial/transactional systems.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience building internal tools or dashboards for non-engineering stakeholders (analysts, support, finance).</p> </li> </ul> <p> </p> <h4>Compensation</h4> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <p> </p> <h4>Equity</h4> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity isolation, device posture, and secure connectivity.</li> <li>Design WAN transformation solutions that connect users, offices, data centers, and cloud environments using Cloudflare WAN and Context Protocol (MCP) server controls, and agentic AI governance.</li> <li>Use AI tools thoughtfully to improve research, customer preparation, technical analysis, content creation, demonstrations, automation, and the repeatability of field activities.</li> <li>Support broader Cloudflare One opportunities involving Email Security when relevant to the customer's strategy and requirements.</li> demonstration and proof-of-value patterns, technical guidance, and lightweight automation, and coach peers and partners to execute more effectively.</li> <li>Capture customer feedback, market trends, and product gaps, translating them into actionable input for Product and Engineering.</li> <li>Coordinate with Sales, Support, Product, and Engineering to resolve technical issues and maintain customer trust during complex evaluations.</li> <li>Own presales evaluation outcomes through technical close, then coordinate a clean handoff to the appropriate Customer Success, Professional Services, Support, or implementation teams.</li> </ul> <h3>Qualifications</h3> <p>Successful candidates are customer-focused technical leaders who combine broad security and networking experience with networking, or network transformation.</li> <li>Active professional use of AI tools and demonstrated commitment to learning how AI platforms, AI-enabled threats, data exposure, and governance affect environments, APIs, and SIEM or log-analytics platforms.</li> <li>Proven ownership of technical evaluations or proofs of value, including discovery, architecture, scope, success criteria, deployment dependencies, stakeholder communication, technical decision management, and technical close.</li> <li>Strong written, presentation, and demonstration skills across practitioner, architect, and executive audiences, with the ability to connect technical capabilities to risk reduction, operational improvement, and business outcomes.</li> <li>Ability to collaborate across Sales, Product, Engineering, Support, partners, and customer teams while managing competing priorities and deadlines.</li> </ul> <h3>Preferred Qualifications</h3> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience with Cloudflare One title: Industrial Software Engineer - Railway Applications (m/w/d) 80-100%
description: About Traila At Traila, we are dedicated to shaping the future of rail transport through cutting-edge technology. Since our founding in 2017, we have been driven by a passion for sustainability and excellence. We believe that rail transport is a cornerstone of a greener future, and our mission is to make it quieter, more efficient, and more reliable. Our talented team is at the heart of this mission, and we are looking for an Industrial Software Engineer - Railway Applications to join us in developing robust software solutions that operate reliably in real-world railway environments. What you will do - Industrial Software Development: Design, implement and maintain robust application software for industrial and railway products using C++, C#, Python or comparable technologies. - Application & System Integration: Translate system and operational requirements into practical software functionality and integrate software with real hardware and physical systems. - Hardware & Device Interfaces: Integrate sensors, actuators, controllers, DAQ systems and other industrial devices. - Communication Protocols: Implement and troubleshoot interfaces such as CAN/CANopen, EtherCAT, TCP/IP and other industrial or vehicle communication protocols. - Controls & Application Logic: Implement state machines, operational logic, control functionality and system behaviour required by the application. - Commissioning & Field Support: Support installation, commissioning and field testing on prototypes, test systems and rail vehicles, including travel to customer and test sites when required. - Diagnostics & Troubleshooting: Analyse logs, interfaces and system behaviour to identify root causes and solve software and integration issues efficiently. - Testing & Validation: Develop unit, integration and system-level tests and contribute to HIL/SIL or other validation activities where relevant. - Software Architecture, Quality & Controlled Releases: Own software architecture and release discipline, including configuration and version control, code reviews, test evidence and controlled software releases. - Product Cybersecurity: Own threat assessment, secure access and software updates, vulnerability handling and lifecycle security maintenance; coordinate specialist security reviews and work with Systems/RAMS on vehicle interfaces and safety consequences. - Technical Guidance & Mentoring: Review implementations, share practical software-engineering practices and mentor colleagues to strengthen consistency, maintainability and technical ownership across the team. - Tools & Data: Develop tools for configuration, testing, diagnostics, data acquisition and analysis that support engineering and field activities. - Documentation & Continuous Improvement: Maintain clear software and interface documentation and improve existing code as Traila products mature from development into deployed systems. What you bring - Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics or a related discipline, or equivalent practical technical experience. - Hands-on professional software-development experience in an industrial, automation, automotive, machinery or comparable technical environment. - Proven professional railway software experience, including products released and maintained in service. - Strong practical programming skills in C++, C#, Python or a comparable industrial software stack; you do not need to be an expert in every language listed. - Experience developing software that interacts with real hardware, devices or physical systems. - Experience taking software beyond prototypes into tested, maintainable and deployable industrial use. - Practical railway software lifecycle experience aligned with EN 50716:2023, including requirements traceability, configuration management and verification/validation appropriate to the required software integrity level; relevant EN 50128 / EN 50657 predecessor experience is also valuable. - Practical embedded or industrial cybersecurity experience, including secure credentials and access, signed software updates and rollback, and handling vulnerabilities in released products. - Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills across software, communication and hardware interfaces. - Experience with Git and structured software-development workflows. - A practical ownership mindset: comfortable working directly with prototypes, test equipment and deployed systems and driving technical problems through to resolution. - Ability to work effectively across engineering disciplines and communicate technical issues clearly. - Fluent English; German is a strong advantage. Nice to have - Experience with industrial Linux, embedded Linux, automation or control systems. - MATLAB/Simulink, HIL/SIL testing, data acquisition or condition-monitoring experience. - Working knowledge of railway cybersecurity under CLC/TS 50701:2023 and of EN IEC 62443-4-1 (secure development) and EN IEC 62443-4-2 (component security) is desirable. - Familiarity with EN 50155 and EN 50126 for equipment integration and collaboration with Systems/RAMS. - Experience in a regulated or safety-relevant product-development environment. Benefits 25 days of annual leave, plus paid bridge days at Christmas. Flexible working hours and home office options. Annual professional development allowance for courses, certifications and conferences. Competitive compensation with milestone bonus scheme and full Swiss social coverage. A collaborative team culture with regular social and sports activities. Real autonomy and short decision-making paths. If you want your software engineering to have real-world impact in rail, we’d like to hear from you. Contact Yasi Samari, HR Responsible, by applying directly here. title: Revenue Accounting Manager
description: <p> </p> <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>We are hiring a <strong>Revenue Accounting Manager,</strong> ideally a candidate with a passion for systems accounting, to drive revenue recognition process, decisions, systems and reporting.</p> <p>In our finance function we aspire to set the industry pace for speed and accuracy of reporting. We aim to achieve this by driving our product pricing and terms, contracting, sales processes and systems into alignment.</p> <p>We are looking for a <strong>professionally qualified accounting leader with expertise in IFRS 15/ASC 606</strong> to build scalable contract review and revenue recognition processes. This lead will work across teams including product management, legal, FP&A, sales operations and commercial business systems to align understanding and ensure that the accounting and revenue recognition treatment of contracts and products is straightforward and correct, with a very high level of automation. Perhaps unusually we <strong>prefer a leader with deep personal interest in the software and technology industry, and ideally some data analytics and software engineering experience</strong>. The Revenue Accounting Manager will ensure the proper application of revenue accounting guidance for public market scrutiny. </p> <p>This is a management position which requires confidence in presentation, setting goals, and directing the work of others. We expect to grow a team focused on revenue, with a particular emphasis on systems and automation, that puts us at the top of the leaderboard for clarity, correctness, transparency and speed of reporting as a global tech company.</p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>This role is home-based in EMEA time zones, with the option to be based in our London office. It will report to our Global Financial Controller.</p> <h3>Key responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Collaborate with Product Management, Sales Operations, Sales, Legal, and FP&A teams to design standard contracts</li> <li>Drive process and configuration improvements in NetSuite and related systems for end-to-end automation of the revenue life cycle</li> <li>Incorporate industry best practices and emerging technology to raise the bar for reporting speed and accuracy</li> <li>Review and evaluate the revenue recognition impact of non-standard contracts and new products</li> <li>Lead, mentor and develop a team of revenue accounting and systems accounting professionals</li> <li>Assist in month-end revenue close, including reconciliations, fluctuation analysis, and other reporting</li> <li>Develop and maintain effective internal controls over revenue transactions and reporting</li> <li>Research and write accounting memos on significant revenue recognition and other related policy matters</li> <li>Act as the primary liaison with external auditors in matters related to order-to-cash</li> </ul> <h3>Valued skills and experience</h3> <ul> <li>An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university</li> <li>An undergraduate degree in Accounting or Finance, or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path</li> <li>CPA, CA or equivalent with excellent technical accounting skills and IFRS experience</li> <li>A detailed understanding of IFRS 15 and relevant rules related to SaaS and services</li> <li>Leadership or management responsibility</li> <li>A track record of going above-and-beyond expectations</li> <li>Experience of software licensing, subscription and services revenue accounting and operations</li> <li>Experience driving revenue recognition and scaling accounting processes in a high-growth environment</li> <li>Experience with ERP, Rev Rec, CRM, CPQ and other relevant software categories - NetSuite and Salesforce preferred</li> <li>Experience in a multi-country multi-currency, operations and tax environment</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English </li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability </li> <li>Thoughtfulness and self-motivation </li> <li>Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments </li> <li>Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long</li> </ul> <h3>Additional, optional skills we value</h3> <ul> <li>Public company reporting and revenue accounting experience</li> <li>Software implementation, integration and user acceptance</li> <li>Software engineering qualification or experience</li> <li>A passion for technology and a desire to work with motivated colleagues</li> <li>MBA or other relevant business degree</li> </ul> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote</p> <h3> </h3>

each deployment model so operational practices stay coherent rather than fragmenting into separate playbooks.</li> <li>Apply distributed systems fundamentals, including consistency, replication, and failure domains, to Gitaly's storage and replication model.</li> <li>Own elastic storage and compute strategy for Git repository data, including capacity planning, autoscaling, and consumption-based provisioning for GitLab's largest self-managed and SaaS customers.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Familiarity with GitLab's product and deployment models, and how Git horizontal scalability.</li> <li>Experience running production infrastructure across multiple deployment models, such as self-managed, dedicated or single-tenant, and multi-tenant SaaS, or a credible You'll also help keep GitLab and its customers secure by building access management tooling and addressing vulnerabilities reported through our HackerOne program.</p> <p>GATE will become the foundation for token issuance, validation, and identity services across GitLab.com multi-tenant software as a service (SaaS), Self-Managed, Dedicated, and air-gapped environments. Your work will affect core components that customers, users, and GitLab teams rely on.</p> <p>Some of our projects include:</p> <ul> <li value="1">Building GATE as the centralized service for token issuance and validation</li> <li value="2">Consolidating tokens and migrating authentication paths out of the Rails monolith</li> <li value="3">Building passkeys and passwordless authentication</li> <li value="4">Developing composite identities that combine machine and human authorization for AI</li> <li value="5">Improving service accounts and secure automation</li> <li value="6">Enhancing Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP), OpenID Connect (OIDC), and System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) capabilities for automated user provisioning and single sign-on (SSO)</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Shape the roadmap for GATE and GitLab's authentication services with the team.</li> <li value="2">Design and implement token issuance, validation, and identity services in Go and Ruby across the Rails monolith and GATE, including new authentication mechanisms such as Workload Identity Federation.</li> <li value="3">Migrate authentication and token management paths from the monolith into GATE while maintaining reliability across all deployment models.</li> <li value="4">Build authentication mechanisms from the ground up, such as Workload Identity Federation.</li> <li value="5">Strengthen security for users and organizations through access management tooling and by addressing vulnerabilities reported through our HackerOne program.</li> <li value="6">Define and improve standards for style, maintainability, and engineering practices in a high-scale environment, and advocate for them through code review.</li> <li value="7">Communicate publicly about GitLab initiatives, projects, and contributions from people not working for GitLab Inc. Reflect GitLab's values in these communications.</li> <li value="8">Ship moderately sized features and improvements with moderate guidance and support from other team members, and collaborate on larger projects, including the build-out of GATE.</li> <li value="9">Participate in the maintainer trainee program at your own comfortable pace while working toward becoming a project maintainer.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Professional experience with Go and/or Ruby in scaling or mission-critical SaaS products.</li> <li value="2">Familiarity with authentication and authorization technologies or techniques, such as OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SSO, SCIM, LDAP, JSON Web Tokens (JWTs), role-based access control (RBAC), or identity and access management (IAM).</li> <li value="3">Knowledge of token systems, cryptographic signing, and key management.</li> <li value="4">Experience building or contributing to a service from concept to production, including proposal, discussion, and execution.</li> <li value="5">Proficiency in written and verbal English, with the ability to communicate complex problems and solutions clearly in a remote, largely asynchronous work environment.</li> <li value="6">Experience diagnosing, preventing, and resolving performance and optimization problems.</li> <li value="7">Experience working in an iterative software development process, managing your work effectively, staying organized, and following through on priorities.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>Our mission is to empower GitLab system administrators with the toolkit they need to create their desired balance of security and accessibility for their GitLab experience.</p> <p>Authentication is the first impression a new customer has when they configure a new GitLab instance. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>The Observability, Monitoring, and Integrations team manages observability, monitoring, and detection for systems that support customer purchasing and use of GitLab. As a Staff Backend Engineer on the Fulfillment Workflow Monitoring (Catch All) team, you'll set the technical direction for the telemetry, detection, and reconciliation tooling that identifies billing, data, and event anomalies across CustomersDot, Salesforce, and Zuora before they can affect revenue or the customer experience.</p> <p>This is a greenfield team. You'll help build it from the ground up, shaping its operating rhythm, incident response model, and quality bar. You'll use telemetry and machine learning to identify issues early and help resolve them. Because Monetization changes can directly affect revenue and often involve confidential or financial information, you'll use strong judgment, careful rollout practices, and a high bar for reliability. This role is opening at the Staff Backend Engineer level (grade 8).</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Design, build, and operate observability across the Monetization stack, including metrics, logs, and traces, using tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.</li> <li value="2">Implement automated detection for billing, data, and event anomalies, and route alerts to the responsible feature teams.</li> <li value="3">Develop reconciliation and data integrity checks across usage and billing pipelines.</li> <li value="4">Define and track service level objectives and service level indicators, write runbooks, and take part in incident response to measure and improve Monetization system reliability.</li> <li value="5">Explore artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques to predict system anomalies and accelerate resolution.</li> <li value="6">Review and offer feedback on merge requests from other Monetization engineers.</li> <li value="7">Collaborate with Product, Finance, Support, and other partners to turn operational needs into reliable tooling.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Professional experience with Ruby on Rails, including building and operating applications such as CustomersDot.</li> <li value="2">Experience in site reliability or observability engineering, including monitoring, alerting, service level objectives and indicators, runbooks, and incident response.</li> <li value="3">Experience setting technical direction for observability, reliability, or detection work and bringing other engineers along.</li> <li value="4">Experience building anomaly detection, monitoring, or risk management tooling.</li> <li value="5">Familiarity with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry.</li> <li value="6">Exposure to analytical data stores such as ClickHouse and the change data capture and event-streaming pipelines that feed them, including NATS JetStream.</li> <li value="7">Experience owning projects from concept through production, communicating clearly about complex technical and organizational problems, and proposing iterative solutions.</li> <li value="8">Working knowledge of Python for anomaly detection and data work, or experience with billing, financial, or other business-critical systems, including Zuora or Salesforce, is a plus.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Observability, Monitoring, and Integrations team is part of GitLab's Monetization section, a highly cross-functional group that partners with Sales, Finance, IT, and Support to deliver secure and reliable purchasing, billing, provisioning, and utilization workflows. title: Credit Risk Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">📍Dublin | 💶 €93,500 - €114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + benefits | <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4">Hear from the team</a> ✨</span></p> <p><strong>⭐ About the team:</strong></p> <p>Our Borrowing (lending) business is growing rapidly across both existing products and the planned launch of new initiatives. We aim to create a genuine feel-good factor when it comes to personal credit, and are looking for driven, analytical and creative individuals to help us achieve this goal.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Credit Risk Manager to help drive the credit and growth strategy for our consumer lending products as we grow our business in Ireland. Our credit teams are part of our Credit Discipline which drives a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. We’re great believers in powerful, real-time analytics and empowerment of the wider business. All our data lives in one place and is super easy to use. 90% of day-to-day data-driven decisions are covered by self-serve analytics through Looker which gives analysts the head space to focus on more impactful business questions and analyses.</p> <p>Join a team where your ideas can rapidly transform into reality, leveraging our cutting-edge technology and agile ways of working. Our credit analysts and managers are fully embedded into a product squad alongside Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, Marketers, Customer Researchers, Data Scientists etc. This enables us to solve customer problems in a fast paced and innovative way.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You'll play a key role by:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Working closely with Borrowing squad leadership to develop and execute an ambitious growth strategy </li> <li>Collaborating with people from engineering, marketing, product, risk and control to design and deliver new products and customer journeys</li> <li>Leading the development and maintenance of the NPV models and affordability strategies that underpin the Borrowing underwriting decisions</li> <li>Monthly monitoring and reporting on Borrowing performance to stakeholders up to executive level</li> <li>Collaborating with the Decision Science team to maximise value from our internal and external data through cutting-edge ML models</li> <li>Promoting a culture of proactive, high quality analysis and ensure we have the right credit capabilities, infrastructure and talent in place to scale safely</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!</li> <li>You have extensive experience in unsecured lending in Ireland</li> <li>You have a deep understanding of lending economics and have experience developing and deploying underwriting strategies and credit models</li> <li>You have strong analytical and data capabilities, backed up by technical coding skills. SQL, Python and Looker experience is a plus</li> <li>You have experience with the development and maintenance of NPV models</li> <li>You have a strong understanding of the regulations that apply to lending in Ireland</li> <li>You thrive in a fast-paced environment and are keen for the chance to improve our products and help ship changes to our customers</li> <li>You are a strong communicator, able to cut through complex problems and articulate decision points, particularly to senior leadership</li> <li>You have experience in project management and coordination across teams</li> <li>You work well collaborating in a team with diverse skill-sets and personality types</li> <li>You are highly motivated and energised by the idea of bringing a positive impact to our customers and Monzo</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💶 A salary range of €93,500 - €114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>📍This role will have a hybrid working model, based in our Dublin office 3 days a week. You will also travel to Monzo’s head office in London from time to time</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team</p> <p>🏝 Annual Leave - 34 days including public holidays (24 holiday days + 10 public holidays)</p> <p>📚€1,200 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>🏥 Private healthcare scheme</p> <p>💰Pension scheme: the minimum contribution is 4% and Monzo matches any additional contributions that you make up to a maximum of 6%</p> <p>💛 Wellbeing benefits: financial education, women’s and men’s health support, mental health benefits, including coaching and counselling</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>An introductory video call with a member of the Monzo Recruitment team</li> <li>An initial video call with the hiring manager</li> <li>A series of role specific, case study & behavioural interviews</li> <li>A final call with senior leadership</li> </ol> <p>This process should take around 4-5 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We'll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don't miss out.</p> <p>#LI-MOS1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. both written and verbal</li> <li>Experience with Linux server technologies, including but not limited to Virtualization (KVM), Containers (LXC), etc.</li> <li>You have a Bachelor’s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree</li> <li>Knowledge of network technologies, including PXE, DHCP, TFTP, DNS, NTP</li> <li>Some experience with Baseboard Management Controllers and Protocols (Redfish, IPMI, AMT and others)</li> <li>Strong experience with networking, storage technologies and Cloud hosting and infrastructure.</li> <li>Ideally, experience of large-scale physical server provisioning and automation, including rapid deployment, configuration, management and service orchestration.</li> <li>Familiarity with some of the open source development tools and methodologies used in creation of several Ubuntu projects (MAAS, Juju, Ubuntu Server, LXD, Ubuntu Core), such as Launchpad, Debian packaging tools (APT, dpkg) and snapcraft.</li> <li>An exceptional academic track record from both high school and preferably university.</li> <li>Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote</p>

title: Senior FinCrime Operations Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">📍Dublin | 💶 €76,500 - €95,500 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + benefits | <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4">Hear from the team</a> ✨</span></p> <p><strong>⭐ Our FinCrime, Fraud and Dispute Operations team</strong></p> <p>Reporting to the EU Director of FinCrime, Fraud and Dispute Operations, we're looking for a Senior Financial Crime Ops Manager to join our fast-growing EU team here in Dublin. You will need to oversee our outsourced partners, holding them accountable for SLAs and performance. This position requires in-depth data analysis expertise and a strong commitment to data-driven decision making, alongside a solid understanding of day-to-day fincrime operations and deep knowledge of transaction monitoring, AML/CTF, screening, and onboarding rules and models implementation. You will work across different areas and products including our current and business accounts and partner with our group data science, data engineering, product, and technology teams.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Driving strategic partners oversight: Ensuring that our outsourcing partners for FinCrime Operations are operating effectively.</li> <li>Monitoring our FinCrime metrics and driving action delivery with our product teams to address the trends.</li> <li>Combining hands-on execution with strategic thinking to align cross-functional teams with our FinCrime, AML/ CTF vision and strategy.</li> <li>Helping to build and oversee solutions with technology at the heart of our screening, onboarding and transaction monitoring mitigation strategies to cover the various typologies using automated alerts.</li> <li>Supporting the Director of FinCrime, Fraud and Disputes operations with producing Committee packs.</li> <li>Supporting and managing the oversight of change implementation, making prioritisation calls of those initiatives. </li> <li>Working closely with the second line of defence and our Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO) to complete assurance activity, identification and remediation of any actions. </li> <li>Collaborating across the company to remove roadblocks and solve complex challenges relating to Monzo's EU expansion.</li> <li>Supporting 3rd line of defence with auditing activities. </li> <li>Being an excellent partner to our third party vendors, unblocking and empowering their teams for high delivery and high performance. </li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You excel at leveraging robust data insights and analytics to drive strategic decision-making.</li> <li>You are a problem solver who takes initiative to create a high impact for stakeholders.</li> <li>Excel at stakeholder management and coordination across multiple teams.</li> <li>You have previous experience of achieving results through 3rd party/outsourcing  management and you’re excited about working in a cross-functional team with engineers and data scientists to empower third party vendors' success.</li> <li>You have previous experience leading and managing FinCrime operations in payments or banking.</li> <li>You enjoy partnering with 3rd party vendors, data scientists, and second line of defence (2LOD) to proactively mitigate and respond to existing and emerging fraud trends.</li> <li>You understand the Financial crime,  money mulling risks of the various products and services operating in the fintech space.</li> <li>You champion the use of automated processes to find more efficient ways of working.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💶 A salary range of €76,500 - €95,500 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>📍This role will have a hybrid working model, based in our Dublin office 3 days a week. You will also travel to Monzo’s head office in London from time to time</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team</p> <p>🏝 Annual Leave - 34 days including public holidays (24 holiday days + 10 public holidays)</p> <p>📚€1,200 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>🏥 Private healthcare scheme</p> <p>💰Pension scheme: the minimum contribution is 4% and Monzo matches any additional contributions that you make up to a maximum of 6%</p> <p>💛 Wellbeing benefits: financial education, women’s and men’s health support, mental health benefits, including coaching and counselling</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>An introductory video call with a member of the Monzo Recruitment team</li> <li>An initial video call with the hiring manager</li> <li>A series of role specific, behavioural & leadership principles interviews</li> </ol> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We'll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don't miss out.</p> <p>#LI-MOS1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>
